title: Louvre Museum Skip-the-Line Guided Tour with Venus de Milo & Mona Lisa
description: See the highlights at the Louvre with a guide, and gain a depth of understanding for famous works such as the 'Mona Lisa' and 'Venus de Milo.' This tour includes a skip-the-line admission ticket, which should save hours of waiting in line. Plus, you have the option of a morning or afternoon departure time to suit your schedule, or upgrade to a private tour.

reviews.usertext:
My partner and I had an excellent experience on this guided tour, which takes in some of the mosr popular pieces in The Louvre. The museum is so huge and busy that we wouldn't have known what to ptioritise seeing or how to easily get around if we hadn't had a tour guide. Kenny, our guide, was entertaining and knowledgeable. You can choose to leave at the end of the guided tour, or you can carry on exploring The Louvre independtly, so this is really good value for money. Having seen the line to get in, I'm so glad we had skip the line acces.

Even if you aren't overly interested in the particular pieces of art, The Louvre is an artwork in and of itself and is incredibly beautiful. I would highly recommend this experience!

Perfect tour of the Louvre with Daniel the Irish Guy. Learned loads about history, art and sculptor - it was a great mix of topics. The Louvre can be overwhelming with the amount to see, so highly recommend booking a tour with a knowledgable tour guide. Also getting to jump the queue is a bonus!

Carolina was excellent! The museum is huge but she made it interesting by showing us certain items of significance and providing the history behind them. She was easy to follow and understand. I definitely recommend this for first time visitors, otherwise it may be easy to get lost in the crowd and miss important artifacts.

My sister and I arrived late . There was no option to reschedule or refund. I wouldn’t have expected a full refund as I understand tickets were probably bought already — but a partial refund could have been offered or a reschedule . I even offered to still go to the louvre, purchase entrance tickets again and meet the group wherever they were — that was also not allowed. If you’re late , there’s absolutely nothing the company will do. So don’t have an emergency or don’t get lost (understandable for a tourist to get lost) because your money will just go down the drain.

My sister and I decided to go to the louvre anyways — lines were long but they move EXTREMELY quickly . We just googled “top things to see at the Louvre” and used an online guide which was FREE. We got the audio guide at the Louvre for 5 euros and that was able to give us the history of the art pieces we chose to go to based on the online guide. Doing this was MUCH cheaper — so I would recommend getting the audio guide and googling a few things you want to see (online guides also tell you the room the pieces are located in) — you can move at your own pace, save money and have a personalized experience!

This ticket was for a skip the line guided tour. The tickets said to arrive at least 15 minutes early as the tour itself started at 11. So arrival time for us was 10:40. The person who was supposed to meet us was there as expected. But 11 came and he still doesn't start the tour. At about 11:10 or so, he finally tells us he's waiting on the actual guide. A few minutes later, he says the guide isn't coming and that all he can do is basically get us in the museum for self guided tours (and that we could purchase/rent an audio guide). We spent SO much time waiting around - time waiting for him to figure it out (not his fault, but the company's), time waiting to get inside, time waiting for some people to wait in around couple lines for audio guides, and then lastly he gets us through the ticket gates for us to finally start on our own after 12. So we waited for an hour and a half from arrival to museum entrance. Also, we never actually got a ticket, which meant we couldn't exit any exhibits or we wouldn't be able to get in anywhere else. The company, city wonders, offered partial refunds, but not what they should have. At most, we should have paid for a regular museum entrance ticket since that's all we got. We didn't get a guide and we basically didn't skip lines with all the waiting, yet the company is still charging us almost double regular ticket prices. I have questioned it but haven't heard back from City wonders yet. All in all, just understand what you are booking when/if you book this. Yes, you may have a great experience with no problems, but this is booked through a third party so if there are issues, you're kinda stuck.

Contrary to what others say, this tour isn't worth the time or money. It focuses on the building history, and then their collection of home furnishings, sculptures, and historic artifacts - with almost no emphasis on paintings (only the last 15 minutes of a 3 hour tour).

But what's worse is the false advertising: You do NOT get an admission ticket, which means you cannot roam at will after the tour. We were outraged, because the museum is divided into different parts and you need a ticket for each. At the end we thought we could at least go see the Rembrandt, Vermeer, Ruben snd Monets we came there to see, but they were on a floor we didn't have a ticket to. No amount of pleading with the ticket office helped - they said our guide should have given us admission tickets. No one would want to go to this huge museum without the possibility of spending some quality time with the things they are particularly interested in. The fact that our guide couldn't give us our own tickets suggests some kind of scam, though I can't understand what.

Be warned. Do not book with city wonder. They contract out their guides and most of the time they do not show up. Do not assume previous complaints of last minute guide cancellations and missing guides are a one off: they occur OFTEN. Do not expect a refund either. Go with another company that has their own in-house guides. If they knew there was issues they should notify you WELL in advance for you to make changes. Not on the day of.

Now onto the experience:

Our tour was booked for 9:00am in the morning but only one tour guide showed up. The one guide only brought enough radios for 25 people…there were 50 people waiting around. The city wonder representative stood around and did nothing about the issue. He kept on saying to “call his company for a refund”. He didn’t try to find more radios or try to find other guides. He was completely and utterly useless. His statement was frankly insulting given that the other 25 people all travelled thousands of miles to learn more about this wonderful museum.

The only solution the group came up with after waiting around for 30 minutes was to have the group with no radios stand further away from the guide while those with the headset stand closer. This solution failed since some hallways are small and narrow…and incredibly busy. Trying to get close is a chore and even up close…without a headset hearing the guide is completely impossible. By the end of the tour most of those without the headset had left in frustration…I completely understand this.

To conclude: you have travelled thousands and thousands of miles to see the famed museum only to have your tour become a total mess that would literally ruin this unique and once-in-lifetime experience. Do not risk going with this company. Take a look at the many other tour companies with their own guides. Learn from my mistake. Please.

Called night before right at office closing hours and said cancelled due to emergency. Read other comments that said same thing happened to them with the same exact wording - don't book with City Wonders Ltd. Obviously they cancel at last minute regularly. Suggest instead you download for free the Rick Steves Audio Europe app and use its "The Louvre" audio tour - gives you all the same highlights and descriptions for free and buy your tickets in advance from the Louvre directly for a lot less money.

Got a full refund but that's not the point. Luckily had time to schedule my own visit.

To pay for this guided tour was well worth the added expense as we were able to see all of the main attractions as quickly as possible. Our tour started early so we missed the crowds for most of it. Our guide Catherine was so knowledgeable and we learnt the history and possible reasons behind some of the awesome art and artists. All in all
I would highly recommend this tour.

Very chaotic system for checking in with tour. Bit of a free for all. Also had to wait while people that had just turned up registered and paid. Tour guide was good although we could only access part of the museum as the President had shut off a section to hold a memorial service. Consequently we felt paying the full amount was a waste of money. Not the tour companies fault but annoying nevertheless. Too much waiting around for people on the tour... wouldn't book this kind of tour again.

Arrived well before meet up time. Tour guide never showed up. They sent some kid to inform us, then we had to wait in regular lines to get in which took nearly an hour and then the kid tells us to purchase headsets to go in because there was no guide. He then takes a picture of my booking and informs all of us we will be getting reimbursed. I later get an unreal email from "City Wonders" which is the company providing the service that they do not issue refunds for missed appointments. HELLO they missed the appointment not us, I then replied to the email and its been days with no response or reimbursement!

We did the first tour in the morning, which I would recommend, as it gets so very crowded in the museum as the day goes on. The tour was a lovely way to see several important pieces of art and get a brief education on each; as well as more general knowledge about art and how/when they fit in to the changes happening across time. Our tour guide, Addie (sp?) was wonderful… knowledgeable and engaging. It is an overwhelming museum and the tour really helped to get a handle on it without walking around aimlessly

I’m only posting this because Trip Advisor sent me a text message asking me to.

We arrived at the meeting point well ahead of the advised time. We hung around only for a tour guide to turn up to advise us that the tour had been cancelled. So

You let us hang around whilst the regular queues built up;

You can send me a text message asking me for a review but you can’t send me a text message telling me the tour I booked weeks ago was cancelled?

Poor poor poor

Max did a great job of showing us the key areas of the Louvre in the 3 hours we were scheduled . He thoughtfully grounded our group in where we were within the building to help keep perspective. He did a great job of selecting key pieces of artwork to story tell to make the tour more engaging. And he kept it light hearted for those that may not have his Artistic background and knowledge- highly recommend this tour and this guide.

It was a crowded day at the Louvre but our guide Anna made sure we hit all the highlights of Louvre ensuring we spent enough time admiring the three main ladies of Louvre. She also ensured that we got enough information on some of the other painters exhibits and explained their techniques in layman terms.

Overall a good guided tour of Louvre.

Tip;
Block some additional time to stroll through the attached gardens (weather permitting).

I literally have never left a tour review, but Adam was able to make a massive and intimidating collection seem straightforward for an art novice so I had no choice but to let you know. If you think you need to wander the Louvre alone because the tours all look so expensive - do not pass go, sign up for this affordable tour, and hope you get Adam as your guide. He is funny, informative, and engaging to people of all backgrounds and expertise. It is not often you get a Ph.D. to spend an afternoon walking around with you who is thrilled to share some of their interpretative thoughts not just on the most famous collections, but also on why, when, and how art has evolved over the past several millenia. A MUST do to be sure and something that made a bucket list item somehow exceed expectations!

This was the worst run tour I have ever paid for. I received one email confirming my booking and the time to be there. I received nothing further. No additional emails stating where to meet, as my 3 other guided tour companies did during this trip. We arrived in time and searched for the tour company to no avail. To make it worse, I had to pay a second time to enter the museum so that my family would not miss the entire museum.

Now they are refusing o give me a refund. The tour was operated by CITY WONDERS LTD. Buyer beware they are clearly not running an organized company and I would stay away from trip advisor as well since they are allowing this. Don’t take a chance on this company ruining any part of your groups trip. There are lots of other companies to choose from . This tour cost $316 USD so it was not inexpensive.

We just today used Headout bookings and a company called Paris Trips today for a personal tour of the Versailles and everything ran smoothly. The booking email was very clear about where to meet and all other details.

Unfortunately this experience was a series of mishaps. On the day of our original tour we got so lost, thought we had arrived way early, just to realize we were at the wrong place. A nice street vendor and a metro ride later we got there to have missed our group. The company graciously rebooked us (which was above/beyond) for the following day. We were sure to be at the right location, early and then the tour guide was a no show! A rep from the local tour company showed up and said our guide was sick and he would let us in to the museum, which was about 20 minutes after the time on our tickets. There was no guise, no narrative, no help. If we wanted that we had to buy the self-guided device for €10 each, out of our pockets. Since our time was limited we did. It so this. Trip advisor did help facilitate a partial refund. The museum is huge and overwhelming. Give yourself lots of time and have a plan ahead of time to know what you want to see.

We arrived for an 11am 2 hour tour of the Louvre only to discover our tour guide had cancelled that morning. We were not notified until we arrived. To say we were disappointed was an understatement. We were only in Paris for 1.5 days and this was supposed to be the highlight of our trip (the only thing my 14 yr old son asked to do whilst we were in Paris was see the Mona Lisa). Tour guides get ill, I do appreciate that, but to not have a back up in place was unacceptable. The representatives from the tour company were good and reassured us we’d get a full refund. The queues for tickets were already 1-2 hours long, plus it was 30+ degrees with no shade, so we decided not to queue for tickets and so missed out on the whole Louvre experience sadly.

We had a great time Christina was very knowledgeable and ensured we skipped the line with no difficulties. She gave us a brief history of the sculptures and the artist who made them and spoke at length in regards to the most popular paintings in the museum. The tour was a great event that we highly recommend to everyone looking for a bit of art and history.

The tour was wonderful, the guide Florence knew so much information about the paintings we stopped at. It was definitely a great idea for our first visit to the Louvre.

The only thing that stopped it from being five stars was that there was a lot of white noise from Florence's microphone which made it quite hard to hear her at times. Don't think it was her fault, just the equipment. I still think it was worth every penny getting a guided tour through the most beautiful museum in the world.

City Wonders cancelled the Louvre tour last minute (less than 24 hours) with no explanation or courtesy email. Tickets on Louvre site were all sold out by that time hence couldn’t visit the Louvre at all. Next day morning I left Paris. It is very unprofessional and disrespectful to treat customers like this.

Zero communication from the group on where to meet beforehand. It turns out this isn’t an authorized tour group per the museum staff and we had to buy tickets inside and do our own tour. Don’t waste your time with these jokers.

Do not book this tour. Our City Wonders tour guide never showed up. We had an 11am tour scheduled and we were there 20 minutes early along with 6 other people scheduled for the same tour. After waiting a while past the supposed 11am start time we called and were told our guide called in sick and there were no other tours available that day or any other of the days we were going to be in Paris. We ended up going into the Louvre ourselves after securing tickets and waiting 2 hours.

There were also other people there that had scheduled earlier times for the same tour (10am and 10:30am) and their guides never showed up either. They had waited from before 10am to after 11am for their scheduled tours. All in all City Wonders left several people from several different tour times with no guide and no recourse, other than to wait in the line to go into the Louvre on their own.

Very informational and great way to see the well known pieces of the museum. The guide was very knowledgeable but probably spent a little too much time talking about the artwork of lesser known pieces for what our family enjoys. You will be with a decent sized group and the museum is BUSY but they provide headphones to hear the guide and the guide has a flag to easily follow. The meeting place was easy to find.

We showed up 15 minutes early to the designated meeting area as per the ticket instructions. Saw the tour guide with company logo and went to check in. He did not have us on his list so he suggested we wait for the next tour guide. We did so and she also did not have us on her list and suggested to wait to see if another tour guide came. None did and it was 5 minutes after we were supposed to leave. I called the customer service number and their only offer was 50% off next time. Was 0 help and only suggested we were not on time. Refused a refund and said we could wait there for the next tour that someone didn't show up for and be fit in that group or send an email for them to investigate. Main reason I am upset is we aren't the only ones in this situation!! We stayed there trying to resolve this and join and tour and 30 min later there was a mother and daughter doing the same. The only thing we can think of was a tour guide didn't show up and the company didn't communicate it to its customers. Then on top of it the phone call was absolutely useless even though they looked up our reservation in their system by our email.

From the description of the tour, I was expecting an art historian to take us through the Louvre. However, throughout the tour I was only having these from the guide:

"You can see, the artwork is very old, it is from 13th century it is remarkable"
"Look here, you can see the artwork is beautiful"
"This artwork is a masterpiece, you can see it is beautifully made"

So, I guess I could just do it as well why pay for a guide?
And througout the tour the guide was talking with a very low voice, ( she was wearing a face mask, maybe not feeling well? or the earphone was not good? I asked to change once it was still the same)

The Louvre is so huge and the amount of walking+talking could be demanding for some people. Life is hard these days, I appreciate people who are trying hard. I would give the guide 4 or 5 stars for her trying, especially she seemed sick that day because she was wearing a face mask all the time. However, in regards of the informativeness of this particular tour, I must deduct a few stars.

The Louvre is simply amazing. Besides the bucket list items such as the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo, there are so many other must see items. One of my favorites was the actual castle wall from when the Louvre was a fortress. Our guide Marta was great…knowledgeable, friendly and helpful. The Louvre is so huge you could spend weeks trying to see everything so having a guide was extremely helpful and skipping the line is a must.

This was our first time to the Louvre and this tour did not disappoint. The meeting point was easy to find and the check-in person was also very easy to find. Addy was our tour guide and she was extremely knowledgeable and provided great commentary on the Louvre and hit the key pieces throughout the museum in the 2+ hour tour and even stayed longer for those who wanted/were able to keep going. Addy also did a nice job of blending in humor with the historical backgrounds and even descriptions on the type of art represented and historical significance. Highly recommend the tour and Addy!

The only upside of this tour was to skip the entry line. There is no tour of Monalisa since there’s a huge line so the guide just tells some stories about Monalisa Outside the room and ends the tour. The tour started half an hour late and a little disorganized. Overall I think the money is not worth it since we paid close to $300 for four of us.

Appalling! Will be applying for a refund.
We met at 11 at the meet point and were encouraged to buy drinks first which was extremely fortunate as we then spent the next hour and a quarter either waiting trying to get in (our guide did not have the correct ticket) or racing so quickly through areas of the Louvre - up and down stairs, being turned away from some areas as she had no idea where she was supposed to go. All with no commentary.
Someone finally stopped her and confronted her and she admitted it was her first time and nearly burst into tears. A couple of people gave their earpieces back and left the tour. We were all hot, exhausted and fed up.
She finally found the greek antiquities after asking for directions and we eventually had a 60 minute tour of these and several paintings including The Mona Lisa.
There was NO queue jumping and plenty of waiting in line. DO NOT PURCHASE THIS TOUR.

This was PERFECT. The guide was so knowledgeable about the Louvre, the history of the building and the surrounding area, and the history of the collection. She was organized and efficient with her time. I especially loved that the tour included radio earpieces because the museum was so crowded and sometimes loud, but we could hear her easily. She showed us the highlights, so that taking the tour in the morning was perfect, because afterwards we could just stay in the museum and see the rest of the museum. The line to get tickets was so long but this tour skipped through all that. We literally went directly into the museum, easily!

That was my third time to the Louvre and first with a guide - it is well worth it to have a guide. Our guide was very knowledgeable and given the size and crowds at the museum, a smaller group wouldn’t have made much of a difference. I would recommend this tour. My 13 year old son determined he does not like art museums but my 11 year old daughter loved the tour and didn’t want to leave early, even when we needed to rush to our next activity.

I had the most wonderful tour with Claire Cooper. She was incredibly knowledgeable and friendly. Highly recommend this tour. The Louvre would have been SO overwhelming had I gone alone. The place was very crowded due to school being out for the fall break, but she navigated us through those crowds with patience and true finesse.

She took time to not only show us the main attractions, but a ton of stuff I may never have found on my own. Her tour was not cookie-cutter - it was full of interesting tidbits about the pieces and great back stories. I especially loved her explanations of the evolution of the paintings, from the more churchy era down to the impressionists.

Finding out about a lot of paintings that were initially hated but now adored (such as the Raft of the Medusa) and the hidden “lies” like Napoleon’s mother painted into the coronation when she was in fact quite mad and didn’t attend - things like that were a real treat. The best part for me was a tie between the Mesopotamian sculptures and Napoleon’s apartments.

In short, it was a fantastic tour and if you’re waffling, just do it. Worth every penny. I would love to tour with Claire again and if we have enough time on this trip we will be trying to go with her to Orsay as well.

Thank you again Claire!

Our guide Junko Endo was excellent. We have done five other such tours in Italy this year, and in stark contrast,Junko’s comments were brief and informative. She only stayed at each highlight for the appropriate time, kept a brisk pace & I think we covered a lot more ground than is usual in such tours. As expected there were two queues of a 100 each for the Mona Lisa, but other areas were not too crowded.

The experience and the guide themselves were great - we skipped the lines, went to see the most parts of the museum to get a sense of what is where.
But organization can be better- we were sent to stand by one tree, then a different tree, not readyvwith the headphones- needed few more and new batteries. Essentially we left meeting place 30 min after scheduled time.
The group was too big for the fact how crowded the museum is and people had hard time follow and not getting lost.

We showed up at the meeting place early. The trip guide help up a little yellow flag with City tours on it but left before we could reach her through the crowd. We called City Wonders and they said they'd call her and we could catch up with the tour. They then said the guide didn't pick up her phone and they would not let us take a later tour or provide a refund. Very disappointing and very expensive.

The Louvre Tour and tour guide was exceptional. The knowledge our guide was able to provide was incredible and we learned a lot more from utilizing this service than if we merely bought entry tickets and wondered through the museum on our own. I would highly recommend as there is so much to absorb in the Louvre beyond just the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo.

We had booked the Louvre 9:00am tour for this morning. One of the two guides that was supposed to be there did not show up. There were 50 people in total and each guide was supposed to take 25 people. The 25 people who were assigned to the guide who did not show up were not provided with head sets. The person from City Wonders who met us at the meeting point said there was nothing he could do about it. He could not reach the company. In the end, the entire group of 50 people followed the one tour guide for the tour. However, given how incredibly busy the Louvre is and with such a large group, those of us without head sets had a hard time hearing the guide unless you stayed very close which was difficult at times given how busy the Louvre is.

It is very disappointing as we booked a guided tour for a reason. Other wise we could’ve just gone into the Louvre ourselves. We had done other guided tours before with other companies to see the Uffizi Gallery in Florence and really enjoyed it and was really looking forward to this tour of the Louvre.

I emailed City Wonders and have not heard from them yet. Their chat also never works. They have not offered any compensation so far.

It seems like from other recent reviews that this has been happening quite frequently with guides not showing up/tours being cancelled.

Despite the one tour guide who showed up today being very good, I won’t be booking with City Wonders again. This whole experience really ruined the visit.

After booking with this company several months in advance for our group of four (2 adults and two teens), City Tours canceled our tour based on their claim that the tour guide was ill. Because this was the week before Easter, there were no tickets available to tour independently — and, although City Tours received full payment many months in advance for our tour, they did not have tickets for our party. 3 of our attendees had never been to Paris. Needless to say, this failure was beyond disappointing.

We showed up on time and we were informed that we would not have a guide as they decided not to show up. Being how large the Louvre is, a guide is essential to make the most out of your time. I learned from another tour, that this particular operator no longer compensates their guides adequately so they book tours that they cannot guarantee staff for. DO NOT book with them.

Our amazing tour guide, Claire, made the experience that much better. Her knowledge and side stories were stellar. I would highly recommend City Wonders Tours to anyone visiting the Louvre, and hope that you get Claire as your guide.

This tour was the highlight of our visit to Paris. The Louvre is a maze if you don’t have an excellent guide. Our guide showed us all the best highlights in just a few hours and had so much wonderful knowledge of the works of art as well as of the museum’s history. We had a magical experience and would highly recommend this tour to anyone wanting to see a LOT in a small amount of time.

Venus de Milo was awesome and our guide very informative. Museum was unbelievably crowded so some things like the Mona Lisa you couldn’t get close to without waiting an hour or more. All in all a once in a lifetime experiences with a wonderful tour company

Addie, our tour guide was great. She talked a lot about what she liked about each piece we stopped at and important points to note. She was extremely knowledgeable and shared her knowledge so that we understood the painting or sculpture. I got so much more out of the tour than I would have if I had just walked in by myself.

About 2 hours into the tour, Addie did a check on whether we would like to see two more pieces or if the group was tired out. Most of us opted to continue -- so glad we did!

Additionally, I appreciated the detailed instructions on the website about where the meeting place was and what to look for. A City Wonders rep was in the exact spot.

Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and passionate about the art she was discussing, yet she was easy-going and approachable. With her guidance, little time was wasted and we got to see many important pieces of art and appreciate them better because of the context she provided. I would take another tour with this guide.

At the beginning of the day, there were issues and delays that had nothing to do with the guide. The folks setting up didn’t have the microphone and other equipment ready. When the guide finally got the microphone, it didn’t work, so she had to borrow one from someone and figure out a solution on her own. Apart from the first 10-15 minutes, I’d recommend this tour. Once the tour ends, you can stay in the museum to continue to explore on your own.

The Louvre was so packed with people that even with getting access via the guide to skip the queues, it was a bit difficult to keep up with the guide. Our guide was clearly very knowledgeable and I can’t and don’t fault her at all but don’t think that this gets over the fundamental issue with the Louvre. There are SO many people that I think a guided tour is difficult to enjoy fully. As I said, it was great to get entry without too many queues but otherwise it was a bit of a whistle stop tour. I really can’t think of a way around this but just be prepared for the crowds!

We thought this was an excellent tour (I'm shocked to see so many recent reviews saying the tours were canceled with no warning!). It was a little bigger than I expected (maybe 20 people) but the guide was extremely knowledgable, very engaging, and passionate about the subject matter. She did a good job corraling everyone as it was quite busy that day and managed to lead us through quite a number of pieces. I was an art history major, and seeing so many of the artworks I studied made this a highlight of our trip. Just note "skip the line" just means no waiting to buy tickets and while you get to see the Mona Lisa, there isn't time to stand in the line to get up close to it for good pictures.

When you're visiting the Louvre in Paris - the largest museum in the world and you unfortunately only have a few hours of your trip available for the experience and not days, you start looking for the most efficient way to do this. But you're already leaning towards disappointment whilst making a compromise and picking out just the iconic exhibits you can catch a glimpse of during your visit. However, that's all before City Wonders and Adam came into the picture!

Adam had done his homework, he knew each of us in the group by our name and where we were from. He introduced everybody and made sure he created an environment for the group to have a fun experience with what was to come with his sense of humour. Adam is highly qualified academically for a tour guide, he has a PHD in Nuclear Physics and he's also worked at the Louvre on some of the exhibits on our tour.

Adam was funny, engaging, and whipsmart! He seamless tied together our entire experience through stories that were relatable and engaging. It wasn't just a tour of the art - but he was able to speak to history, culture, religion, science... just an enriching experience and a new way of looking at art and the reason behind the iconic exhibits we saw. If you're planning to visit the Louvre, City Wonders and Team Adam is really the only way to do it!! Highly highly recommend.

City Wonders had no guide available but didn't tell us until after we waited outside with the group for almost 30 minutes and the "coordinator" took us inside the Louvre to the lower level mall. It was a complete fiasco from start to finish. The company should have canceled and refunded the money. If I could give them a 0 rating, I would. Since it was our last day in Paris, we weren't able to schedule for a later day, but if City Wonders let us know ahead of time, we might have been able to book a different guided tour. It was incredibly disappointing and it wasn't an isolated incident. Don't roll the dice with this company, book with a different vendor.

My husband booked this tour in order to skip the line. There was a group of 25 people and the guide took us to see the highlights, starting with the Mona Lisa, which was a bit crowded and unorganized as far as movement for taking photos. The rest of the museum was fine to walk through and see everything. Our tour guide Leah was very knowledgeable and I was able to get some nice souvenir gifts at their boutique. Lots of shopping opportunities here! Great experience!!

A tour is all about the guide and ours was very dry and uninspiring. The Louvre is huge when you only have 2.5 hours you are looking for highlights and good stories of the top items. Our first stop at the entrance was a 20 minute talk about the statues that was very dry. We were very disappointed in the tour which resulted in the Louvre being our least favorite thing we saw.

This tour was a split review for my family. Our family of 3 liked and disliked different things. For a couple of us, the tour moved too slow. The tour guide chose to give a deep history into a few pieces instead of a quick history of several. I felt like we could have covered more pieces than we did. He did tell us at the beginning that we would only cover 15% of the Louvre and that we could leave the tour at anytime, just let him know. So maybe its on us for not doing that. I also feel like we could have started the tour at 8:30-8:45 instead of 9 because he took some (needed) time to discuss the plan of what we will do that day, get us inside the main area, let us use the restroom, etc. Our tour started at 9am, but we weren't inside the Louvre until 9:40. We also ended our tour with the Mona Lisa. I understand why he did this as he stated some might have already seen it and not care but that was a big reason we chose this tour. So I was very concerned we'd be in line for an hour if we didn't go see her until 11:45. However, it was only about a 15-20 min wait at 11:43 when we finally got in the room. And our experience may have been different had we had a different guide. For us it was a mix bag. We enjoyed parts of it but I feel like there was too much time spent on each piece. I think we could have moved thru more peices a bit faster. Instead of 15 min on each piece, spend 10 and we can bring in 5 more peices. For some it may not be enough time spent on each piece so it all about what you are wanting to get our of your tour.

This tour was the highlight of our anniversary trip to Paris. After a little bit of a delayed start after getting the microphone & headsets right … we set off through the crowds right to the top of the queue - our guide Severie (sp?) was an art graduate and had an incredible insight to bring to our life the detail of the main highlights. The almost 3 hour tour past by in a flash - it was just wonderful. I will never forget this visit. ❤️🇫🇷

We had a fantastic tour with KENNY ! He was outstanding. Truly loved the experience, had a wonderful time discovering rooms, history, and special collections we would have missed, and still seeing the highlights we knew to find. Even with the most known sculptures and paintings, the added insight Kenny provided was truly wonderful.

BONUS: For parents with small children, this is an added plus. Having a tour that led us around meant more eyes on our young son, a large group he could watch out for (he began to recognize people in our group), and just a better overall experience. We had a destination with each stop, my husband and I could enjoy a bit more, and our children got a much better experience than we could have provided. Wholeheartedly recommend. And special thanks to Kenny for his excellent organization and presentation.

Do NOT use this guide / tour operator!

We were booked in for the skip the line and private family tour of Le Louvre for 6 people.

They do not provide any notice and cancel when you arrive at the meeting point after having taken your money in advance. This was my family and many other families experience who turned up on time to find they had cancelled all tours for the Louvre. There were c 60 people they cancelled on saying that the guide called in to say that they were not in that day. This is not believable given this would have meant 10 guides had all called in not to work that day!

They did not even have the tickets in hand to give to bookers to go in to the museum themselves. By which point all tickets were sold out online!
Book direct with the museum and do not use this business as their service is appalling.

Signed for an English speaking guide but our guide spoke with a heavy accent and was hard for him to find the right words at times. The tour started late and the flow seemed chaotic and disorganized. Instructions to stay together before entrance should have been given in order to avoid delays entering the check points. We also kept losing track of the guide because his flag was down most of the time. We ended up parting ways early in order to see as much as possible on our own. To the guide’s credit, he tried his best and was very kind, accommodating and sweet. Also, thank you for accommodating us on a different day when we missed our original tour time.

The title says "skip the line" but it is much more. The Louvre is huge and crowded and it can get overwhelming. Our guide Anna took us to all the important pieces directly and gave us a lot of information about the art. We could easily hear her due to the headsets we received. Sure, anyone can visit a museum on their own, but doing it with a guide is a much more efficient use of your time.

Skipping the line was the best part of this tour. The guide was informative but the whole tour felt very rushed. Several members of our group decided to venture off on their own because the tour guide gave us no time at all to admire the artwork. Maybe a private tour would be better…

The tour guide never showed and the person who carried our tickets spoke little English. All this person did was make us lose 30 minutes of the day and directed us to rent headsets since the tour guide would not be helping us. He then left after we were allowed entry. Many people asked him questions and he could not answer most all.

Our tour guide went above and beyond for us as our children were late to the meeting point. My husband opted not to go on the tour so he could look for them. He found them and on notifying our tour guide she asked our group if they would mind if she went out side to retrieve them. She then amongst serious crowds went out, found them so they could join the tour. At this point we were already inside through security at the group meeting point. We were all so grateful. Not only did we not ‘waste’ 3 guided tour payments by them nonattending but more importantly our Australian children were able to join the tour of the Louvre and all that it entailed. We all cannot thank her enough. The tour itself was educational, interactive and well worth time, effort and money.

Our guide Flora did an outstanding job. She was very knowledgeable about the Louvre, art, and what we could expect. My mother was with us and uses a cane to walk and Flora was very cognizant of that and made sure to guide her around stairs where possible and found places she could sit when we were admiring the art. When the Louvre got busy Flora did a great job keeping the group together. Not knowing a great deal about art it was great to experience the Louvre with a guided tour and you can also stay afterwards to see even more.

Our guide was Addi, and she was very knowledgeable about art history and spoke to us in detail about the significance of the works of art that we saw - paintings and sculptures. I learned a lot about the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, the Nike, and several other landmark pieces. I recommend this tour as a good way of seeing the important things and learning about them.

I visited Louvre at least 5 times on my own before but I was glad I took the 3 hour tour with Violette. I learnt so much more with her. She is an amazing guide, very enthusiastic and super knowledgeable about everything she talks about. 3 hours just flew by and I am hoping I will be back to Paris soon to do more tours with her. She is very passionate about history and art, and makes tour very fun and engaging. I usually get upset leaving museums like Louvre: too big to handle on your own and after hours you feel like you know less than before. The tour helped me feel more accomplished: efficient and I am sure I will remember things I saw. Highly recommend Violette with CW.

We signed up for this tour on the advice of friends who had been on it and had a great experience. So glad we did!

Our guide, Christina, was simply outstanding. She brought the artwork to life, sharing the history, characters and context of what the piece represented to the artist and their historical audience.

We also appreciated that Christina curated our time together to talk in more depth about special things at the Louvre we likely would not have noticed on our own. There is so much to see, and having her insight and expertise made all the difference in our experience.

Definitely recommend!

Had an absolutely wonderful tour with Violet. There’s a different joy to seeing the museum with someone who is passionate and knowledgeable about history and art—Violet was that for us. Even after visiting the Louvre several times, I still learned so many new things. Absolutely recommend booking a tour—goes way above and beyond what an audio tour can provide. Thanks so much Violet!

Absolutely amazing tour and necessary. It would be impossible to see everything in the Louvre in a day and this tour made it possible to see the highlights. The last tour was less of a line to see the Mona Lisa but if I were to book again I would take an earlier tour so you can go explore the Egypt exhibit and Mesopotamia. That was my bad thinking I would be able to see that on this tour - which would be impossible. So I suggest book an early time-spot and then stay after the tour to check out those can’t miss exhibits. Be warned, the Louvre is a palace and it will be information overload (in a good way) with all the stuff you can see!

We mainly paid for the skip-the line-part and was impressed with how quickly we were able to enter. Kenny was very knowledgeable and we got to see the highlights of the museum collection during our visit. He didn’t really leave time for questions unfortunately. We were overall impressed with our visit!

absolutely terrible, tour guide didn’t show up because he was sick so many of us showed up with no tour guide. rather than messaging us before we made our way there they just tell us when he doesn’t show up??? they gave us two options, a full refund or they would get us into the museum and give us a partial refund and we just have a map to look around. so i took that option. when i try to get into the museum the women said the ticket was invalid so u had to leave. very disappointed. not only did this waist much of my time and leave me upset because i wanted to see the mona lisa but they only gave me a partial refund although i couldn’t get in. could not recommend less!!!

Natalia was great. She knew so much and you could tell she really enjoyed talking about the pieces we saw. She was not just spewing a script. She had passion. Set your expectations right and you will have a great time .... The Louvre is busy. Think Boxing Day shopping. This tour was 3 hours of walking. Don't wear heels or go to Versaille first and then be too tired to enjoy the museum! There are more things to see than you could possibly get to if you went every day for a week. So the guide will take you to the 2 most famous pieces (Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo) and will take you through a path that he/she finds inspirational. If there are specific things you want to see, don't sign up for a guided tour. Or go see them after the tour ends and you can roam freely. You will hear the guide though ear buds. This can be a bit muffled because the museum is so busy. Loved it. Read the instructions carefully about where to meet (for us it was under the Arch du Carousel). We made reservations for Cafe Marly before the tour! Hope you enjoy!

Tour guide moved really quickly through the interesting sections with little to no explanation, then spent almost an hour talking about 2 paintings.
She also spoke very quickly and her accent was too thick to understand a lot of what was said.
She didn't seem to know much about anything that wasn't a painting also, and a few times would contradict the information given by the plaques.

Easy to find the meeting spot and our guide Anna was excellent. Once inside, there was a secure spot to store items if needed and use the bathrooms before the tour started. Inside it is very busy but she was holding a small raised flag so that we would be able to keep sight of her. Having the individual ear pieces was perfect as we could easily hear everything she was saying even though it was quite crowded. I would definitely recommend this tour.

Adi our tour guide was very knowledgeable and engaging during the guide. She was funny made the tour interesting. Although the lines were too long and the museum overcrowded, she was able to maneuver her way to avoid us clashing with the large crowds and other groups of tourist.

Our tour guide Martha was awesome. Very personable and informative. There is no way anyone can see the Louvre in a day so use this service to optimize your time. Skip the lines and get the highlights in 2 hours. After that you can still explore on your own. The tour itself was well paced and having Martha to guide us was a great choice!!!! Highly recommended!!!

We experienced a rocky start with City Wonders who was wondering about the proposer start time. Lost an hour of doing something else…sleeping perhaps, but no matter; we connected with Florence and the tour was immediately on. She was engaging and extremely knowledgeable about the Art we were seeing. Start early is my suggestion. Florence took us all over. Explained what we’re doing, where we were in time, who the key players were and how this integrated into the grand historical arc covered by the 5,000 years or so of history encompassed by the collections. We were made aware of recurring elements and the historical, mythological and religious themes that served as inspiration for the interconnect story of the human species. Very well done. Would go back. Have to go back. Saw an enormous amount of art, but only a fraction of what is on offer at the Louvre.
.

This tour allowed us to skip the line, saving valuable time during our vacation. But more importantly we got an extremely knowledgeable guide who got us to many of the most significant pieces of art in 2.5 hours on a very busy day. His commentary was excellent and it was delivered through a microphone to our handheld audio receivers so we could easily hear him. I learned a lot and would definitely recommend this experience.

It was our first time visiting the Louvre so we decided to book a tour as we'd heard it can be overwhelming. Our guide Nancy was great, really engaging and informative, all 6 of us in the family really enjoyed the tour. We managed to see everything we wanted to and learned a lot too, and are keen to visit again in the future on our own!

The Louvre is sn amazing building that could be an event on uts iwn Andrea was very knowledgeable and had an interesting approach to the tour. He focused on less well known facts and perspectives and worked to keep us involved. Less positive was the group was more people than I expected and Andrea's microphone kept getting muffled.

This was well worth every penny!! The skip the line pass saved us hours of waiting in line. The tour guide was super knowledgeable and entertaining. He hit the highlights and gave such great information about all the exhibits he took us too. The Louvre can definitely be overwhelming for first-timers, and our tour guide made it such a great experience. After the tour was over, he gave us tips for other exhibits and information on other things to do within the Louvre!

Very disappointing.

Upon entering the Louvre with our guide, Severine, and our group, we stopped first for a bathroom break. When we went back to meet the group, they had gone. We had no way to meet up with them; no knowledge of the route they were going, no way to contact them and it was crowded with long lines of people to go anywhere.
We had to leave the Louvre and luckily saw the people outside who were organizing the tour groups we had been assigned to. They were able to add us to another guide and group that would be beginning shortly.

Unbelievably, and unfortunately, halfway through that tour, maybe more, this guide became ill, had to lay on the floor and began vomiting. I felt so badly for her. She kept wanting to continue giving the tour but she was not physically able to do so.
We had to leave without having seen the Mona Lisa.

The name of the tour group was City Wonders.

Scott

Our tour guide was simply fantastic! She was engaging, funny, incredibly knowledgeable, and passionate about the subject matter. For the life of me, I cannot remember her name as we completed so many tours during our short stay in Paris! But I am happy to describe her to give her some kudos… we completed the English speaking tour at 2:30pm on 7/27/22. Our guide was British, blonde, and full of excitement. I would second this tour in a heartbeat to better absorb my surroundings and the information provided! Thank you for a great experience.

Our group (8)showed up excited for our tour of the Louvre. With vague instructions on meeting point we finally found our coordinator who advised our guide called out sick and there was no back up plan. No replacement guide, no ability to join another tour or reschedule. Our option was to go in unaccompanied or leave. Very disappointed is an understatement and now they want to give us partial refund which is unacceptable.

We went Thursday last week and it was very crowded, the museum opened a little later than usual and that's probably why it was more crowded. We took the first tour to start at 9 when the museum opens so we didn't have to deal with so many people but no luck there. It was hot, but passable and the tour was good, not great, nut good, the guide was good and knowledgeable, for an art history student, but for me was a little boring. I still recommend to get a tour, so you don't waste to much time looking for anything. City Wonders was good.

Myself and 23 others were waiting by the Carousel 15 minutes early as requested. At 11 when the tour was due to start, an incredibly last minute substitute turned up and told us our guide had called in sick! The tour guide company could have messaged us before we all arrived so as to not waste our time waiting under the hot sun. She was also not a guide but she offered us a partial or full refund. We took the partial refund and were allowed to skip the line into the Louvre, however we ended up going around ourselves! Don’t waste your money booking for a guided tour unless you want to take the risk. We are still waiting for our refund.

It was very difficult to find the meeting location with the directions provided. I called for assistance which really did not help much. I really thought that we would have to cancel the event. The skinny is that you have to go through the entry gate of the Lourve to see the chariot sculpture. I was misguided in thinking the meeting place was outside of the Louvre. Once we found the location there was still a bit of drama as someone else had tried to take our place but the staff handled it professionally. Annalise our guide was very knowledgeable and the tour was great! The art is superb and everyone should take this tour but Be aware that this is a lot of walking in close and crowded spaces.

Got lost showed up
Late and City Wonders would not let us join another group even though the day before on a City Wonders tour to the Eiffel the guide welcomed other people who had missed their time and let them join our group. Very unfair to just take our money and say “Sorry”. Even though we had used them on three tours that we week they didn’t care to help.
They should put in bold type on departures times that if you show up late that you forfeit you money with no exceptions.

Our guide Sylvie was amazing!! She was knowledgeable, passionate and kept the group entertained as she pointed out the highlights of the Louvre. We all received so much information and she answered all of our questions. Highly recommend this! It was totally worth the time and money!

Gregory, our tour guide was amazing. He was very informed, funny and showed us the best of Louvre. He gets 5 stars.
We booked though Trip Advisor for Musee D’Orsay for the next day and the company changed the time last minute by 3 hours. Nightmare for our plans. The company gets 1 star!

Very efficient and informative tour. Louvre is so huge that it is great to have a guide and a small group is the way to go. Also, you need not worry about staying longer, you are free to explore all you want after the tour if you want. Skipping the line and being informed by a knowledgeable guide takes out the Louvre stress.

Definitely an excellent choice if you don’t want to stand in line for hours to get in. We met up outside the Louvre and had a group of about 15. We were given audio headsets which was a must since the museum was so crowded and busy. We were taken into the museum through an alternate entrance and directly to some of the highlights of the museum. We actually left early because of how crowded the museum was, but we were able to see what we wanted.

Florence was great! Got us in quickly and navigated us well through the crowds. It was nice to see the more famous pieces of artwork, in addition to some other pieces. We also got to go down to the basement which is a realistically new experience as they carved it out recently!

The Louvre is always such a magical experience being in the presence of so much art history. If you’re wondering if you should see it via a guide please do - hearing the history behind the art makes this experience!

I’d give this tour 5 out of 5. Our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable and gave us interesting information about each piece we seen in the museum. I couldn’t even tell we had been on the tour for 2 1/2 hours. Take this tour!

Wonderful tour. Oliver is an outstanding, engaging and well informed guide. He shared his insights into the museum highlight pieces and did a great job engaging with tour participants using humour. Highly recommended

Riddle: how can you go to Paris,book your tickets months in advance and still never see the Louvre, one of the most iconic places in Paris? Answer: Book with City Wonders. I am very disappointed, this is something I will probably never have an opportunity to do again, it is an experience I had been looking forward to very much and now it is gone. We had tickets for May 29th, showed up as directed at 10:45 promptly and were told that the company had cancelled all it's tours for the day. We walked the hour back to our hotel room which was very near to the Eiffel Tower so we could use the wifi to connect to the internet to try to buy some tickets but they were sold out for several days in advance and only available outside our free time left in Paris. Moreover I can see from reviews written both before and after our experience that this seems to be an ongoing problem with this tour company.Think twice before you book these tickets. We booked these tickets from Viatour to whom I would suggest that they are gravely diminishing their own reputation by promoting a company so utterly unreliable, and who as a Trip Advisor company should surely be aware of the negative reviews and who also should perhaps think twice about continuing to do business with City Wonders.And please City Wonders spare me the standard it's all because of Covid lame automated response.

Very interesting and informative guided tour through the "jungle" of the Louvre. Although it took almost 3 hours time went by so fast. Our guide (Claire from GB) did a great job! She explained everything in a very entertaining way so that everyone - even those who don't know a lot of the history of arts - could understand. Thank you, Claire!

Oliver was a tour de force on this tour in france!

Fantastic guide and the only way to see this museum. He really brought the pieces to life with his story telling and detailed art historical explanations.
Tres bien! Thank you Oliver!

Anna was a wonderful guide, she had lots of interesting history and details to share about the Louvre and the works of art she took us to see. It was a great tour and she kept our teenagers interested too. It was a great way to get the most out of the Louvre when you are only spending a few hours inside.

This was a great way to see the Louve. Our guide shared wonderful stories and details that really made the artwork come alive. Would highly recommend. The tour itself ends up being less than 3 hours due to security and COVID checks, but was still the right amount of time (especially if you’re bringing kids - our 10 & 14 yr old sons were dragging by the end).

Well worth the price. We skipped the line as advertised and spent 3 hours viewing the museum highlights. Our guide, Anisa, had an amazing depth of knowledge that she shared for each piece of work we stopped at. Really good experience.

Aug 29, 2022, first time in Paris for my husband, daughter and I. We loved the Louvre!!! Hugo was a fantastic tour guide! He was so personable, fun, and extremely knowledgeable. He provided a great deal of information on the Louvre itself and the history surrounding some of the main exhibits. Thanks again Hugo!!! (Hugo/10 was with Takewalks.com)

Our guide Max was excellent in his knowledge and appreciation for the artworks we viewed. We enjoyed the selection of artworks he chose to bring to our attention very much. His love of the Art on offer at the Louvre was very evident and he drew us into the magic of the Louvre with his enthusiasm for art appreciation. The easy access was excellent.

We booked this tour because we had not been to the Louvre before, and wanted to see the highlights without spending all day there. It was worth every penny! The Louvre is gigantic, and yes you can get a headset and go on your own, but by 12 pm the museum was a madhouse...and we were pretty tired. So I would recommend this tour most definitely. We will go again on our own, but now know where to go etc.

Highly recommend the Skip-the-Line in visiting the Louvre. It was well worth the money. Our guide was Severin and she was very knowledgeable. I visited the Louvre previously and learned a lot more this time. I was a little worried about how we would find the group in such a big area outside, but the group has it well planned.

One recommendation I would make is to have the map of the Louvre either downloaded on your phone ahead of time or try to get a map as you are entering the building. Once the tour is over, you can stay but it can be challenging to figure out where to go from there if you have no map.

Only way to see the Louvre

It is essential to have a tour guide in this enormous maze of a museum. Couldn’t have hoped for a better one than Oliver! He answered every single question in detail ( I ask a lot of questions), and added flavour and nuance. Not only was he educated (and educational) but hilarious too! Unfortunately I had a slight accident at the end of the tour, so Oliver, if you’re reading this, I’m really sorry about your trousers.

We only have a few days in Paris and really want to visit the Louvre Museum. Our tour guide was knowledgeable of the history, background it was a great introduction as well as we can quickly get to some of the well known masterpieces. Be prepared that the famous lady now has two constant queues and security guards to time how long each person can stay to take a picture. We did not get to see Venus de milo. The tour is best with adults or teenagers not recommended for families with young children.

Of course the Louvre is a must do when in Paris. However it is huge, overwhelming and incredibly crowded. I highly recommend doing the skip the lines tour. It was very efficient, the meeting location was easy to get to, and the guide was knowledgeable. Doing the tour made the Louvre manageable and we got to see the highlights of what we wanted to see despite the crowds.

It was the perfect amount of time. I don't know much about art, so I knew I needed a guide to explain and walk me through the Louvre (rather than wandering aimlessly and finding the Mona Lisa). I learned SO much and in a fun way. We met clearly, skipped the line, and in the morning, easily moved through the musem. I would recommend the morning time as it was a lot busier upon leaving in the afternoon. The ear-pieces made it very easy to wander nearby and still learn as well.

Go Team Adam! Adam is very intelligent, great at remembering names as well a great host! He is excited about the Louvre and the art and shares that spirit through the interesting details and stories throughout the museum. We had people of all ages on the tour and Adam would address everyone by name and ask questions that would engage the young tourists as well as challenge and engage the adults. We really enjoyed the Louvre and it’s thanks to our wonderful tour guide, Adam! Thank you! We learned so much and had a great time!

Best part of the trip was 100% the tour guide! Anna was so knowledgeable, fun, and engaging. We would’ve been totally lost without her. Not only did we hit all of the big spots in the museum, we also LEARNED a lot. Sometimes, learning so much about art and history can be overwhelming, but Anna had a way to make it so interesting. While our feet were definitely exhausted at the end, if you’re going to see the Lourve and want to truly appreciate and understand the overall history of the place/pieces, you should book this tour! And extra points for you if you get lucky enough to score Anna as your guide.

We loved this small group tour and experience in The Louve. Our guide Claire was very knowledgeable of the works and their history. She was personable and kind and engaging. It was nice to have someone guide you to the main attractions and some other hidden gems while inside. I recommend this tour for convenience and ease of exploring the museum.

Having Adam as a guide made this experience one of my all-time favorite travel memories. He was incredibly knowledgable and, as someone who used to work with the Louvre, clearly knew what he was talking about, but he wasn't intimidating at all. He was kind, funny, friendly, and broke down concepts in an easy to understand way. Having an expert to guide you around these masterpiece works in a maze of rooms is invaluable and I would book Adam for literally any tour he ever gives.

We enjoyed our visit to the Louvre Museum very much. Alex was very kind, funny and informative. He was patient and we were very glad to have him as our guide. The experience is one we will never forget. We highly recommend a guided tour because the museum is so very big it would be a bit difficult to see it all and figure it out on your own if you’re a first time visitor. There was So much history and culture it was a lot to take in. Our favorite parts were all the sculptures. Mona Lisa was great to see in person. But there were many other DaVinci paintings that were more lovely to see than the Mona Lisa. This tour is a Must! Enjoy!!! Thank you again Alex!!!!!!

Cannot see the Lourve in one day! Taking tours like this in pieces, focusing on sections of the museum is what you need to do! We will continue to participate in additional tours at the Louvre during our future visits to Paris! 3 hours was the perfect amount of time. City Wonders is a well organized tour company and very cognizant of the time frame chosen to ensure you see what you are expecting to see! If there is a specific piece of artwork that you want to see during your visit to the Louvre, and you want it included in your tour, make sure you search for a tour that mentions that. But, you can always remain in the Louvre to seek it out yourself after the tour concludes. Ana is amazing! Her enthusiasm really made it a great experience for us!

This was a great tour, very glad we did it! The Louvre is quite intimidating to try to navigate on your own, so it was very helpful to have our guide lead us to the most important pieces and provide insights into the interpretation. We're not huge art people, so it was good to see the highlights. Tour guide was really good, she knew what she was talking about!

This was a perfect tour! Our guide was Penelope, who has been doing this tour for more than 20 years. She knew an incredible amount of detail and history. She anticipated many of our preferences (like hitting the highlights first) and was able to answer common questions even before we asked them. Her experience also gave us the opportunity to understand how the Louvre has changed over time and helped us really appreciate was an incredible museum it is!

When my wife and I arrived at the meetup spot, we couldn’t find a tour guide holding a sign. Eventually we stumbled upon what we soon realized was our tour group and were told by a third party representative that City Wonders actually cancelled our tour (without providing a reason). They didn’t even have the class or foresight to simply send us an email that morning so that we could find other arrangements. Very frustrating and irresponsible. Will never book a tour with City Wonders again.

Great way to get an overview of this impressive, massive museum. The guide was very knowledgeable about the works and history and the tour was a good way to help navigate the museum and hit the highlights. Starts off a bit slow outside but picks up along the way although does require a long attention span so can be a little tricky for younger ones.

This was the most informative and the best museum tour we’ve ever had. Thierry our guide was extremely knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the great works of art. He described in great detail the distinctive nuances among the epochs and artists. This great tour guide made our visit to the grandest museum memorable.

Our tour-guide Addy was absolutely excellent, a true art connoisseur whose passion and knowledge shone through and added so much more to our tour. The Louvre was extremely busy to the point of being quite uncomfortable, but that was expected for mid-july. I enjoyed putting my phone away and just appreciating all the beautiful art for a while.

We had an excellent tour of the Louvre with a wonderful tour guide named Summer. She made the tour so interesting and fun that even our two teenagers wanted to stay in the museum to see more when the tour ended - they had dragged their feet getting to the museum. Summer was extremely knowledgeable and her passion for art shone through. She answered all the questions the group had and she was very considerate of a gentleman in the group who had trouble walking. Summer would find him a place to rest wherever possible. I feel like I learned a lot this morning and recommend a tour with Summer to anyone.

The Louvre would have been too big and intimidating to understand if I had gone on my own. I am so grateful for our guide - Anthony who took his time to take us through the different rooms and eras in the museum. I got to see many of the art pieces I had on my list to see and learned so much more about other types of art and techniques. Our guide was so knowledgeable and explained many things to us. He suggested places to go if we wanted to see some other things after the tour. Thank you Anthony.
Also be prepared, there's a lot of walking involved but well worth it!!

Excellent tour, I wish I remembered the name of the female tour guide. She was informative and passionate about the pieces. We was able to enter the museum without any wait and she went over various pieces of art. She also led us to a hidden restroom and guides us to each room, including the Mona Lisa. I was able to get front and center and didn’t feel rushed at all.

We use a wheelchair and only saw they are excluding along with strollers from this tour. Next, our Uber was late and we did not arrive until 10 minutes after the tour group started. We proceeded to enter on our own and did a self-tour.

I see now why they exclude chairs and strollers. The Louvre basically has four floors of exhibits in three separate buildings(even though they appear as one. Each floor has half levels requiring a short flight of stairs, approximately 20 steps on average. It is a complex floor plan.

Those who can’t use steps spend a significant amount of time searching for lifts to take you to each sub level or other floor. They are not in logical locations making this a time consuming task. Louvre employees were great at providing assistance but the lifts were often away from the exhibits.

So, they are right in stating no wheelchair or strollers. There is no way they could wait while you search for your lift.

I requested a refund and was refused according to their policies which I fully understand.

This was an amazing "Team Adam" experience. Choosing to go with a guide was absolutely right choice, and what a guide did we get. Firstly Adam was just full of knowledge, but the way he was bringing that knowledge to us was simply brilliant. He was funny, very interactive and not once during this tour were we bored or felt tired. If you want true Louvre experience on a short trip to Paris I think this is a perfect way! Go team Adam!!

Ivanna, our tour guide, was the absolute truth. She is a PhD and took us through the Louvre with such an incredible, fresh commentary on famous Louvre pieces. She had a wealth of knowledge, and contextualized pieces like the Venus de Milo by situating them in history. Her explanations challenged preconceived notions and demonstrated a level of rigor and intelligence rarely seen in a tour. Would take a tour with Ivanna again and again. Truly the best experience at the Louvre!

We really enjoyed our guided tour! It went by quickly and was very informative. Our tour guide enestasia was easy to listen to and very pleasant, loved her, she was very knowledgeable. She even waited with us in line to look at the Mona Lisa because most people wanted to see her. One of us had been before not on a guided tour and it was thoroughly enjoyed with the tour. Locking our bags and coats was helpful, and we didn’t have to pay extra to use those or the group entrance. Highly recommend!!

Absolutely brilliant- 3 hours of fun informative art history from the amazing Nancy. We’ve been to the Louvre a couple of times and just haven’t known where to start and it all felt a bit overwhelming. Nancy imparts so much information whilst showing key pieces of art and sculpture. She is incredibly knowledgeable and I would recommend this tour to anyone.

The tour guide never showed up and 25 tourists who scheduled their whole day if not vacation around this were very pissed off. This company is a gamble, pay a little extra and go w Babylon where you know they will be professional. That’s who I ended up going w the next day. Ttly worth it. The v least city wonders could have done is send a backup guide for situations like this. So unprofessional.

Our guide Summer was great she is very knowledgeable and told great stories explaining so much in the museum. She answered everyone’s questions. A lot of walking. Skipping the entrance line was real nice and went in thru a separate entrance for groups. I would highly recommend Summer and this tour to get you thru the museum. Once the tour is done you can stay in the museum and walk around.

Our guide was absolutely wonderful. It was evident she loves history, and sharing it with others. We enjoyed the 3-hour guided tour very much, and thought it was money well spent. The lines outside to get in were very long, but as promised she got us in without delay. We highly recommend this tour.

Meeting spot was fine, but the tour was meh. We had headphones that were connected to our tour guide. However, there was way too much static and it really just became unbearable. I thought it was only my headset, but my wife was experiencing the same thing. Another person even mentioned to the tour host that there was static; but she tried to adjust the location of the mic hoping that it would help. It didnt. I also thought maybe if I move closer, but that didn't help at all.

The tour was ok, I think the better value may be just getting your own tickets and getting the headset devices they rent out to tour.

If I could do it over again, I'd pass on this tour.

Our guide, Lucia, had very interesting stories to the architechture, paintings and sculpture. Her stories made the tour come alive and we learnt so much during this time. She is really a great guide and the 3 hours felt like 30 minutes!

Not being a well versed art connoisseur the world renowned Louvre can be quit intimidating which is why I can’t recommend this tour enough! Our wonderful guide Lucia took us to visit all the most prominent and popular attractions. The best part was her knowledge and the history of the pieces and the depth of detail she spent in describing them. Honestly I could have spent the rest of the day hearing her tell me the history of all the beautiful pieces in this iconic museum!

Adam gave us literally the best tour I’ve ever experienced. He is a wealth of obscure knowledge and fun anecdotes, and his delivery style is very funny as well. Hailing from Canada and speaking flawless English, he turned what could otherwise have been a chaotic, confusing, and overwhelming environment into an intriguing stroll through history. I cannot emphasize enough how worth the money this tour is, and how much Adam’s guidance will improve your experience at the Louvre.

We were not able to go on the tour as the meeting point was misleading. We were waking around to find the tour guide and did not find the tour guide on time. We cancelled the tour immediately, requested a refund and proceeded to book a new guided tour with the Louvre set for the following week.
We are completely disappointed with the lack of service when we called . The tour operator could not have been any less interested in helping us. Moreover, we have sent several emails requesting a refund and the company is fighting to keep the money despite the fact that our tickets were not used. This action speaks to a lack of integrity with Viator/Trip Advisor.

Our guide, Liliya, was so terrific. She walked us through and provided great, interesting knowledge about exhibits that was easy to get, engaging, and fun. She had a terrific personality and really made the tour great. I highly recommend this tour, and Liliya, for Americans in Paris that are interested in the Louvre.

Never have I ever met a tour guide more knowledgeable than Nancy. This lady has everything in her head and she makes art come alive with the interesting stories and interpretations. I will forever be grateful as I will never see art the same way again.

Very interesting tour. We saw lots of Romans expositions and the most important paintings. Flor was friendly and tried to highlight the most important things about The history of the sculptors and paintings. It’s a good tour if you don’t want to spend a lot of time in the museum.

Our tour guide was wonderful . This is a perfect tour for those that want the highlights of the Louvre museum . It takes approximately 3 hours to do the tour but note it takes 3-4 months just to go through the entire museum! Be prepared to wear comfortable shoes. Highly recommend this tour company

Skipping the line and moving smartly through the museum were worth the price. Then adding an art historian’s perspective to the art we saw and the historical understanding of the building itself was wonderful. Learned quite a few things and got tips on things to see on our own! Just make sure you leave time for exiting as it is not easy to get out!

I love how we can enter the museum before the crowd. Max is a very good guide that not only show us the highlight of the Louvre but also other hidden gems in the museum such as Aphrodite and state with eyes. The private tour was awesome and its a totally different experience than hearing the guide from the audio device. Highly recommend this tour!

Adam was probably one of the best tour guides I've ever had. It was great to have a guide who was clearly knowledgeable and whose passion for the art and history made this experience memorable. Would highly recommend this tour for everyone.

Our guide was great! It was nice to have someone to lead you around the huge museum so you didn’t miss the important pieces. She was very knowledgeable about the art and the history of the paintings and statues and artifacts in the museum. Make sure, when you get your voucher, you click on the departure tab. We almost missed our tour because we didn’t know where to meet the group.

Thanks to Anastasia our tour was brilliant. Without her we wouldn’t have known where to start. She explained so many pieces of art to us in so much details within the 3 hours we were there. Super friendly guide and definitely worth going to see the Louvre!
