Florence was very knowledgeable on the history of the Louvre and all of the paintings and sculptures she took us to. I learned so much and really enjoyed all of the history! I came here once before without a tour guide, and I’ll say this was worth all the knowledge I’ve gained. And she managed to keep calm among the hustle and bustle and wandering tour members!

My experience was the absolute worst. I arrived at the Louvre Museum from the train station around 20 minutes before my scheduled visit. I looked around and saw a line that said “reserved group tours.” I stood on that line with my 3 guests and and waited about 10 minutes before being told that my tickets weren’t valid. Now frantically trying to figure out what I could have possibly done wrong I find a shirt with a museum employee spoke English. I called trip advisor and asked the employee to speak to the trip advisor rep. The trip advisor employee and the Louvre ticket taker spoke briefly about meeting points and where I needed to be and finally she ( the trip advisor says… you have to go to the arc and find your group) it’s now ten minutes after my scheduled tour. I run to the arc which was a good distance away and there’s no group!!!!! The representative told me that it was my fault, I should have read the fine print for the meeting place. I searched my confirmation for such info and didn’t see it, after I calmed down, I clicked on a drop down menu and there it was … the meeting point.

I asked the rep if she could schedule my group for the next tour she said no! I asked can you please schedule us for a later date, she said no, you should have called earlier. I wasted 30 minutes in total from the time I arrived at the museum trying to find out where to go only to have your company rep treat me and my group so rudely with out any consideration for the fact that we are visiting another country on a limited time frame. If the meeting point we’re in plain site like the other details this wouldn’t have happened. I will never use trip advisor again, I can admit that I messed up by not seeing the drop down, but the reps lack of knowledge prolonged this horrible experience and the unwillingness to try any other solutions have left a horrible taste in my mouth.

The Louvre is an overwhelming experience. It was great having someone walk us through for 2 hours and getting us started. I loved having individual headsets so that we could hear our guide. It was informative. The guide was jovial.

I would also suggest the earlier tours to avoid the mob of people that visit the Louvre.

The experience can be wonderful. Since the Louvre can be overwhelming we decided to do it with a guide. We really lucked out with Andrea. He was so full of energy and enthusiasm and knowledge of his subject matter. He really explained a lot about the sculptures and paintings we were seeing which made the experience all that much better.

The only issue I had was that the tour is supposed to be 3 hours and ours ended after just 2. That is the reason for the 4 star rating, otherwise it would have been a 5. As I result I feel that a partial refund should be issued.

It was a very busy day at the louvre cause it was a holyday week. Taking this tour made it much easier cause if not you get lost and you skip the important parts of the museum. Hugo was our guide. A passionate guy that have a huge knowledge of paintings and hystory.

This tour exceeded my expectations. What made it special was our guide, Nancy. Her sense of humor and encyclopedic knowledge of the Louvre really added to the experience. Skipping the line and access to the "VIP" bathrooms made the tour more comfortable. I would recommend this tour to my best friends.

This tour was exceptional. And Laura, our guide, was outstanding. She was knowledgeable, and an excellent story teller. Brought all of the amazing treasures of the Louvre to life. I would highly recommend this tour, and particularly, Laura. The Louvre is massive - as Laura told us it would take you 3 months to see the 38,000 art pieces there to see. So you need someone to help you see the highlights, and explain it all. Laura did a great job of explaining the history of the Louvre, and the individual pieces of art. We spent a couple of hours after the tour seeing some other things. A wonderful day!

We were so excited for this tour and decided to splurge on the cost. We left early so we could be at the meet up at the suggested time. 11:00 came and went. Our clearly irritated tour guide, Gregory, finally showed up. He counted and recounted and recounted and counted the number of people in our group again all the while having an argument with the tour staff about how many people he was touring. He acted like a flamboyant spoiled child.

He handed out the the headphone sets that hardly worked. I fussed with my own to try and hear the tour guide constantly getting so much feedback I missed most of what he was saying. My adult daughter and many others in the group were having the same issue.

At the start of the tour, Gregory stated that we didn’t have to continue for the entirety of it and it “most people can’t make it to the end and I won’t be offended if you leave early”. Seriously poor choice of words to an expensive tour. He continued on so flippantly that he went as far as saying “well something happened here and hmph, moving on to the next work of art. Horrible dissertation of historical facts and innuendos regarding some pieces. We, along with many other parties in our group gave up. We handed in our head phones and went on without the guide. I expected excellence out of a Trip Advisor tour and we didn’t even get mediocrity. Expensive, yet not worth the cost in any way except skipping the line.
Shannon and Emily
Louvre tour
Paris, France

Ivana is an excellent tour guide. She is very knowledgeable in the subject of history of art. Also, she is highly educated. The tour was very interesting and very well organized. My daughters age 13 and 15 loved the tour. My 15 year old doesn’t like museums in general, however she got very interested in everything that Ivana was describing. I think that after this tour she became interested in museums and the history of art.

We booked this tour for 9:45am on January 19th, 2020 and we arrived at the meeting point at exactly 9:45am, which was when the tour had started. When I approached the tour guide, she told me that the coordinator had already left. I was confused since she was the one giving the tour, and there is no mention of a coordinator on the tour details. Her name was Jenny, I believe, she was wearing glasses and had freckles. When I attempted to talk to her again, she refused to help me. I called customer service and in the middle of the call, she approached me to talk. She then quickly scrolled down through the list on her phone saying our name was not on there. Luckily we saw it and pointed out on her screen. It only took about 20 seconds for her to help us and realize we were in the right group. She was rude and unwelcoming as though it bothered her so much to take an extra minute to hand us a pair of headphones. Another lady came right after us and the tour guide refused to help her at all as if she had already had enough with us arriving last. It was very rude and unprofessional the way she dismissed the lady. After the tour was over I approached her to ask her why didn’t she looked at her list before refusing to help us, she says that they cannot wait for every single person. However, when I told her we were there at the right time and that she was rude for refusing to check the list, she said that she would not accept us nor help anybody else again next time. We pay for a service that involves professional customer service and the treatment was very poor. I understand if we had arrived after they had gotten inside the museum, but to reject us at the meeting point is unacceptable. The tour guide (Jenny) was knowledgeable about the subject and was very informative, however the behavior she treated us with at the beginning made the tour uncomfortable, plus the comments at the end were very rude and unprofessional.

Don’t use these people. I arrived at 11.00 (as stated on my ticket) and no one was there to meet me. I asked 5 different officials where my party was and no one could help. I phoned Trip Advisor who also could not help. Basically I was unable to enter The Louvre as I would have to have bought another ticket and by this time the queue was too long. I was furious and eventually the poor woman at the call centre for Trip Advisor agreed to give me a refund however Trip Advisor have since gone back on their word and are refusing to refund me. I’m so angry about this. Words cannot describe. It’s scandalous. It stated 11.00 on my ticket and I was there at 11.00! Trip Advisor are insisting I must have been late as it states to arrive 15 minutes early in their small print. This experience has spoilt my trip to Paris and I will never be using Trip Advisor again.

Normally I am more of an off the beaten path type of traveler and almost never do tours, but this was money well spent! So glad I booked this tour. Our guide, Summer, was incredibly knowledgeable about the works of art & the museum, and you can tell she lives and breathes this; true passion.

It was like getting a university level art history lesson while touring the Louvre, but more personal! Learned so many facts and interesting anecdotes, meanings, history, and subliminal symbolisms in the works of art that would have never know otherwise.

Our guide Violette was simply the best, with her incredible knowledge of art history, candid attitude, and brilliant humour that made the tour a rich learning experience and a complete joy.

This was our third time with CityWonders (also at Versailles and, several years ago, the Vatican Museum). Every tour had been 100% worth the money, though this one is our favourite experience yet.

The tour guide did not show up so we were not able to get our tickets and therefore not able to enter to museum. The line was very long by that point and would have taken forever to get tickets. We decided to leave. It was our last day in Paris so we were not able to make it up.

Our guide was very friendly and knowledgeable.
HOWEVER, it was two hours of a four hour tour before we saw any actual art. The first half of the tour (which started late) involved descriptions of the underground shopping center and ruins of the old fortress which sits below the Louvre. If you are into archaeology over art, then this is great. But based on the bored faces, it was not with anyone came for.
Nothing special about Venus de Milo or Mona Lisa — the guide simply took us there and left us to fend for ourselves.

Strongly suggest that you simply purchase skip the line tickets and do it yourself. You will get to see more art and at your own pace.

Oct 12 we took this tour with Flore. (Not sure about name). She spent about 30 min in the basement at the “old castle” explaining bricks & moats & watching videos about it 3x. No other tour guides went to this area. This was a waste of time that could have been spent seeing the Crown Jewels, and other more important works of art by Raphael which were listed in the ad.
I would not recommend this company again.

The tour was well organized. Our guide Ferit was very knowledgable and fun to listen to! The whole tour lasted three hours but it felt like three minutes because we were so taken by beautiful stories behind the famous pieces of art. We recommend this tour to everybody without reservations!

Fantastic! Worth the price by far. Penelope was so knowledgeable and guided us thru the crowds. We especially appreciated the no lines, the private restrooms and the up close no obstruction view of the Mona Lisa. She made sure we saw every treasure of the Louvre. Penelope is a treasure herself as she gave us so much background information about the sculptures and paintings. Wear very comfortable shoes as there are multiple staircases to climb and you’ll walk from one end of the Louvre to the other.

It would have been extremely helpful if the guide actually showed up. Tour company wasted an hour figuring out what was going on. Had to rent headsets (gameboy DS) that were available at the Louvre, told how to get in and them left on our own. If you are on a time crunch go with a different company. The headsets you can rent has maps, audio descriptions of rooms and some specific pieces. If you have a list of things you want to see the headsets can give you a map on how to get there. Honestly this is a waste of money.

The Louvre was stunning. The guide was knowledgeable. The skip the line ticket saved a great deal of time.
We did have an incident where two people got lost. In my opinion it was the tour guide’s fault because she told them where to meet us at the top of the elevator, but then didn’t go there immediately. So when we arrived, they had already assumed they went to the wrong place and wandered off. Had she gone there immediately and not 20 minutes later, they wouldn’t have been lost.
In general, it’s a lot of walking and stairs. If you have trouble walking the skip-the-line ticket may still be worth the money, but keeping up with the actual tour may be difficult.

The Louvre without the line: This was our third trip to Paris and we have always wanted to visit the Louvre. However, the lines were always very long to buy tickets and get into the museum. Four of us decided to give this company a try. Well, I can tell you that hands down it was great! We met Lucia, our tour guide for our private tour at the designated spot and she quickly got to know us. With a few questions, Lucia was able to determine how she would plan our tour to fit our schedule and ensure we got the most out of the experience. Lucia is an incredibly knowledgeable professional. We learned more in a few hours, and finished with an incredible history lesson. I have no doubt that she knows every single piece and item in that museum. We would do it all over again. If you have want to get a snippet of history in the Louvre, I would highly recommend Lucia and the company we booked.

We had Alberto for our guide at 9am. He was very knowledgeable about the art history and the progression of the art styles. Our tour visited the highlights of the museum. Then after the two hours you could leave or he stayed on for one more hour to show us the kings room. He even took some pictures for the families at the end!

Our guide, Marta, was incredibly knowledgeable and an excellent guide. I particularly enjoyed learning about the history of the Louvre’s beginning and how it came to be. The tour was top notch and if you’re lucky enough to get Marta, it will be an unforgettable experience!

This was a highlight of our trip to Paris. Our gorgeous guide Nicola was so knowledgeable and so engaging. We learnt more than we signed up for. Skipping the line is the only way to do the Louvre, even in the low season it’s really busy and there is so much to see you need guidance otherwise it’s too overwhelming. Nicola showed us the most significant works, and her delivery was informative and often humorous. Couldn’t recommend more highly.

Summer was an extraordinary guide! Her knowledge of art history was of immense value and made our experience of the museum so much better than it would’ve been otherwise. We are so glad we chose this tour!

The depth of Summer’s knowledge of art history in general and specifically of the louvre was surpassed only by her enthusiasm for sharing it. I still find myself thinking of and sharing stories she told us days later.

My only regret is that we couldn’t hire her for our whole week in Paris!!!

5 stars highly recommend.

I have to start by saying I am not a big fan of museums. That being said, not only is the Louvre just incredibly amazing, but Violette took our experience to the next level! She was fun, energetic, and most of all, VERY knowledgeable! She very much enjoys what she does and you can tell from the minute you meet her. The Louvre is massive with sooo much to see! This tour is great if you want to know more about the history of the pieces! I did the 2:30pm tour on a Saturday and would recommend selecting the earlier time. The museum was closing when our tour ended so we didn’t get the chance to walk around on our own afterwards. Either way, it was a truly great experience. All of my tours in Paris were with City Wonders and I would highly recommend them! ASK FOR VIOLETTE!

We love the tour and our guide Daniel was extremely accommodating and knew the museum so well. I felt like we saw more in 2.5 hours than we could have encountered all day on our own. I found it particularly helpful that Daniel knew Rome and Italy well having guided there too. He was able to answer so many questions we had. 5 stars, highly recommended!

Our tour was scheduled for 9:45, but at 7:30 that morning a staff member for the operator (who was extremely polite and apologetic, and is the reason this review is getting two stars and not one) called to say that due to some unexpected unavailability of the guide our tour would be cancelled. She offered to reschedule for later in the week (which wouldn’t work with our travel timeline) or a refund. Of course, with that late notice there was no online ticket availability (I asked if there was any way we would simply get the tickets the tour company presumably would have given us and gone without a guide and was told this was not possible - but I would strongly suggest the company consider such a policy as it would seem to be the way to make the best of a bad situation). I certainly understand that unexpected issues do arise, but were I to do this again I would get tickets ahead of time directly from the Louvre. Alas, that shall have to wait until the next time I’m in Paris!

What a wonderful tour! This was a family trip we had 2 of our kids ages 16 and 12. It was very hot outside and during corona. The group was small just us 4 and one others a mom and adult daughter. Everyone was so nice, we were able to pass the line and go right inside and didn’t have to wait in the heat or long line. That in it self was great. Our guide was so knowledgeable it was like having an art and history scholar in one. We saw all the main attractions. She was also very good with keeping the kids engaged. I really appreciate how dedicated she is. This was the best art tour I’ve ever taken. The louvre is so huge it was great having Someone that knew the art and the buildings. What a great afternoon! I would do it again!

Adam was an amazing guide, very funny, and incredibly knowledgeable. This is honestly the best tour I’ve ever been on- thank you Adam!!!! He made what would’ve otherwise been aimless wandering through the Louvre into a story of art and the history of France. I listened in on a little of what other tour guides were saying and Adam’s tour was clearly superior. The depth he is able to go in with each piece we stopped at and how he weaved together a clear understanding of even the most nuanced subjects is astounding. Much love from MN.

This was a great tour. The guide is amazing in every way. She showed us how the lockers work and showed us back to the lockers at the end. Our guide was super informative and the flag she carried around made it always easy to locate her in a big crowd! Highly recommend!

The tour was was very good. Sylvie I think the guide was called was very informative and took us to parts of the Louvre we would otherwise miss, in particular the moat and foundations of the original building the Louvre was built on and the history of the building itself. She was also sensitive to the needs of the mixed group. A good purchase I think with City Tours!

Addie was an amazing guide, the best we have had throughout our European trip. Her English is excellent and clear, which seems surprisingly uncommon among guides. More importantly, she had excellent knowledge and demonstrated passion for the artwork in the Louvre.
We saw all the “superstars” (Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo etc.), but also other interesting works that showed the evolution of art in those periods. The pace was great, the attitude always helpful and friendly. The tour actually went overtime, I think primarily because she wanted to show us more. We were tired but followed happily to the end to enjoy all of this wonderful tour.
Addie even gave us a tip on a terrific lunch spot nearby which we enjoyed directly after the tour.

If you are visiting for the first time and you want to make the best out of your time, money and enjoyment this is the package you need to go for. If you like a tour, this one was good!

Mr Ferier, out tour guide, was fantastic, he presented all the interesting stories, facts, numbers, and anecdotes about the art pieces we saw.

He made it look like a movie, created a connection and a story while presenting everything.

After he finished we had the choice of exploring further the museum at our pace.

Amazing!

Amazing experience with our tour guide Adam. Adam was knowledgeable, engaging, and hilarious. He has a true passion for art, history, and restoration. The information Adam gave us was amazing, but he also included education. My husband and I now know how to distinguish between Greek and Roman sculpture and truly navigate a gallery. Adam engaged everyone on the tour and we were all laughing as we made our way through the museum. Thanks Adam for a truly entertaining day!

Booking this tour was a great decision. Nancy guided us through the many amazing art at the Louvre and made the whole experience extremely entertaining and interesting. I laughed a lot and learned so many new facts about the Louvre and History of Arts in general. Very worthwhile way to conquer this amazing museum with it's 400 rooms.

The expanse of the Louvre for first time visitors with a few hours at their disposal can be a daunting.
You'd always wonder whether you've spent time at the right exhibits, both popular and not-so-well-known but significant ones!
That's where we were so fortunate to have Adam (Team Adam!) as our guide.
His knowledge and wit were a fabulous combination, helping the visitor experience the history of the Louvre & it's major exhibits, and leaving with a sense of confidence of having seen and learnt what wasn't to be missed!
So thank you, Adam! Great job!

Total Disaster. The receipt said they would email us the tickets. They emailed a link the allowed you to download bar codes. Issue was the Lourve Museum would not accept them. I wast the only one as we met 3 other people with the same issue. I ended up buying new tickets on site. Trip Advisory charged us $184 for this experience. The on site tickets cost me €75.

Adam, our tour guide, truly made this a memorable experience. This was, by far, my favorite tour! Team Adam was amazing. He talked about the art with a true love and appreciation. He shared lesser known facts with us (at least lesser known to me). He wove a wonderful and seamless canvas from one piece and exhibit to the next. He taught us when we didn't even realize. He was such a wealth of information and a breath of fresh air. He knew how to get us around without bumping into folks or making us walk unnecessarily through empty halls. No one could top Adam! We had a few tours after this and were incredibly disappointed and really wanted Adam back!

Unfortunately, the meeting place wasn’t described fully and we ended up being early... to the wrong location. We called and let them know we were on our way from a couple of subway stops down, but the guide had taken the group inside by the time we arrived. I understand that they needed to begin the tour, but we were told there was no way to catch up with the group and the only other tour availability was after we had to leave Paris. We were refused a refund. Very expensive disappointment. I find it hard to believe that “ the tour guide turns off their phone” when they begin the tour, so there’s no way to reach them to allow a catch-up to the group... what about just silencing it for just such a purpose? Text messages? I wish I could provide a review of the actual tour but we didn’t get the opportunity.

This was hands down the best tour I'd ever been on. Adam truly brings art to life and helped me to appreciate each work of art properly, more deeply, and it was truly an enriching experience. I highly recommend Adam for this Lourve tour!!

Summer like the Season was a great tour guide for our visit to the Louvre.

She was able to show the key artifacts the museum offers. She answered all the old couple's questions they interrupted her with.

She gave good background to the museum and was able to link French history and French culture.

I would highly recommend this tour to everyone.

Our tour was cancelled at the last, so we had to buy individual tickets online. The good news is we saved a bunch of money and it wasn't sold out or busy, so didn't need the skip the line feature. Just wish I didn't have the drama of the last minute, little notice of cancelation and having to improvise.

Team Adam!!! What a tour and what a tour guide, the 3 hour tour flew by. Adam is extremely knowledgeable and showed us parts of the museum I would have walked by never realising the significance of the work it held. Adam taught so much and in a fun and interactive way. I would recommend this tour to anyone. Adam is truthfully the best tour guide I've ever had.

This was an exceptional tour. Our guide, Carolina was excellent. She was knowledgeable, personable and pleasant. Not waiting in long lines was a bonus and will worth it. The tour begins outside the Louvre, starting with French history. The tour lasted about 3 hours, which was perfect. The tour covered a large portion of the museum and still allowed for self exploration at the end. My daughter and I fully enjoyed this experience and recommend this Louvre tour to anyone visiting Paris.

This three hour tour was fantastic! Great way to tour the louvre, which is very large and impossible to tour in one day. So useful having a knowledgeable source to ask questions and explain the pieces while also adding the historical references. After the tour you dont have to leave so you can continue and go and see and pieces that you didn’t hit or wanted to see again which was ideal because we ended up doing a little more exploring. We thoroughly enjoyed this and think a guide in this massive museum was very helpful. We also went to the d’orsy and a guide was not needed there.

Rubjen was great!

We took a tour of the Louvre just as the COVID19 scare was beginning in the first week of March 2020. The guide, Farid, from City Wonders was incredible, knowledgeable, excited by the Louvre and so pleasant. He even got to know our names. Best guide I have ever had. Great tour, wonderful stories. Great memories.

One of the best guided tours I’ve taken. Ivana is thoroughly knowledgeable, very coherent and a born educator, who deftly conveyed to her charges her wonderment and deep appreciation for the place and its collection. If Ivana’s leading a tour, you’ll want to be on it.

We were told to arrive 15mins early. Our tour was scheduled to start at 11:30, but no one every showed up. When we called the company, we were told they could not get in touch with the tour guide. We were told that the tour was cancelled and we would be refunded for the tickets purchased. When we inquired about being added to another tour later that day, we were told the company’s schedule was full and that it wasn’t an option. I will NOT suggest this tour to any of my family and friends traveling to Paris.

The morning group I participated had Christine as our guide. She waited for everyone at the exact spot we expected. Listening to her about art and the history of the museum was really intriguing, it made me to get more into the art and the stories behind each painting, sculpture and so on. Keep up the good work!

Team Adam was the absolute best. Adam is the best tour guide we have ever had. He is filled with passion about the museum leaving with us a fantastic understanding of the history behind each piece of art. He skillfully blends his expertise in social and natural sciences to ensure a fulfilling experience. Highly recommend!

The tour was amazing. It included also the tickets which the guide collected for us.
You access thru a group entrance which is very quiet and more private - we did not find any queue at all! - and you use also the group toilet and lockers, which are much more clean and quiet than the normal one.
Our guide Violette was lovely and very knowledgeable. She told us some very interesting facts and was very professional . The tour lasted 3 hours but they flies!
You then have the option to stay at the louvre or leave .
I definitely recommend this tour, as it is smooth and the best option to see the best parts with a guide.

We absolutely loved this tour... Our tour guide Violet was funny, informative and took us to see all the top museum exhibits. After the 3 hour tour we were able to stay and look at spots that weren’t covered. If you’ve never been to the Louvre, this is a great start!

Very knowledgeable and interesting guide. Audio boxes provided were very helpful so we heard every word and could easily follow our guide thru the crowds. She told stories and kept things moving along. Very worthwhile

Violet was a perfect tour guide! Extremely knowledgeable and fun to be around. She made the tour light and entertaining, but her passion is clearly displayed through her energy. I had a small child, along with my two older children, and they were engaged nearly the whole time. So glad we did this!

Our guide Lucien gave my two adult sons and me a 2 1/2 private tour. He was knowledgeable, personable and took the time to understand what our previous knowledge of art and the Louvre was.

We were very satisfied and would recommend him highly.

Had the most awesome guide for the tour of 25 people. Adam began by memorizing everyone’s name and place of origin. The tour included three of the most famous art works in the museum. In addition, with the knowledge of Adam it was one of the most informative tours we have been on and we have been on many. Throughout the tour, Adam included everyone in the group using first names. Never once was I bored with his informative talk and he had amazing strategies to get the entire group up close and personal with the art. So much fun. Wish we could take him with us on every tour of the city. Ask him about the tattoo he recommends for becoming a “Team Adam” member for life! Bravo Adam. You are the bomb!

I honestly wasn’t a fan of museums but felt it was a “to-see” in Paris so we booked this tour. Our tour guide, Adam, changed my life in three hours. He was amazing in every way. Smart, witty, an amazing teacher and somehow humble while being the smartest human alive. He gave us so much relatable information in these three hours, he taught us so much, he made us laugh and he made the time fly by! I will visit the Louvre every time I’m in Paris forever going forward and will always request, Adam. If you are reading this Adam, thank you SO much!

You’d easy get lost here and you can’t cover everything in one day. It was lovely going straight in and not having to waste time queuing.

Our guide was passionate and knowledgeable. What could have been an overwhelming experience turned out to be one of the highlights of our trip.

Fantastic value for money. As soon as we arrived we skipped the long lines and had radios with ear pieces so we could hear our guide the whole time. Our tour guide Max was incredible, he had so much knowledge and made the tour very interesting.

Thanks to Nancy, I had a wonderful time at Le Louvre, such a memorable experience and one that wasn’t boring, or that dragged on forever. Nancy was very friendly and was approachable to ask any sort of question as she was very knowledgeable and bubbly. I highly recommend this tour as you will get to see what’s necessary and interesting to someone like myself whom is not overly into art or history and no doubt even if you are- you will definitely love it! It’s worth spending the extra bit of cash on top of regular entry!!!

Great tour guide Oliver gave a great tour of the Louvre for us. Funny and engaging. The only negative was that the headsets often had interference. He did change frequencies when brought to his attention. I would definitely recommend the 0900 tour. The crowds were there though they were manageable. By the time we exited at 1230 they were beginning to get very large and this was on a Wednesday.

Such a wonderful experience!! Our guide, Marta, was excellent and truly navigated all the highlights perfectly. I’m so glad we learned about the Louvre’s history itself – not just all about the art. It seems like other people skipped most of this, and the tour wouldn’t have been as awesome without it.

Easy meeting spot to find. Great audio devices. Information from guide was easy to follow and interesting. We went with a group of 7 (3 in mid-20s and 4 in 50s) and we all agree that the tour was a bit too long. The last hour or so was a bit much but all in all, we enjoyed most of what we saw. It is worth pointing out that you will be on your feet and moving for approx 4 hours straight with no opportunity to sit so may not be suitable for people who aren’t used to that much activity.

I loved the skip-the-line aspect of the tour but found Anna to be a bit long winded in some of her explanations regarding individual works of art — I would have preferred to see more, with more succinct explanations/context. Plus, I think she could have done a better job of keeping the group together towards the end — a few of us sat down for a brief rest, and she was several rooms away before we could track her down (and then she seemed annoyed that we hadn’t kept up). That said, it was still nice to have a guided tour.

Violet, our tour guide was amazing! Her knowledge of art history and the works in the Louvre were incredible. Violet was entertaining, funny, and an outstanding guide. I would highly recommend this tour and especially recommend seeing the highlights of the Louvre with Violet. The three of us in our group were so impressed with the wealth of information Violet had so readily available to share with the group!

We showed up for our scheduled tour with plenty of time in hand but could not find our guide. Finally, a guide with name of Mohammed met up. He already had a large group with him and said that he is supposed to have 25 people and he has 23 and that we must be the remaining two. He pointed us to go check in with a lady in distance. When we went to the lady, she told us that the tour has been canceled. Meanwhile, after misdirecting us, Mohammed took his group for the tour without waiting for us and was nowhere to be seen. Wish we had been informed about your cancellation in advance with a message or phone call. The lady who told us of cancellation had no back up plans about rescheduling, etc.

Irresponsible! I want to put 0 star for review if I could. Firstly, I came to The Lourve on time 8:45 ( the tour is 9:00am ) but I did not see any tour guide or the sights of company . Secondly, I tried to make a call to customer service but no one picked up the called. We were upset and we had to buy two new ticket to get-in the Lourve. Finally, it is getting superb upset when they refused the refund when I gave them the email to telling the story. I am on vacation and they let me waste my time and my money.

Summer, our tour guide, made this one of the best tours we have taken. She was very informative and provided information about the Louvre and artwork that we would have never known. The tour was well worth the money and more!!! Summer was very professional and answered all the questions we had!!! Would definitely take another tour with her!!!

We thoroughly enjoyed this tour. Despite other reviews, we had no problems meeting the tour group under the Arc du carousel, and got in quickly without having to wait in the long line. Our tour guide Claire was very nice and knowledgeable. The Louve was quite crowded, but we were able to hear her well through the earpieces. We spent around two hours on the tour and went through the wing with the main sites, the tour actually continued to another wing but we were tired so I decided to leave. Would recommend.

The tour was perfect! Team Adam was so fun and amusing! It was so interesting. I would say that it was the best tour of a museum that I have ever been on. Adam was so hilarious as well as enthusiastic. It was a pleasure to have him as our tour guide. It was such an amusing tour. Thank you Adam for the amazing experience!

We had our tour with Summer. She made this tour worthwhile. It didn’t feel long at all. She reminds me of my favorite teacher in my younger years. She’s very informative and mindful of everyone’s needs. We learned so many interesting side notes and stories behind the Louvre. Thanks again, Summer!

Unfortunately our tour guide phoned in sick on the day and there was no replacement. We had to wait 30 mins for people who could not get there on time! We had to enter as a group so we were talked out of getting the headset or the whole group would have had to wait for us! We were promised a refund as no tour guide to pay for. Have not received this yet!
Louvre Museum is amazing!

Did the semi-private tour with Ruben. He was great. He did an awesome job taking us through the exhibits in a chronological order in 3hrs. He was well-informed and was patient and was passionate in explaining the history behind each artifact. It was an ***excellent*** experience and strongly recommend it.

Our guide Stephanie was amazing! She guided us to all the highlights the Louve has to offer, gave us salient background information and pointed out interesting facts. She was so enthusiastic and funny, she kept things lively and interesting. The only way to see this museum. It is extremely large!!

Skipping line good, guides nice, but short tour (don’t go late in day!), 30 min spent on walking through foundation of louvre, explaining the stones and watching pre-made videos. The rest involved cursory explanations of most famous pieces that seemed less informed than the post-card descriptions next to display. Don’t recommend if interested in many pieces and any background in art already.

Paid for a guided tour. Replacement person from company met us late at the rendezvous location and told us that the guide called in sick and that we would not have a guided tour. He said we should ask the company for a refund. We filed for a refund but have not heard from anyone yet.

We waited 15 minutes for our guide who never called, texted or showed up. I had my 11 year old granddaughter with me who of course was so disappointed. I was shocked that no one texted me to let me know that the tour guide cancelled. I called the number on my reservation and was informed the tour was cancelled. Very poor customer service.

Hi Only one of us did the tour as we arrived late due to a strike in Paris and taxis were not available.The guide wasn’t very helpful we tried to explain that we had another tour at 2pm. My grandson was unable to see the Mona Lisa.overall he enjoyed the what he saw of the tour. Unfortunately l have a walking problem and l did want to hold up the group. They didn’t offer a refund and were quite rude.

We arrived 15 minutes early as requested. There was no guide to meet us. There were 24 of us waiting ! I finally called on behalf of the group to City wonders . I was put hold twice but did speak someone. Who had no idea what was wrong. Finally a frazzled hurried unprepared substitute guide shows up without any tickets headphones or list of us on the tour. Finally more than an hour later of the guide scrambling to fix it,we started the tour. We lost at least an hour of our precious day with no offer any partial refund.

Having been to the Louvre a dozen times and on other tours I can attest that this tour is worth it but request Adam. Not only is he super knowledgeable but personable and we learned so much. Would definitely do it again and tour another portion of the louvre. So much to see and learn about.

Violetta is an excellent tour guide for the Louvre. Very enthusiastic and knowledgeable about art history. She explains the major works without hesitation. Our group was 22 strong but every one was able to keep up. Use of the audioset kept the group in touch with Violetta. It really was great having her lead our group.

Experience was horrible, we were unable to locate the guides location and there was no communication setup for those attending. Trip guide was contracted out so we needed to communicate w trip advisor via email. No reply until after your was over. Therefore, we are out 126 euros.

If you like a tour, this one was good! The museum is so massive we visited more than one day. One day on the tour and one day self guided using Rick Steve’s book. Either way is a good option to make sure you don’t miss anything important.

If I could give this 0 stars that would be a more accurate representation. Our tour was cancelled by the tour operator less than 24 hours before our tour with no explanation and no option to rebook. On such short notice, this gave us no options to rebook as all the rest of the tours are full. Extremely disappointed. I would not book with this tour operator if you’d actually like to complete your tour. This is unacceptable.

A very well thought out tour of a monumental facility of enormous scale. Our guide, Lindsey, was very knowledgeable and passionate about every exhibit and kept our group together and on track throughout the tour. It was one of the best tours we have been on in our travel experience.

I have been to the Louvre before but not like this, we had Adam as our tour guide, and he was beyond amazing. His English was perfect, he knew the museum like the back of his hand, and he is so captivating and charismatic. Our group was small, which is great because of the pandemic. We saw all masterpieces you'd expect, and some only Adam could make it special. I recommend it and if you can choose, ask for this guide.

Adi was amazing. Very well organised and knowledgeable. Set realistic expectations about how much we would see in the short amount of time but was happy to accommodate requests. Saw parts of the Louvre I’ve never seen before and learned about its history.

Our guide Alexander was knowledgeable and insightful - with excellent language skills. The tour itself was truly wonderful and provided history, stories and perspective.
Alexander did a fantastic job maintaining the intensity and passion for the Louvre over three hours.
The organization at the beginning was shambolic. No one was clear on the starting time, microphones did not work and people were made to stand in the cold wind and rain for an unreasonable amount of time. Better joining instructions, better signs and better planning are all required - desperately.

Great experience! Our guide was very knowledgeable, prepared and was very passionate about the Louvre. The tour includes the important highlights of the Louvre. Highly recommend this tour.
Be prepared to do a lot of stair climbing and walking.

Kenny was very knowledgable but acted like the tour was for 4-6 year olds. Wasted the first 30 min taking everyone to Thanks, Jon bathroom and to buy a bottle of water…..really? Then spent the entire tour telling the group exactly when to take every picture. Completely un-necessary.

Unfortunately there were some technical issues and we spent an hour waiting for our guide to figure it out. She was very nice, but it was disappointing to see that she was just left on her own… no one came to help her. She had to keep leaving us to call because there was no service where we were. Once we finally entered our guide was very knowledgeable. She was super nice and apologized for the inconvenience multiple times.

they manage the eliminate all the pain points of visiting the Louvre. No waiting on line for tickets and entrance, comprehensive narratives of the buildings history, pavilions, and art pieces. Alex, the guide was brilliant in his story telling and knowledge transfer.

This was a speed tour through the Louvre. We saw all the highlights in less than 2 1/2 hours. Had to run almost to keep up. But still recommend it. Guide knowledgeable and headphones ensure you don’t miss anything. We stayed another 5 hours on our own. Downside—can’t leave and come back because you don’t actually get a ticket.

We were 5 people in a group of 25. The tour started at 230pm and due to uncontrollable circumstances we were late. A very kind representative made sure we caught up with our group and we were on our way. The English speaking Italian tour guide was wonderful, very knowledgeable and a great sense of humor!

Anastasia was very knowledgeable about the progression of the mediums and the effects each era had on the following. Our time was fascinating and memorable. We especially appreciated the earphone set which made it quite easy to hear our guide even if the ambient noise was loud.

Very knowledgeable guide on history of art but on other artefacts very sketchy.
Equipment to hear him hit and miss and in the bustling halls not great reception. Would be better to have two headphones instead of one so the background noise is cut out.

We booked a tour of the Louvre while in Paris. Our guide, Maxim, was incredible! He was extremely knowledgeable and really passionate about the art. My whole family raved about Maxim. We got so much more out of our visit thanks to our guide.

This tour was amazing! Our tour guide Ivana was brilliant and she made the experience easy and very informative. She was very thorough and explained what we would do & where we would go etc. She was also able to answer questions at ease, and it really made the exhibits come alive for the tour group. This museum is fascinating and we really enjoyed all of it. We will be back!
I would 100% recommend this tour. It is well worth the money.
Merci beaucoup Ivana! :)

Our tour guide was amazing! Best tour we have been on. She shared great insight, stories to keep us engaged, and I would highly recommend this tour! You simply shouldn’t go through the Louve without this tour. It also lets you skip the line and below me, that line is long!

A tip: tell your taxi driver to drive to the Louve, not the Arc de Triomphe Carousel that it says on your directions. We ended up at the main Arc de Triomphe ( over a mile away) and had to find another taxi to get us there in time!

Great tour of the Louvre. Alex was very funny and informative. We saw all of the highlights and Alex provided context that made what we were seeing come to life. The length of the tour was perfect for us, and we left feeling like we had seen everything we had wanted.

If this is the first time going to paris or the louvre, definitly do this tour! We had so much luck with Adam the tour guide. Adam takes you right in and leads you thru the Louvre like it's his backyard. Good informed and with a laugh, 3 hours flew by. We loved the tour and learned a lot, thanks to Adam.

This was a really great tour. Our tour guide, Alexander, was awesome. He was very knowledgeable and interesting. He provided a lot more information than some of the other guides we saw at the louvre. He was also very accommodating to everyone's needs while on the tour. Very happy with our experience.

Violet was fabulous.She was a great English speaking tour guide. She was very knowledgeable and spoke with enthusiasm. She even remembered everyone’s name in our tour group! These two girls from the states would highly recommend her to all of our friends.

Claire guided our small group throughout the Louvre and answered our questions fully and patiently. She couldn't have been nicer and she contributed greatly to the overall experience. The Louvre itself was amazing, but definitely crowded. I recommend being there for the earliest tour of the day, as it starts busy and only gets worse. Seeing hundreds and thousands of years of history is always fun.

We toured the Louvre yesterday with Claire. What an amazing experience! Claire is a very knowledgeable and enthusiastic guide. We saw so much more than we would have on our own. I highly recommend this tour to anyone going to the Louvre, especially if this is your first visit.

This tour was a good length, we got to see a lot of different wings. It was very nice to be able to skip the line -- the lines were so long that even the lines with tour groups were longer than normal, so skipping the general line was definitely a plus. Our tour guide was knowledgeable too.

Daniel the Irish Guy was great. The Louvre tour was very interesting, informative and at the same time was fun. Daniel really knows his stuff and contributes his own experience and interest in a genuine and enthusiastic way. It was not rushed and did not try to cram in too much, it was just right. The tour flowed effortlessly and we were.sad when it came to an end. We highly recommend Daniel and City Wonders.

This was one of my husbands bucket trip places to visit. We had a great time and the guide was very knowledgeable and had a since of humor that kept our attention span. If this is your first time visiting Paris or the Louvre, I recommend you do this tour.

Claire was amazing!! Such a nice guide who navigated us through the hectic Lourve. She provided so much great insight. The Lourve was super crowded and hot when we went in August, so plan accordingly for that. It was nice to not wait in the crazy long line although there was still some waiting. I think that was due to visiting in August. Definitely recommend booking this tour!

I was very cautious navigating the many stairs. Our guide knew we were struggling to keep up as he approached us to discuss the matter. We thought he would be more aware of our presence. He ditched us leaving us to find our way out of the maze. The experience was a nightmare.

Adam (a.k.a. Team Adam) exceeded all expectations. If you are in Paris, this is a must tour but only with Adam. He is amazing and provided such great detail, insight, and perspective. He not only worked at the Louvre, but he is also a PhD. We learned so much and he made sure that we saw the best of the Louvre. WOW!!! Best ever!!!!!!!!

Aren’t these tours always about the guide? Ours, Claire, was superb. Art history and French student, Brit has lived iin Paris for 10 years. Lively, engaging, all sorts of fun facts we’d never get from self-guided. We loved.

We visited in mid-June. It was extremely crowded in the Louvre and very hot. Too unpleasant to enjoy or appreciate the art. Also, our tour guide Kenny, with City Wonders, was not great, to say the least. Sorry Kenny.

We arrived to the tour before it started (due to the delay in transport because of the strike). The blonde lady with nose ring would not check us in and told to stand aside and wait. She then let our tour go and told us that our tour had already left and that we should come back next year??? The company refused to give a refund or let us join another tour that day. We were treated horribly and I cannot recommend this company. It’s my understanding that this happened to another family as well. Very disappointing. Beware when dealing with this company!!

Had a great day with friends, and it was made even better by our tour guide Josephine. She was so kind, knowledgeable, and made sure to remember everyone's name. She told great jokes and made me feel very comfortable and at ease. I actually have PTSD and usually have a hard time in crowds, but because she was so confident and accommodating, it was a fantastic tour. She really knows her stuff!

In order for this tour to improve the tour guide needs to show up!!!!!!! We waited an hour. No one came. Called office and was told guide was on his way. Obviously not. Really really disappointed. We’re from the United States so this was a once in a lifetime for us.

We have just finished our tour leaded by Viollette and need to say she is absolutely amazing. The most wonderful, funny, educative tour in my traveling life. After loads of my experience from all over the Europe, f.e. Rome or Barcelona, Louvre and Viollette is completel bombastic combination. Thanx again!

Fun tour with a pleasant guide. Nice introduction to the Louvre. Much better than standing in line to purchase tickets and then wandering around on our own. Skip the lines. Guided tour, then hand around as long as you want to see anything else you want.

The tour was great. Due to the weather, we were lucky to have a sal group. Our host was knowledgeable, had a great sense of humor, and tried her best to answer all of our questions. The tour was informative and entertaining and the 3 hour duration flew by. I would highly recommend this tour.

We toured with Adam with Citywide Tours. Super knowledgeable, interactive, remembered everyone by name throughout the tour. We initially questioned whether or not to use a guide but we would have been lost if we hadn’t. We not only got to see some of the worlds finest art, but also learned a lot. When we come back in the fall, we will definitely book another tour with Adam. #TeamAdam #AphroditeDeMilo

Team Adam!!!!!!!!!!! Adam truly made the experience. I walked away learning so much and truly how to appreciate art. Adam is more than knowledgeable, has an outstanding sense of humor, and is fully engaged with everyone in the group! Cannot wait to have Adam do our next tour!
Lazaro and Sarah
Tampa, Florida
❤️

Penelope was a fantastic guide. She got us right into the museum without any wait. She knew her way around to see all of the major art pieces. We were even able to finish ahead of time since the crowds were not big. I would highly recommend this if you have never been to the Louvre.

We booked a tour for The Louvre because it,s just so big. We didn’t want to have information overload, and wanted to see the highlights. The tour was about 2 hours, which ended up being perfect. Our guide, Addy was amazing. She added a lot of background and color and we saw a lot of things that weren’t “must see” but were still fabulous.

Highly recommend !

Seriously could not recommend this tour more. Our tour guide Addi was AMAZING!!! She was so knowledgeable and interesting! This girl knows her stuff! She really kept our group engaged. 1000% recommend her as the guide and taking this tour to see the Louvre!

Had a terrific tour this week. Anastasia was our guide and she was FABULOUS! She is extremely knowledgeable and her passion for the Louvre was obvious. We were a party of 4 from USA that did not speak French. Anastasia was very articulate and easy to understand her English. Highly recommend!

Well, we didn't enter the museum (very long queue,) but it was definitely the best museum design anywhere on the planet. The museum, was architecturally brilliant, and was also very clean, as well as the 2 pyramids accompanying the main one. Brilliant view

I did not take the tour. I could not locate the office to pick up the tickets and when my party arrived at the Louve my group had left. The person at the Louve pretty much said thats too bad. I had two small children and this was do confusing to me.
There was one employee at the Louve that was awesome and sympathetic. She took me to the location to purchase tickets for entry into the museum. Yes I had to purchase additional tickets.

Group was a bit large, also waited well past start time for late arrivals. I would suggest having late arrivals brought to the group which is underway. The guide was great and extremely knowledgeable.

Brits beware - do not book this tour. We had booked a 2 night stay in Paris to see the Louvre. Operator cancelled just as we were on the Eurostar arriving in Paris. They made no effort to organise tickets without the tour.

First time going to the Lourve and our guide was Adam. He is very knowledgeable and has great jokes throughout the guide which makes the tour, that much more amazing. I would recommend reserving Adam as your guide. 5 star. He doesn’t mind answering all your questions.

We did a family tour of the Louvre with Adam from City Wonders. It was absolutely outstanding. Adam is so clever, knowledgeable and entertaining. Everyone from my 85 year old mother to my 14 year old twins had a fantastic time. 3 hours went by so quickly. Couldn’t say enough good things about this tour - well worth the time and cost. Adam, you’re the best! Thank you!!!!

The tour was really really good. The meet up was easy to find and on time. Alex was very nice , fun, and very informative. Be moved at a great pace. I’ve always wanted to go to the louvre I am so happy I did it this way. I would definitely recommend this tour.

Great tour with guide Laura Peteiro. She was informative, upbeat with a great sense of humor. Fourth time at the Louvre and learned new facts.
Great tour that covers the top works. Recommended.

It was pretty chaotic at Louvre. A skip-the-line guided tour was very helpful, so we appreciated that. The guide could be better, felt a bit rushed everywhere. I wish he could have pointed out more significant pieces and explained the story better.

Excellent ...The tour guide was absolutely fabulous, the drama was before to be able to find the location, remember we are tourism we don't not the area .. and everyone that tries to help is given or have the wrong information. Please be more specific.
The Carrusel is more than one in the area.

We skipped the line and spent 3 hours experiencing the Louvre highlights. We highly recommend City Wonders. Our guide Claire made the experience perfect. Thank you for a very informative, enjoyable experience.

Thierry was an excellent tour guide. In 3 hours he showed us the best of the Louvre! Our favorite was the remains of the old castle moat foundation (who knew it existed?). Thierry’s knowledge of art and history amazing and his presentation was to notch. This is the best way to see the Louvre if you don’t have a lot of time.

We had the very best tour guide anyone could ask for.
Anais was patient and answered all our questions. She
knew so much about everything we looked at. The museum
itsself is so much more even than we expected.

I didn’t realize how enormous the Louvre Museum was until we arrived. WOW! Thank goodness we booked the guided tour because we would definitely get lost trying to find anything there. So many famous pieces of history in one place, it was an experience we will never forget.

Very good. Take this guided tour as you have less time and too much to see. Good to have a guided tour who can show you all the must see art. My guide Catherine was brilliant and English speaking. You will know the intricacies and history behind each important artifacts.

Violeta was my tour guide and definitely the most engaging guide I’ve had. She took special care to remember everyone’s names and gave an amazing and interesting tour. Thanks for welcoming us back to france, Violeta!

Got an email about 18 hours before the tour to say it was cancelled. No reason given and after booking well in advance. Supposed to be one of the highlights of the trip and it was ruined. Wouldn’t trust them again to actually come through in the future. Let’s see if we get our refund…..

Simply the best tour during a recent visit to Paris. Our guide, Adam, hit it out of the park. On time, a walking encyclopedia of information, and all presented in an upbeat and entertaining style. A total highlight!

We.were.unable to meet the guide. When we went to the office to pick-up our entrance tickets. They refused because it was a group tour. Our group of 5 never got into the Louvre. $344 lost because we couldn't find the guide.

Very informative tour! We learned so much about the history of the Louvre. Had no idea it was both a fortress & a palace prior to the art being brought here. Addy was our tour guide & she was fantastic! Lots of great insight, wonderful attitude & a sense of humor.

Awful, not helpful. Got there group wasn’t able to be found . At the louvre employees not helpful . Called the customer service unable to accommodate us . Do not recommend . Cheaper to pay at the museum and no line to Mona Lisa

No message from operator the day before & no guidance at all especially for a first timer in Paris. Missed this experience because instructions were not clear & operator did not reply to my queries. No refund from that bad experience too! Save yourself money & book another tour

Quick but thorough tour of the museum highlights. Logistical complication meant we waited a bit at the start. Unclear where precisely we were meeting, but we found the group by asking around. Some small areas to be improved on, but overall a good way to visit! So nice to skip the line!

We so enjoyed the tour and especially skipping the long lines. We felt like VIP’s with our knowledgeable and gracious guide Claire. She’s the best! We really feel like we saw the most significant areas of the Lourve.

Tour started on timeas advertised.
Julia was our excellent guide. The tour was certainly worth the cost.
Saw everything we wanted to see with excellent and witty explanations. The 3 hours flew by.Helpful information at the end re onward travel and eatries .

The five stars is for our tour guide Anna she was fantastic. Extremely knowledgeable and we learned alot about the lourve itself. We did have trouble finding out tour group at the beginning. Summer was our tour guide - who without question was utterly outstanding. We couldn’t have asked for a more knowledgable, kind, helpful and deeply informed presenter. Her clarity and depth of historical knowledge was mind blowing, and made the whole experience a total joy to behold. Thank you!

Very nice and absolutely interesting tour. Our guide was such a pleasure to listen to. She even knew the name of everyone of us (20) throughout the tour. I learned so much without being bored (as I am not a ‚museum type of guy‘).

I was so excited to do the Louve but overwhelmed at the size of it. Our tour guide Manny truly gave us the best tour ever! We got all of the highlights and soooo much history. Manny is funny and knowledgeable! After the tour he gave us so many fun tips about Paris.

Worse tour ever!! Where do I start? Not only did we waste 3 hours and $300 but we were not able to enjoy the museum on our first trip to Paris!

We were asked to come at 6:15 and we were there. When we got there, we stood around for 45 minutes with no direction. It was entirely disorganized, some people walked away in frustration and crying children and the freezing cold. Apparently one of the guides did not show up. We finally were given a guide and an additional 9 people from another group. We got inside at 7:15, with a little over 2 hours left until the museum closed. Our guide, Silvie with City Wonders Tour Company (very sweet lady), spent 1.5 hours in the old foundations of the mote talking about the history of the building. We were left with about half hour for the art. Yes we saw the Venus de Milo and the Mona Lisa but that was about it. I wish we had skipped the tour, bought our own tickets and enjoyed the art that we came to enjoy. Silvie was knowledgable but did not discern if it was important or not. The headsets they provided failed to work properly. She gave a lot of information but was not enthusiastic about the art itself. We did not even get to see much art. We only had enough time to go see the two star pieces. We were hoping to save time and get someone who loved art to guide us through the museum. Neither of those were achieved.

I am so sorry we did this tour. We wasted precious time in Paris and are leaving disappointed that the opportunity to see art at the Louvre was lost.

Let me start by saying that I am not an art guy... add to that the thought of fighting your way through crowded lines to visit an art museum and a trip to the dentist almost sounds better. But when in Paris, you’re almost bound to go to the Louvre so I booked this online for my wife and I and I am so glad I went.

Check in is a breeze - you meet at the Arc du Carrousel, right across the street from the Louvre and you’re placed in your tour group (ours had 25). Everyone is given a radio with an earpiece and the tour guide talks as you go through the museum. The “skip the line” part of this tour is no joke - you skip the ticket lines and while there is a mandatory security check everyone goes through, our tour guide, Daniel (the Irish-American) has been touring groups through the Louvre for three years and knows the hidden shortcuts the average tourist would never figure out. Note: this feature alone was great because it saved time.

More impressive, however, is how knowledgeable and informative Daniel was. He was able to explain the history of the museum, in addition to providing background on the artists, the various pieces of work and how they were obtained. I’m sure this information is available if you google it but who really wants to do that while they’re on vacation? I know that without a tour guide, I’d look at a piece of art, maybe take a photo and then move on without really understanding the significance of the piece. This is where the real value of this tour is - having a knowledgeable individual educate in a non-boring way. The entire tour lasted about three hours and you will do a lot of walking - according to my Fitbit, we logged approximately 7500 steps on the tour. There are sections where you can sit down but be prepared to log some steps. It would be a good idea to take a bottle of water with you as well.

I’m certain that someone who really appreciates art could spend days in the museum but for the average tourist who wants to take in one of the most popular sights in Paris, this tour is totally worth it. You’ll see the Venus de Milo and the Mona Lisa but so much more; the real value is having the history and background of the art pieces explained which left me with a greater appreciation for what I was looking at. I’d book this tour again, for sure.

We sent on this tour and the Louvre was completely overcrowded. It made it difficult to hear our guide even with the ear piece on full volume. Too much noise from the crowds, and so many people that we lost sight of our guide several times.

It was much too hectic for us, and as a result we left the tour after two yours (this was a three-hour tour). We spoke to other people in our group and they had a much better experience picking a time after 5 pm. Much fewer people at that time. Next time I am in Paris, this is what I will do.

The hype surrounding the Mona Lisa was way over the top. It was like feeding frenzy, people pushing and shoving to get a better vantage point for a photo of a painting that is housed behind thick glass and is much smaller than you would realize. Better to get a good postcard replica, take a photo of that if you must. It was ridiculous to see and experience, and we did an immediate about face to get away from the crowd.

Amazing tour and guide. Lilly was sweet, informative and very personable. I highly recommend this tour. So much to see and so many pictures to take. Wear comfortable shoes as you will be walking alot.

I have been on many tours throughout Europe, and I have never had an issue until booking the skip-the-line tour through City Wonder Ltd. My family and I arrived at the designated meeting spot 20 minutes prior the departure time per the instructions in the Viator email. It was very chaotic scene with many people and many tour groups. Unfortunately, none of the tour groups had signs (despite the Viator email that specifically states “Our City Wonders representative will be holding a City Wonders sign for easy recognition.”). My daughter and I then proceeded to frantically run around trying to find the City Wonder tour group, which we never located.

In the process of trying to figure out where the City Wonder group was, we ran into at least seven other people who were also on the 10:30 a.m. tour on Friday, May 20. At least three of people we ran into said they had been there since 10 a.m. and were unsuccessful in locating the tour guide. At this point, at least seven members of the 10:30 a.m. tour group stayed together and tried to figure out what was going on. We were going to see, since there were so many of us, if City Wonder would send a tour guide, and we could go as a group.

My husband called the City Wonder phone number as did at least two to three other couples we were with. The German couple who was in our group told us City Wonder said they would send an email with an update. When my husband called, he was told our tour guide was there, we never checked in, and we were out of luck. In the process of trying to figure out where the 10:30 a.m. tour guide was, there was an 11 a.m. group who was in the same predicament. It was now 11:30 and their tour guide was a no show. They were eventually told their tour guide called in sick and there would be no replacement. All told, we stayed at the meeting destination from 10:15 a.m. to 11:30 a.m. When City Wonder told us we were out of luck, we then decided to go stand in line for another hour to get into the Louvre.

There are many things that bother me about this entire situation. City Wonder basically gas lighted us, making it seem like they were there and had made themselves highly visible. Perhaps I could believe this if it weren’t for the fact that we talked to several people who had been there since 10 a.m. trying to locate said guide.

Also, the directions in the Viator email are not accurate. Upon reading the many 1-star reviews left by other people and seeing the response left by City Wonders, there are some major gaps in directions/instructions. First, as mentioned previously, there was no City Wonders sign. Had there been, I could have easily located it and gone to the tour guide. In City Wonders response to some of the bad reviews, they say their tour guides have blue polos, so they are easily recognizable. The Viator email doesn’t make mention of this dress. And, I never saw anyone in an outfit I could recognize as a “uniform.” More importantly, what I pieced together from reading the many complaints is the departure time is actually 10:15 a.m. from the Arc du Carrousel. The email from Viator says the departure time is 10:30 a.m. and that one should arrive 15 minutes early. This is a major oversight in explanation. From what I can piece together, there is a strict 10:15 departure time from the Arc du Carrousel, and the tour starts at the Louvre at 10:30. So, telling people to arrive there at 10:15 and that the departure is at 10:30 a.m. is inaccurate. Plus, in our case, it doesn’t account for the other people on our tour who had been there at 10 a.m. trying to find this mysterious guide.

We, along with the seven other people I mentioned previously, were out money and time with a complete denial from City Wonders. I would never recommend them to anyone. If you are able to take the tour, it sounds like it was nice. Unfortunately, we weren’t so lucky.

Perhaps the best tour I have ever had the pleasure of going on. Our guide, Felix, took us right into the museum, no waiting (although crowds were light at the time). I asked him on a few occasions about different works that we were passing but that were not part of the highlights tour and he knew the works intimately and was able to answer all questions and provided additional insight. Felix may be the most knowledgeable tour guide I have ever met.

This was an absolutely incredible tour and we are thrilled that we got to go on this!!

Highly recommend.

I will be back!

Excellent guide, Katrina! Made it an awesome experience. Her knowledge was amazing and just a lovely person to be around. LOVED the Louvre and all we learnt! Even with a National Strike going on.

When I started planning my trip to Paris, a visit to the Louvre was really high on my “to do” list but due to the size of the museum I was rather reluctant to do so on my own. Which proved to be a wise choice for several reasons…
1. Due to the ongoing strikes, it was to be decided on the same day whether the museum would open or not. If I hadn’t opted for the guided tour I am not sure I would be able to receive the constant updates on the museum’s decisions and I would most probably have been discouraged to try getting inside.
2. Even though for the museum’s general standards there were relatively few visitors, objectively speaking there was still a lot of people trying to get inside. Hence the fact that we got in from a different entrance (dedicated only to guided tours) and that we didn’t have to queue, was extremely convenient!
3. Our guide (lovely Sylvie) made our 3H tour really interesting and fun at the same time. She knew very well what she was talking about, all the information and tiny details she gave us made our tour fascinating, she managed to keep us interested by constantly asking us questions and by inciting us to share with her as well as everyone else in the group any possible questions we may have, she pointed out interesting facts about the museum and the exhibits, she gave us useful tips in case we wanted to continue our visit to the museum after the tour… and all that by maintaining her calmness, her reassuring tone and her enjoyable sense of humor throughout the tour.
Overall, especially if someone is a first time visitor, this guided tour is highly recommended!

There were many stairs and that became a little difficult toward the end. We so apreciated being able to "skip the line" as the crowds were huge and waiting in line would have been almost impossible.

This museum is so impressive! Our tour guide was professional and focused on the highlight pieces of art. However the tour had stairs and my husband and I had to lift our stroller up and down. So bring a baby carrier instead! The tour itself is tiring because its 3 hours long so it you want the highlights do this tour but don't plan on seeing everything in the museum that would take a long time! Also the tour does not use the elevators with larger groups.

Daniel was extremely entertaining, funny, witty and knowledgeable. He expertly escorted us through the throngs of people at the Louvre and never lost track of any of the members of the group. He made a sincere effort to personalize the tour and to remember who we were. Instead of just throwing facts at us which we could probably Google on our own, he spun stories, created atmosphere and told tasteful jokes about his subject matter, which was well received. We have been on a few of these tours and Daniel stands out as the best tour guide we have ever had.
Laura was an excellent tour guide who is extremely knowledgeable about the Louvre and the art work contained within.

I enjoyed this tour. Initially I had concerns that we may be unable to see the Mona Lisa, due to the reported long queuing time, as it has been relocated temporarily. However, our tour guide was able to get us in. It still took about an hour to see the Mona Lisa.

Our tour guide was informative, shared insights about key pieces in the Louvre as well as French culture, which we found helpful and engaged the group with questions and humour. We stayed on after the tour to take a bit more time, viewing the art work.

Definitely got more out of the Louvre as a result of this tour, than if we had done this alone.

So Mariam was really knowledgeable but we were all falling asleep and we were all meaning more than there was about 24 people in the group for gave her the headphones and left and then my husband and I did the same thing we couldn’t take it anymore she was focusing on minimum things and maybe him speaking a lot about things that we might not want to cover being such a large museum we thought she was gonna cover small small parts of sculptures and just run by I would not repeat this tour or maybe not with this particular tour guide we saw other tours going by superQuick and we were still in the first sculpture a lot of people were dizzy from the heat and we just decided to leave because she skipped the Mona Lisa and then ended up at the Mona Lisa where there was a huge line and we had already been there for three hours so it doesn’t make sense for people traveling with such a small amount of time available within the trip would not
Our guide Christina was very knowledgeable and led us expertly through the Louvre. I highly recommend this one.

Okay,, so every American who goes to Paris has a couple of things they have to do. They have to go to the Eiffel Tower at night so they can watch it flicker. (Don't forget to buy your "flickering tower model" from one of the many street vendors set up on blankets in the park surrounding the Eiffel Tower). Having done that - your one remaining obligation is to do the Louvre Tour and see the Mona Lisa. Now my wife and I have done Disneyland and Disney World with our kids, and frankly, I would do almost anything to avoid a multi-hour wait in a line for anything. Therefore, the "Skip the Line" tour sounded perfect to me. I signed up months before we left for France, and must admit that I had second thoughts in the weeks before we left. I have had a couple of bad experiences with Viator (Trip Advisor's Excursion Arm) this year. (Note: my complaint is not that the excursions are not good, they generally are very good, but there is a major disconnect between Trip Advisor and the customer - they tell you in your excursion confirmation that you can cancel for free 24 hours in advance - but when you try to do it online, their website tells you that there are no excursions listed - it generally goes down from there - there is a phone number you can call to cancel - but they don' t post it on there website (btw: it is 1-800-680-1640). But I digress. Out of three excursions that I had arranged for in Paris - I canceled two, and kept this one. I am glad that I did. The instructions for joining the tour were clear and explicit - "Get to the Louvre and meet the tour at the Arch in front of the Louvre entrance by 11:30 a.m." So even I could find the Louvre (our hotel was about an hour down the street by foot). We got to the Arch at 11:30 a.m. and there was a guy from City Wonders (had his little flag held up in his hand). Within 20 or 30 minutes the various groups of people had been organized into compact little groups with a tour guide fluent in their particular language. Our tour guide was a young man, who looked as though he had come from "Central Casting" - his name was Alex. As he explained it, in exceptionally clear English, he was French (half French and half Welsh) and had lived in France his entire life. In his own words, it was a fluke of nature that he spoke English so well, and he apologized for not speaking English with a French Accent. He was one of the best tour guides that I have ever had for a museum tour. He was exceptionally knowledgeable and had a good sense of humor for the entire three hour tour. He was also lucky - for the very day of our tour, was the first day that the Mona Lisa had been returned to its permanent home (it had been in another part of the Louvre for the last 6 months or so, and had been the subject of very long waits (1 1/2 to 2 hours). That day, we were able to see it within 15 minutes of arriving at its location in the museum. All through the visit he kept a running dialog on what we were seeing.
