The museum is massive, and he guided us through it like a pro, hitting all of the important art works within the three hours. This is a very good tour, and if you get the chance - ask for "Alex".

Our tour included only 2 couples and our guide was wonderful! So much to see and she made sure we saw all the highlights. When it was time to get in line for the Mona Lisa she was able to knock a 45 minute wait down to 15 minutes, leaving more time to discover the Louvre. This guided tour was the best money spent in Paris!
Our tour guide(forgot his name shame on me😓)(he was a shorter young French man). Anyways, he did an AMAZING job!!!! Very thorough, fun, and rant about stuff. My kind of tour guide. 🤗
Our guide Damian was very knowledgeable and had great stories. He kept a good pace and got us through all the key areas of this amazing museum.

I would recommend this tour, it provides you the opportunity to see the Mona Lisa, and learn the history of the Louvre Museum, my party had someone who walked with a cane, communication is not very good, providing best practices for someone who has a disability, but overall the tour was great.

Bought online tickets for this tour. Didn’t really know what to expect .. but was pleasantly surprised.. very specific, targeted tour of the Louvre which otherwise one would be lost in (coz it’s so huge).. Anastasia knew her subject well.. took us straight to see the Mona Lisa first.. thereafter, showed some interesting pieces of art and sculpture.. gave a good explanation of every painting/ sculpture.. all in all an interesting, well spent 3 hrs which otherwise would’ve extended to a whole day of aimlessly roaming around the museum.. 👍👍👍

Medical emergency made me leave Paris early. I had a turnaround of 4 hours and could not contact the company. My 8-week old grandaughter needed open-heart surgery. The Company's response was I did not meet the cancellation requirement of 24 hours.

I also booked the Paris Walking tour who sent a nice email and refunded my money.

We had Manuel as our guide and he was awesome!
He made the experience of waiting an hour to see the Mona Lisa enjoyable with his knowledgeable and wit.
Thank you!

We enjoyed the tour of the Louvre. Our tour guide addressed the Mona Lisa wait times in a professional manner with the group agreeing to not waste 2 hours waiting to see it. Instead we were treated to a fascinating tour of various works of art and sculpture with explanations as to the art form and technical detail.

We visited the Louvre with the amazing Nev! Wow what knowledge of art and the history of Paris and France she has. We were very lucky to see the Mona, Venus De Milo and Nike plus many other incredible works. We did this tour with kids and couldn’t finish the whole 3 hours - as they were too tired. 2 hours would probably be spot on for families with kids 😊

The Louvre is so big any tour will only give you a glimpse of the museum. Mona Lisa was the highlight but couldn't get too close & people are moved on very quickly so if you're hoping to get a selfie make sure you get in front. This is not the fault of the tour company. Our guy was very knowledgable & funny.
The Louvre was amazing. The museum was fantastic. Are tour was very knowledgeable and passionate about the history of Louvre. She was a great tour guide.

IF you're the kind of traveler who does your homework and knows what you want to see and what's not worth the long lines (yeah, the Mona Lisa), Skip the tour. Buy tickets online to skip the physical line. Plot your course through the museum in advance - maps available online. Pace yourself to linger at the exhibits that interest you. Otherwise, you'll be exhausted at the end of your three hours, pay exorbitant prices for food and drink while resting up, and have to drag yourself back (or forward) through the huge museum to satisfy *your* interests about which the guide knew absolutely nothing.

Having said that about the tour structure, two good points:
1. If "The Louvre" and a few famous works of art are on your bucket list so you can have "been there, done that," this is the perfect tour for you.
2. The guide we had (as are his colleagues, I'm sure) was vigilant to keep us all together, DID retrace his steps to pick up any stragglers who'd gotten "lost" as he said he would, advised us well on restroom use and buying water to stay hydrated for three very busy hours, and shared adequate knowledge about the exhibit highlights on the tour.

Full disclosure: We handed in our headsets and left the tour halfway through when we realized it wouldn't cover our primary interests. The guide was understanding and kind about that.

It was great to use this skip the line option and having a guide walk us through the history of the museum and it’s artwork. My only complaint is the narrative was a bit long and it sometimes overly focused on certain pieces of art. After 3 hours without the opportunity for a break it was a bit much. But our guide was so informative.

My mom and I went on this tour, it was my first Skip the Line experience and I look like a genius for booking it. We breezed passed the line and went directly to see the Mona Lisa which was lovely. Then we wandered a few other “must see” pieces. Our guide Alistair was excellent, knowledgeable and patient. He really made it a great experience.

Amazing side seeing place in and out, we really admired historic buildings all around loved the glass Piramits and the pool fountains fun to watch after the long walks relax sitting around it, try to see evening lights. We're there afternoon after sunset lights came up was beautiful specially Piramits all lights up spectacular view it was. We had a dinner at the Le Café Marley's terrace watching the this view of Louvre.By the way I recommend the Café.

The tour is worth the price as it gets you in quicker and gets you to the highlights. Be prepared for a very quick run through and over view of a limited selection of exhibits. Be advised the Mona Lisa Is like a 3 second see it and move along event. It's probably the most over-rated and most disappointing part of the Louvre. The rest of the museum is not too bad. Take the tour then after go exploring the museum on your own

Tour guide was knowledgable but make double sure you identify what you want to see. If you dont you will spend a lot of time discussing the history of the Louvre and architecture and not necessarily what you're there to see. We got an hour and a half tour for $450 which I think was very expensive for what we got.

I found the beginning a little disorganized. The tour guide gave us a break at the very beginning where one of our party went missing, other party members were late and the last 2 hrs 45 minutes there were no breaks. About 40% of our tour didn’t stay for the whole thing . I found some of the stuff she said interesting but I think I would have rather just done it at my own pace with breaks etc. I am not sure how long the line is to get in so that may have saved some time. I will recommend that someone not take the tour and just go at their own pace.

We met outside the museum and received our audio equipment for the tour. We proceeded into the underground entrance under the giant pyramid. Following our tour guide we still had a wait in lines of folks heading to see the Mona Lisa. The advantage of the tour was that through out the wait (as we meandered through the museum) the guide provided us with insights into the museum and specific info about the Mona Lisa. We were given enough time to take some pictures at the painting and though you are processed through the space fairly quickly to accommodate all the people, it seemed to be adequate. The only complaint that I would have was that our guide 's style of presenting information was to have us "guess" answers to questions she would ask about the art we were viewing. Instead of telling us what she wanted us to know she continued to have people guess! This became more annoying as we nearer the end of a 3-4 hour tour! We got to see wonderfully famous works of art and though the museum was crowded, it wasn't overwhelming! As a tip: large bags are not allowed in the museum but there are free storage lockers on the lower level of the welcoming center!

The tour was great and very well organized. Link up was easy under the monument in front of the Louvre. Our guide took us to the Mona Lisa first since that is the most popular. The place gets packed so try to take a morning tour. My only complaint is that the guide sat and talked for 15-20 minutes in front of one painting telling this long history. For a 3 hour tour there isn’t time for that....let me see as much as possible and talk and walk with short summaries. Standing around killed my back.

The Louvre is indeed massive but our guide Alex ( from Scotland) knew which routes to take to experience the most desired art we would want to see.

I would highly recommend Alex.

For a first time visit I thought this would be helpful- and boy was it. Love skip the line and get right in and then have someone show you around. Our guide was so knowledgeable and answered all our questions - she truly was an art buff! You could tell how much she enjoyed giving tours and all the art on display. Well worth the money.
We had Fab for our guide and she was not just informative but very friendly too! Glad we did this tour.

We genuinely did skip the line with the guide physically holding back the queue! It was good to get the Mona Lisa early and then the rest was targeted and efficient highlights. At 3 hours it felt we saw a great deal and though it was more expensive it’s well worth the time saving to be guided and given insight. This was done with earphones so that you were free to look around nearby while not missing any of the detailed information. The Louvre is so vast I would highly recommend this for your first visit to get bearings. You may not come back but if you do it means you can then go to deeper layers.

We arrived early for our tour and asked at the entrance of the Louvre for directions on where to go. We were sent across the street on the other side of the Louvre. We were redirected three different times and completely missed our tour. So disappointing.

When you are limited on time, this is a great service. We saw all the major displays of art and sculptures. During the tour alarms began to blare and it appeared that we were going to have to evacuate without seeing the Mona Lisa. But our guide expertly navigated the huge museum to get us there. It was a false alarm but we had comfort in knowing our guide was in control.

I dont do lines, therefore do yourself a favor and skip the long line during the summer and especially on weekends. We where inside the museum under 30 seconds, pretty fast and got so the Mona Lisa in under 10 minutes before the lines started to get longer, lol lines?

Absolutely fantastic.
Felix our guide was amazing and so knowledgable. We got to see everything which you go to the Louvre to see.
I totally recommend this to everybody money well spent.

Manny was an informative and entertaining guide who was also very considerate of his group. Although we started a few minutes late, we hit many of the highlights in this huge and very crowded museum. Well worth the expense to save time and hassle while learning. Wear comfortable shoes!
Definitely worth the money. Our guide was terrific, very knowledgeable not only about the various pieces of art but also about the history of the palace buildings that now form the Louvre.

The museum is extensive. With the Summer crowd the skip the line with the tour guide was a great option. Still be prepared to lineup like airport security as you enter the museum. It is a three hour tour . You will see the Mona Lisa but security will keep the line moving. You can stop and take your pictures but be ready to take those pics and move along..

I cannot say enough great things about this tour!! Our tour guide, Violette, was nothing short of amazing! She has a masters degree in art history, so she is very well educated on various pieces in the museum. She was very kind, upbeat, and was engaging with all members of the group. She was not afraid to “stick up” for our group when we were cut in line by other tourists. She ensured everyone was together and that no one was left behind, which I greatly appreciated. We only waited in line for approx 30 mins when entering the museum which is much better than the 1-2hr line outside. Definitely worth the money and I will book this tour again when in Paris!

We booked a private tour of the Louvre with City Wonders 2 months in advance, and then 2 days before our tour the company called us to cancel. We were very upset and asked them to reschedule for the following day, which was then also canceled.
So rude. No care for their customers.

The process for getting entrance to the Louvre was seamless and our guide was very interesting and knowledgeable. Considering it was the height of tourist season and the hottest day in the history of Paris, it was as good as possible. Our guide seemed to truly love the Louvre and passed that passion onto us in his guidance.

I've been to the Louvre before, but this was the first time on a guided tour. Our guide, Laurent, did a nice job showing us the highlights while navigating the crowds and fielding questions. We got a bit delayed at the start with the Mona Lisa being temporarily moved and a member of the tour requiring special accommodations for a mobility impairment, but our guide did his best to meet everyone's needs. Learned a lot. Even our teenage niece enjoyed it.

I signed the family up for a 3 hour private tour and i was apprehensive that the length of the tour would be too much for my teenage daughters. I couldn't have been more wrong. We were greeted on time at the meeting point by our tour guide Ruben (excellent English) who took us right into the Louvre. One entrance was very crowded with several large tour groups so he quickly moved us to a different entrance which saved us valuable time. Upon entering Ruben asked which areas of the museum were of particular interest to us. My wife has always enjoyed Egyptian art and artifacts so he started there. I liked that he inquired what was important to us. Overall I find it hard to imagine a better tour guide than Ruben. He knows the history of the museum itself as well as all of the exhibits. In reflecting on the tour, i feel like we had taken a class more than a tour based on the insight from Ruben. I highly recommend the 3 hour private tour (with Ruben) for those who want to learn more than just see.

The tour went ahead as advertised and met our expectations. The exception was the promised viewing of the Mona Lisa. Having moved the painting to a new location, the queues were phenomenal and the waiting time of between one and two hours could not fit within the parameters of the tour. All other aspects more than satisfactory. Our guide was very knowledgeable and efficient in moving us around. There was very little time lost to queueing or waiting, with the exception of the start. Other potential participants who have mobility issues should note that the tour involves many stairs, both ascending and descending.

It was our first time to Paris and we wanted some direction as others have told us that the Louvre was huge. Almost an understatement - it's cavernous! Our guide, Fabrizia, was amazing! She was full of energy, knowledge, and did a great job getting us around the very packed museum. A word to the wise, I met a lady the day before our tour that had her wallet stolen while at the Louvre - and now I know why! You are so absorbed at looking at everything around you, it's easy for the pros to get you. Please make sure to be aware of your stuff and surroundings at all times. Also. the skip the line was worth it!

Excellent guided tour that is worth the money. Our guide Fab was very knowledgeable and friendly. You skip the long lines and get highlights of most important artifacts. It would take hours on your own.

What’s a trip to Paris without visiting the Louvre? And the best way to visit is to skip the line. The tour hit the highlights but you can stay afterwards to go around on your own since there is so much to see. Definitely wear comfortable walking shoes.

Guide was very knowledgeable about the museum and the key pieces of art. I would recommend this to people looking to avoid crowds. While the louvre will always be crowded during busy seasons, our guide helped navigate through and show us things we would have missed otherwise

This was our first time to The Louvre and we wanted some history/context for the incredible art. The tour is very well organized, meeting across from the entrance, so we could meet our group and guide. Laura P was fantastic! She kept our group together and moving, as well as having a wealth of information about the museum and art work. Being able to skip the long lines and hear the story behind some great pieces of art make this a “must do”.
It was awesome not having to do the long lines. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable of the art he was showing us, but the tour it is not ideal for teens or young kids. Kids were getting bored.
Skip the line Louvre tour is well worth it! Hugo (our guide) was great and City Wonders company very organized

Our guide Fab was absolutely Fabulous! Her passion for the Louvre and the art pieces made our visit so much better (went on our own many years ago and this way with Fab was so much better(. Full of information and from Italy so she had lots of info that was way more helpful because she has studied the material and obviously loves it and we enjoyed our visit to the Louvre so much more this time!

Did this tour with my wife and 18 year old daughter, and it was nicely done. Normally I enjoy Natural Historical museums rather than art museums, but, hey, this was the Louvre!!

I can't remember the guides name, but she was from Serbia and finishing her masters in Art History. She was very easy to understand and was great at positioning herself in front of the important works we saw and explained them in detail.

We enjoyed viewing the Louvre and hearing the history of the building in addition to many interesting and informative facts during our visit. The pace was comfortable and in spite of the crowds in the Musee, Manny made sure we were able to see and appreciate primary artifacts. Highly recommend this tour with Manny!

We were pleased with the Louvre tour. Our guide Christina was very knowledgeable and provided excellent historical context to the Louvre itself and the art we viewed. We saw all of the top attractions. I would have preferred a little less time on some to allow more ground to be covered, but that is minor. The main criticism is the audio equipment, which failed several people and was a distraction.

Our tour guide Claire from England - she talked to all of us before hand and took an interest in where we were from and why we were here. Her leadership through the Louvre was fantastic. She took time to explain the backgrounds and history of both the big draws and even some lesser known ones. What I would really like is follow on tours, so this one would be Louvre 101, and maybe you could offer a 201 and 301 to get into the less touristy pieces. At the end she led us into the Napoleonic apartments which was a treat. Would definitely use her again, and well worth the money
Our tour guide was extremely informative about all areas of the museum. Anyone visiting Paris needs to make a stop at the Louvre. The buildings history itself is amazing.

This tour was easy, informative and convenient for viewing the Mona Lisa and other hidden gems. Fabricia was an amazing tour guide! She kept the tour moving, but gave us enough time to take in all the beautiful pieces of art including the famous Mona Lisa. She gave us such interesting facts on the the art and recommended lunch at loulou which was also amazing!! Highly recommend!

by go there you need to visit this place is amazing specially in this time of the year
also keep in mind to be there you need to visit a lot Paris is the place of beauty

You really skip the lines and the guide Yulia was fantastic! Great knowledge and comprehension of art and what is worthy! It was not my first visit to Louvre but a great way to review the great masterpieces! Not expensive, but 2 hs is a very short time for seeing so many things! Great for beginners and those who really do not have time

Great introduction and insight given by our guide Josephine. It makes the whole Lourve experience so much more meaningful. Likely to get lost in the sculptures and paintings and missing the important tidbits of history on show without a guide.

I've been to the Louvre before but was never really able to appreciate the famous pieces of art we can find alone in the museum. Felix, an historian teacher from Croatia, brought a whole new perspective where i got to actually appreciate details and historical context of several paintings and sculptures he walks us through. Felix did a masterful job keeping a group of 20 tourists completely immersed and interested during the entire 3.5 hours of the tour. Will do it again when i have my family with me!

Great tour for the price. Totally worth it. You do skip the line with no wait. You have to fight you way to the front row to see the mona lisa but the tour itself was great. Smooth and knowledgable. ASK FOR CAROLINA.

This tour was a highlight of our vacation!! I took my 16 year old daughter to Paris and she choose a visit to the Louvre as one of her priorities. This tour did not disappoint. Our guide, Rubin, was fantastic, knowledgeable, entertaining, accommodating, and catered to everyone the group. If I were you, I wouldn’t miss the opportunity to take this tour!!

Informative tour of the highlights of the museum, ideal for those spending a limited time in Paris looking for a brief overview of the Louvre’s famous paintings. Without this tour, you will easily spend two hours waiting in line to enter the museum, which can be unpleasant in the pouring rain. We were able to bypass the line and the tour guide quickly steered us towards the famous works that are always the highlight of any Louvre visit. Afterwards, the guide gave us helpful advice on navigating Paris, including some of the best local restaurants. This tour is ideal if you don’t want to waste your precious time in Paris standing in line and fighting crowds. The guide was also well versed in the different artistic periods and offered helpful insight to enable members of the group to gain meaningful knowledge into each piece. Well worth the cost.
Well worth the money...skipped a 3 hour wait in line. The tour operator was knowledgeable and entertaining.

My wife and I visited Paris for a long weekend, we decided to purchase skip the line tickets for the Louvre. There were 6 of us on the tour, guided by Ruben. Ruben was an excellent guide, he knew his stuff and was super friendly - he made sure we were always happy. The tour does have a lot of walking - so be prepared, the Louvre is massive and has so much to see and experience!

My mum and I booked a City Wonder Louvre Skip the Line Tour.

Claire was our guide - she was absolutely fantastic. I cannot rate the tour, the guide and value for money enough! The Louvre is such a colossal museum we really wanted to benefit from the main gems in the museum. Claire, and the tour, did not disappoint. Claire's enthusiasm and knowledge was unrivalled compared to many other tours we've done. Highly recommend if you want to get the best out of a relatively short period at the museum.

Highly recommend Claire - her passion and knowledge of art was truly admirable. She's inspired me to do a course on Art History and who knew the history of the fame of the Mona Lisa!!!

Viator/City Wonders - we'll be booking again in the autumn!!! Looking forward to seeing you again!

Our guide was Adam. He was so knowledgeable and very funny and engaging. Our children were with us and even they were completely engaged. Our trip to the Louvre would not have been nearly as amazing if we had not had Adam as our guide. I highly recommend it!

Great tour and a lot of fun. It was nice to get out of the outdoor elements and into the museum. The only slightly bad part were these large groups of Chinese folks that formed a mob outside of the popular exhibits. Mona Lisa was about 15 people deep and the only way to see it was to look through cracks in the crowd. These mobs leave and then another Chinese mob appears. I'm trying to avoid racism, but these folks make it difficult.

I have not been in Paris for several years and my wife and I went to spend her birthday there. We went to the Louvre using a tour we booked through Tripadvisor. The guides name was Felix and he was outstanding. The group had about 20 people in it and Felix made sure to talk with everyone. He had superb knowledge and went out of his way to show us pieces of art work that we would never have stopped to look at. I would recommend taking this tour and if you are lucky enough to have Felix as your tour guide you will be in for a treat.

We booked this tour because we wanted to see the Louvre highlights without getting lost. Well worth the money. Upon arriving at the Arc du Carousel the tour coordinator was there ready and organized. We were a large group and they divided us up. We were lucky enough to get Violette. She was fun right from the start. We started at the Fortress and worked our way. Going with a tour allows you to bypass a huge line and you get access to free lockers. But I digress.
Back to the tour. She told us stories and histories of the various art objects we saw...not just the biggies. She never rushed. She allowed us to take our time to get to the front of the more important pieces like the Mona Lisa. What was really nice was there was a man with a cane. She always made sure she walked slowly enough to keep up and when we stopped wherever possible made sure he got a seat.
I think this tour is the only way to see the Louvre and worth the money. I am sure all the tour guides are good but if you get Violette you are very lucky.

Our guide was Nevena. She was very knowledgeable, passionate and enthusiastic. Three hour passed just by. Three hour tour passed by just like that. We wished we had Nevena as our tour guide on every tour we have been on in Paris!

This is the way to visit the Louvre. This was our first visit to Paris and we had a limited days to see the top sites. Being able to skip the line and tour with someone who was knowledgeable about art and the lay out of the Louvre made the trip very enjoyable. Our guide, Ivonna, was very personable and her passion and expertise really highlighted the tour.

City Wonders cancelled our Louvre tour with no explanation and < 48 hours notice. With the clock ticking, we scrambled to find another tour - no easy feat for a popular museum like the Louvre. Ultimately, Babylon Tours came through with flying colors. We are still trying to get our money back from City Wonders.

We had two terrific City Wonders tours in Rome, but I cannot recommend their Paris service.

If you are going to Paris or Rome or any other place that offers tickets where you go and do not have to stand in line,,, I would say "IT is a MUST" There are so many tourists now travelling the world and bring family with them so lines can be very long...I bought tickets in Paris which included several activities besides museums and was able to go in very quickly.. This enables you to move faster and see more things.. I would not travel with out checking for these tickets.. They can be costly and you most likely will not use all of the activities but the ones you do ,,,, will be enjoyed better.

The guide was knowledgeable and took us to what appeared to be the most important works. We went mid morning on a Monday and I didn't think it was too crowded (except when seeing the Mona Lisa - which is only a small painting anyway). I was disappointed that Louvre doesn't do more to protect it's treasures (such as air quality control) instead of relying on touch-ups. Perhaps I expected too much.

We booked the extended group tour. Adam was our guide and he was incredible. He was charming, funny, and very knowledgeable about the subject matter. Adam encouraged interaction and questions, while asking the group plenty of his own to keep us on our toes. Our time at the Louvre was extremely satisfying with this tour. Adam was a big part of the experience.

This tour helps you see the highlights in a manageable way. Our guide was very thorough and asked us questions to keep the group involved. The tour started at 2:30 so if you plan to spend a few more hours in the Museum, take the earlier tour as the Louvre closes most days by 6. Our guide was nice enough to take my husband and me to the Napoleon apartments upstairs after the tour concluded.

Firstly, skip the line is the only way to go otherwise you will line up for hours. Secondly a small group is a good way to get around the Louve which is huge and there will be loads of people there. The best things about this tour company is that the guides are super knowledgeable about the museum and know the best way to get around to see the most important/famous pieces. We learned so much and it was actually more interesting than expected. We found the three hour tour plenty of time, although you could stay longer on your own if you wanted so do the am tour.

Our family of 3 children (16, 13, 11) and two adults had a morning tour. The best part was skipping the line. Several times I had to ask for the guide to speak up, as did other people in my group. I began to lip read but when he developed white saliva in the corners of his mouth I could no longer. We left the tour an hour early. I wish I could have heard everything he said. Many important pieces were overlooked. I wish I had done the individual audio tour instead.
As you make your way to the meeting point be careful of the youths with clip boards pretending to survey - they are common criminals and the local authorities should do something about keeping them away from Tourists.

Our guide, Erwan, met us outside the museum. We were scheduled to be a group of 6, but 2 did not show up. He waited about 5 minutes, and then took us to the entrance. They mean it when they say to arrive early, as the tours leave promptly. We visited this museum several years ago with a larger tour and a guide using a microphone while we all wore headphones. With Erwan and such a small group, we did not need anything, which made for a more comfortable tour. He was extremely well-informed and interesting. We appreciated that we could stop as long as we wanted to at various exhibits and see rooms that are not normally covered on larger tours. He took pains to see what we were interested in, and steered us to paintings and exhibits that took our interests into account. Skipping the long lines was certainly a big plus.

If you are looking for a way to skip the line and/or not have to navigate the Louvre on your own, then this tour might be for you. If you want to learn anything meaningful about the art in the Louvre then this tour is not for you. The latter point, of course, may depend on your actual guide - our guide just wasn't that interesting. The museum is overcrowded, but this would've been less of an issue if the tour was interesting.
We did a small group tour and it was well worth the cost. Our guide was knowledgeable and fun. The museum is so large, it was great to have someone lead us through the museum most famous exhibits.

I booked this tour as a recommendation from a friend. Great idea. I did months of research about Paris and the Louvre so I could try to make the most of my trip. There is no was we could have seen everything we did on this tour if we had tried on our own. The group size was not too big, the guide was fantastic and I learned so much beyond my own research of the art and artifacts. The only downside is because it’s a ‘Skip the Line’ tour you are not free to roam the rest of the museum after the tour ends, you would need to buy a ticket to the section(s) you would want to revisit. That policy may be due to the museum and not the tour guide company. Great way to see the museum favorites.

Find out when Adam is guiding! No better way to see the Louvre. We were in Europe for 4 weeks and did many tours. My husband was not really thrilled about "another one" but finished it saying "best tour in 4 weeks." This was all due to Adam and his intriguing lessons and stories about the pieces. He was SO knowledgeable. The 3 hours flew. Adam was so organized keeping us moving and making the most of every minute to take best advantage of such a large place. I wish we could have joined him on his Versailles tour the next morning.

My husband and I took the 3 hour tour on Wednesday, 5/16/18, beginning at 6pm and were fortunate to have Adam as our guide! My husband is not a huge fan of museums but he was being a dear and accommodating my wishes. Thanks to Adam's great engagement, humor and vast knowledge, my husband thouroughly enjoyed the experience and left him wishing Adam could accompany us to every museum we visited! The 3 hours flew by leaving both of us wanting more! Adam kept the small (15-20) group engaged and his sometimes irreverent humor has my husband and I in stitches to this day 😂! SASSY JEESUZ😂😂😂

We both highly recommend this tour. Skipping the line was great but the best part was learning so much from Adam and enjoying his awesome energy! Well worth the price. BTW- going Wednesday evenings is a good idea bc the museum is a little less busy.

We really enjoyed this Louvre tour!
Our guide Violet was awesome!! Energetic and very knowledgeable with lots of great details. Her English was terrific.
The skip the line worked well, and we were able to get in quickly.
The Louvre is huge, but I felt the Violet showed us the important highlights as in the tour description and then spent sufficient time explaining about the major art pieces. She answered questions well.

Ask for Adam- he kept my 12 year old son interested the entire time! I did not think he would make it through to the end. My son and I appreciated Adams enthusiasm, love for history and art, his charisma and his humor. Thank you Adam for bringing history to life for my son.

My 14-year-old daughter and I had dear Adam lead us on a three hour tour. He managed to keep her interested and giggling throughout. He is very knowledgeable and has interesting stories, backgrounds, theories, and insights (I'll never look at the Mona Lisa the same way!). There just is never enough time to cover all that is in there, of course. He was so interesting, the time flew by.

We couldn't have hoped for more on our tour. Our family of five (with 15, 13, and 9 year old) were kept engaged throughout. Adam was an outstanding guide. He packed in the "have-to's", but also put personal touches and gave insights on things that only come with his level of experience. Highly interactive too. Made you think about what we were looking at. Top notch.

My wife and I took a tour with a wonderful tour guide who provided us with a historical background to the Louvre and to the works of art inside. I recommend this tour to see the highlights of the museum - our group was 12 people.

The first stop, once inside via the tour group entrance is the rest rooms. Then we go through security and finally into the museum. We started with the castle itself walking through the moat and seeing the Egyptian sphinx. Then we started into the art walk. A few people wanted to see the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo and then leave. That was a mistake as it was an hour or two before we got to them.

It can be tiring but there are seats where you can sit and listen to the talk on your vox machine. The guide was entertaining and very informative. We were there on a Monday in November and took the afternoon tour. The museum was closing as we finished our tour. We had seen what we came for (the highlights) and were tired and ready to leave. The gift shops and restaurants were open for another hour or so if you wanted to shop or eat after the visit.

If you want to see more of the museum after the tour be sure to check closing time.

Babylon Tour LLC was the tour operator for our small group tour and Athena was our guide. Oct 30th 2017, we took the small group tour of the Louve. We chose the small group tour because we wanted to have the best chance to get the most out of the short time we had in Paris. Athena our guide was superb. Excellent knowledge. She gave us history, a wide variety of art spanning masters and unknowns. It was absolutely amazing. She is a jewel.

Having arrived at the Louvre main courtyard, we found a mass of people, all being directed by the Louvre security guards. At that point we were so glad we bought skip the line tickets. The guards reviewed the information on our tickets and promptly stopped the line, let us ahead of everyone else, and directed us into the Louvre where we found the Group Meeting desk. While not the meeting place indicated in the ticket, we thought the guards must do this all the time - right? and hey it's the Group desk so they must know something about the tour company and the tour we had selected. But NO - they had no idea at all. From arriving early at the Louvre, we realize we have been directed to the wrong location and by the time we would fight our way through the crowds to get to the correct location on our own, per the ticket guidelines we would be considered late.

But hey - our tour would have only just started outside and we were already inside the Lourve, so I called the customer service line to meet up with the other guests. I would have been on the phone for near 1 hour before finally giving up. One after the other, I spoke to 3 customer service representatives, and explained our situation. Each spoke with their supervisor, and were initially very supportive and thought they could connect my family with the tour group, but would place me on hold while trying to get hold of the tour guide. Each time the call was either dropped or hung up, so I would call back. I was told that policy means the tour guide must have their cell phone turned off when starting the tour. Great policy I say - they how do you contact the tour guide in the event of an emergency - we text they say - great can you text them now and get a meeting location for us. I was placed on hold and then after 20 minutes (on 3 occasions) a dead call. One customer service representative told me the supervisor approved a special offer for me to rebook at a 50% discount in 3 days time. This meant that not only would I forfeit the hundreds of dollars for today, I would be required to pay additional hundreds of dollars for a future date which I informed the customer service representative I would not be in the country; the response - there's nothing else we can do.

I sent a note to the tour company requesting a review of the circumstances and requesting a refund for a tour we tried so very hard but did not participate in. I received a quick email reply saying again - there's nothing else we can do.

So my feedback, no one knows anything about this tour company. If you intend to buy this tour just make sure you disregard any directions and controls from any Lourve guards and attendants, and be at the meeting spot way ahead of time. Otherwise you too will be out of pocket with a customer service representative saying - there's nothing else we can do.
The guide did not show up for the trip. We had to purchase another ticket and tour the Louvre without a guide. I would appreciate a refund for the trip.

Don’t waste your money! Horrible explanations and overpriced. Get there early purchase your ticket and get the audio guide for only $50 Euros for 2 adults and 2 teens. Children under 18 are free yet these people charge you. Do it yourselves. Save your money!

Fantastic
The museum is amazing, and our guide Severine was extremely entertaining, knowing the ins and outs to make a smooth navigation despite the crowds, and embellishing each item with her storytelling skills.
Relatively no waiting and guide was excellent. Very knowledgeable and made it fun and interesting with his stories and humor.
Very easy to find the meeting spot, the guide leader was well prepared and give us a lot of interesting information about the Eiffel Tower
We struggled to understand Natalia's English. Also wish she had surveyed the group as to if there was something particular we would like to see.

Visiting The Louvre , especially for the first time can be overwhelming. It was a pleasure to visit with a City Wonders group, skip the line, and have a knowledgeable tour guide. He provided details to some highlights in the louvre, as well as a history of the building as we entered. The tour was during the morning, so my daughter an I were able to find our own highlights in the afternoon. Our guide was amazing. He was knowledgeable, friendly, funny, and did a great job keeping our group together. He also had a knack for finding excellent viewing locations when he stopped at a piece to talk about it.
Tips: Arrive a little early so you are not stressed. Look for employees with City Wonders flags next to the arc. When they find your reservation, they will tell you where to wait for your guide. REMEMBER THE NAME OF YOUR GUIDE so you know you are in the right group. Wear comfortable food and clothing.

We are in Paris for one week. We receive a phone call less than 24-hours before our scheduled tour to inform us that “the tour is cancelled due to the guide’s illness.” No fault of the guide, but City Wonders left us ‘out-in-the cold’ with no backup plan to replace this once-a-lifetime experience (!). Oh, but they could reschedule for June 3. Wow! But we are leaving Paris on May 31.

City Wonders - no wondering from us: no matter the city to visit - we will NOT be using this company’s services ever again!
Was expecting a much more professional arrival experience for the price. Just met outside a random shop! Knowledgeable guide who took us to the right places.
Great way to see the Louvre and learn the deep background on some key works and the museum itself. Daniel the Irish guy was funny, attentive and informative, he really made the tour special.
Our guide was extremely informational and so sweet. She made everything so interesting. This isn’t the type of thing I’m typically interested in, but had to since I’m in paris. Glad I did it.

After coming home from my first trip to Paris, missing my Louvre experience with this group, it seems that i am not the only one who had the same issue finding the "meeting spot". I arrived at the Louvre on-time. I was looking around for a flag or some sign. asked the security people at the door, and they had no idea what i was talking about and said that my ticket was not the right ticket. Tried calling the number, but it would not go through. Def need to learn how to make phones in Paris before you go. i also had poor cell phone service(TMo), so I could not check the website. Only had my ticket loaded onto my iPhone Wallet. Pretty much could not find the group. No refund from City Wonders because it was my fault that I could not find the meeting location and read properly. So as an ADVICE to CITY WONDERS, ON YOUR TICKET THAT YOU SEND OUT TO YOUR CLIENTS,, PUT THE PROPER MEETING PLACE OR SOMETHING THAT STATES TO CHECK THE MEETING SPOT. Sometimes people will miss the fine print.

Ended up having to buy new tickets and wait to get in.

Advice to first time visitors. It was SUPER EASY to navigate the Louvre. They sell tickets on the LOUVRE website for set times to go in. Must book early before your trip. You can also rent a Nintendo DS 3D with headphones for 5 Euro that will help you navigate the museum and see the important pieces of artwork. they also have signs up at the Louvre to the Venus and Mona Lisa. EASY!

Would give 0 stars if it was allowed. Tour operator was not at meeting place. Went inside the Louvre for help they told us the meeting place was some place else. Tried to contact the tour company they never answered the phone. I would avoid this company on Viator or Travel Advisor they are nothing but scammers.

We booked a trip to the Louver museum in Paris and couldn’t find the tour guide. Instead of texting me like my other guides, there was no communication and we were out a LOT of money. We had to buy new tickets outside. I emailed them about this and they basically said tough luck no refunds. It is clear we didn’t redeem the tickets and are extremely unsatisfied with this business practice. Zero communication except to tell me “too bad.” Absolutely don’t recommend.

Anastasia was amazing!
She showed us all the “must sees” and much much more.
She is very friendly and personable and extremely knowledgeable about the art, sculptures, and the history of both as well! And also a good bit of French royal history!
We enjoyed the tour and we enjoyed Anastasia!

Book the Airbnb experiences version instead. This one is inflexible.

I had booked a similar tour through Airbnb and they were super accommodating, but then for scheduling reasons I had to book this tour through TripAdvisor instead. Big mistake. I was sick, tried to reschedule and nobody responded over email, WhatsApp, or the TripAdvisor app.

Finally I dragged myself there, got there 5 minutes late, and they had already left. I called, I eventually got connected to someone who was unable to give me the contact info of the actual guide - im sure I could have found her within minutes if they had given me her contact info or if she were able to call me.

This tour pre-purchases my louvre tickets. And they refused to even give me those tickets so I can at least recoup the ticket fee if not the tour fee.

Sigh. I just watched two days ago while a different tour waited almost 30 minutes for stragglers to show up. I was 5 minutes late.
Violette was highly knowledgeable that I asked for her calling card. She gave the most important information within 3 hours. Amazing!

We waited with about 20 other people outside the Louvre this afternoon for a tour guide that never showed up. This was our only time to be able to visit the Louvre. Viator and City Wonders could care less that our day was ruined. Who knows if I ever get back to see this in my lifetime. How does a company have no back up plan? How can Trip Advisor continue to do business with this company. Stay away!!!! I will never use either again.
The host were soo friendly and informative, and we highly recommend it to anyone, the hostes violet were best guide ever.

Lucia was a great guide, wonderful English and deep knowledge of both the art and the artists as well as the building itself. You could tell she really enjoys the tours! I couldn’t imagine trying to navigate the museum without her guidance.

Had a amazing time with Daniel.. he had a good knowledge of the art work and kept the group interested from start to finish, as he took on our tour of the Louvre .. to be fair it was very quiet so we didn’t have to que which was a bonus.

We had a very good experience with this tour company a week ago. Yullia, our tour leader, explained in a very articulate and interesting manner. Highly recommended. Thanks Citywonder for providing the best tour in Louvre.

A cultur Visit in Louvre Museum is the best of Paris, to see the wonderful Venus of Milo was a real pleasure for me, there are also very interesting exibitions to admire and a lot more; there are one good restaurant and much other full of tourists:
I recommend to visit the Louvre, a must.

Our guide was very knowledgable and had great stories
We met outside under the arch and was taken in a secret way
We had rucksacks so our guide led us to cloak rooms
She was always helpful and friendly
I would recommend this service for any one visiting the Louvre

I bought tickets on-line. Done, normal. 2 hrs later I get a message saying I don’t have tickets after all, and that they’re actually sold out. Utterly amateur. My group was extremely disappointed. It’s embarrassing.
Lucia was an amazing tour guide. Made the Louvre very enjoyable. Would highly recommend this tour. Informative!
Team Adam was excellent. Very knowledgeable, adhered to time. Definitely worth it. All important attractions in the museum were covered with excellent detail.

Our family was beyond fortunate to have Adam as our tour guide at the Louvre. His wealth of knowledge is unparalleled - he delighted us with his fun facts - humor - and stories. He also showed incredible compassion to our daughter when she fainted - he didn’t hesitate to stop the tour and find immediate help for her. I feel my family left the Louvre enriched in a new appreciation for all the inhabitants of the Louvre - especially a new appreciation for the star Mona Lisa. We cannot wait to get back state side and tell all our friends the story of the magnificent Venus de Milo - who we now know to refer to as Aphrodite ❤️. You would be doing yourself a great disservice- to go to the Louvre without booking through City Wonders and not specifically asking for TEAM ADAM!!!!!
Small ideal for Adam - get press on Louvre tattoos - ladies we’re bummed that’s now how our tour ended 🤣🥰

Adam was our brilliant tour guide who navigated us through the amazing Louvre. We have two teenagers and three college students who all learned to understand and even appreciate art. I loved how Adam brought us through the centuries of artwork to help us appreciate the significance of the beautiful Mona Lisa. Adam is not only brilliant, but also energetic and passionate about the art and history of the Louvre. We are committed to Team Adam for life!
Adam was excellent and very informative. He took time to explain. It was excellent trip, we highly recommend it

Had an awesome tour of the Louvre with our guide Adam. Adam was very knowledgeable and friendly, taking us in a journey through the history of art. We started in Babylon then to Greece and the renaissance.

The only downside was the headphones which were not very reliable, dropping in and out.

We had the best three hours being shown the highlights of the museum. Our tour guide took time to know all of our names; his knowledge of the museum was incredible. He made the tour fun and we learnt so much. It was honestly an experience I will never forget. Thank you Adam.
We absolutely loved the tour, our guide was Adam and he was amazing, knowledgeable, funny, friendly, great guy, I highly recommend this tour, I learned so much,Go team Adam 👍👍

The Louvre is so large that I was intimidated to attempt to tour it without a guide. On the 3hr tour, our guide took us from ancient civilizations, to medieval times, to the Renascence. Overall, the tour was interesting. I found the sculptures more fascinating than all of the paintings, but I don't claim to be an art expert either. Our guide pointed out interesting facts and kept things moving in places that I would've likely gotten bogged down. My only criticism is that her microphone was of poor quality. It kept losing her voice when she moved her head, so a recommendation would be for the tour operator to invest in better electronics. 3hrs is a long time so be prepared to be on your feet! Overall, I recommend the tour. I'm very glad to have had a guide, rather than try to tour it myself.

We had the best tour guide ever!!! Team Adam!!! He was so knowledgeable in everything he showed us! I only wish I had known about Adam before my other tours so we could’ve requested him. We loved every single minute of this tour, and we were no experts in any of these paintings or sculptures, but Adam definitely made it fun to learn about. Thanks Adam from your fellow Californians!

Our tour guide Violet was amazing. She knew how to move us through the crowds and show us the main highlights. This museum is vast so self navigating would be difficult. Skip the long lines (especially in poor weather) and enjoy a informative, engaging tour with an expert in History. After the tour you can leave or are free to continue on solo. Worth every cent.

This is a perfect tour for anyone wanting to see all the main highlights of the Louvre in a single afternoon. We booked City Wonders’ semi-private, afternoon tour, which kept the group at a more intimate size.

Josephine was an amazing tour guide. She did a great job navigating a very crowded Louvre and hitting all the highlights of the museum in a timely manner. We felt neither rushed nor did we feel that the tour was dragging along – it was almost the perfect pace. Josephine is incredibly knowledgeable about the Louvre – she had answers to every question thrown at her. She also has a great sense of humor, which really kept our tour lively (museums and art work are admittedly a pretty dry topic that can get quickly boring over a three-hour period). We would highly recommend Josephine to anyone looking to tour the Louvre!

Nancy gave an excellent tour of the Louvre. Nancy was able to navigate our tour group through the Louvre and provide enough historical perspective in order to make the tour a rich cultural experience. highly recommend!!!
This tour was the highlight of my trip to Paris. Don't go to the Louvre without this tour! Very informative. Terrific tour guide.

Definitely a must see and you definitely want a guide. Ours was fantastic. She spoke fantastic English. You could tell she was very passionate about the museum and was very very well educated on the works on display. Again, I do recommend these “Skip the line” tickets as you could tell it saved us quite a lot of potential wait time. Additionally it would be easy to get lost in the amazement of the building and art and possibly miss some very key works. The guide can only do so much in a tour time if about 2.5 hours, but it’s probably all you can take in anyway. The wait to see the Mona Lisa was only about 8-10 minutes so don’t be afraid of that. You gotta do it. Our guide shared some amazing history about the building itself, and I could argue that the building is as interesting as the works inside of it. Have fun and wear your walking shoes!

I went on the "Comprehensive Louvre Tour: Skip-the-Line & Explore More" and it was amazing!

I personally think the best way to enjoy the Louvre is through a guided tour. Especially if you're lucky to have a guide like Adam. He was very well versed in the history and arts. He made me fall in love with arts/history through is energy and passion. He was very fun!

You should totally book this tour and hope you end up on Team Adam.

Our tour guide Julian was fantastic! He was so knowledgeable and guided us through with ease. He was kind, patient had a great sense of humor! We thoroughly enjoyed the tour with him. The tour is definitely the way to go if you want to visit the “must see” pieces. I could not have imagined a better way to see the louvre and yet start planning another! The skip the line is exactly that and worth every dollar and peace of mind!

Given the size of the Louvre collection our tour guide, Fabrizia Aceti, did a wonderful job in taking us through some of the highlights of the museum. At the outset, she explained the challenges of seeing the Mona Lisa, and allowed us as a group to decide whether to weather the aggressive crowds to do so. The vote was affirmative to see the da Vinci painting, but it took a disproportionate percentage of the tour. The balance of the tour, Michelangelo's "Dying Slave", "Lamassu" from the Assyrian Empire, the "Winged Victory of Samothrace" and many more artworks included explanations to note their significance to the art world. Ms. Aceti was gracious and helpful throughout the tour. The discussion concerning da Vinci's "Saint John the Baptist" in comparison to the Mona Lisa was fascinating.

If you’re concerned you won’t be able to find the big attractions like the Mona Lisa, Aphrodite or Nike statues, then this tour will be great for you. I wasn’t particularly impressed with our guide’s knowledge and my spouse & I felt there were multiple instances where the history was being stretched to make the story more dramatic. Overall it was okay but I wouldn’t pay for a tour next time. I would just buy a ticket from the museum directly and find my own way.

The Louvre is absolutely breath taking. Our guide Laura was outstanding and gave great bits of information during the tour. She was patient and did well at steering a group close to twenty. I’ll need to return again and again just to absorb all the amazing pieces the Louvre has to offer.

Even on a rainy day in late October, the lines to get into the Lourve were beyond imagining. Our guide, Laura P. walked us directly into the museum from our meeting place across from the pyramid in front of the Lourve. She managed our larger-than-expected group with skill, courtesy, and concern. Each person got to see the highlights
that tourists short on time want to see at the Lourve. Her knowledge of history and art were excellent and truly enhanced our experience. I strongly recommend this tour.
I highly recommend this tour. Worth paying extra for a tour guide to help you navigate the Lourve. Our tour guide was great.

We saved a ton of time. Get an map, so that you can see more of the museum. Wish I had talked to the other tourists in my group before we headed in. Didn’t need to see the Egypt, Greece and Rome items. Would have preferred more of the renaissance paintings? When in Paris see the Western Europe things. Go to Rome Egypt or Greece to see those items

Fantastic tour and extremely memorable. The Louvre was everything it promised, absolutely massive, so many ancient and classic art pieces. Seeing the Mona Lisa in person and Delecroix Raft of the Medusa were definitely my best 2. The tour guide Laura was excellent with significant knowledge. She was very engaging, able to answer all questions and provided so much information throughout the visit. Even kept my 10 year old son engaged on what is quite a long, but very necessary 3 hour tour. Definitely highly recommend the tour rather than walking round individually.

I booked this tour of the Louvre on our first full day in Paris because it seemed like it would be a good idea. After starting our tour and seeing the 2.5 hour line for admission that we weren't in, I started feeling like I made a good decision. Shortly, it became apparent how knowledgeable and clever our guide, Adam, was with leading us through the Louvre that my husband and I can't imagine having tried to visit the Louvre without a tour such as this. Adam was not just knowledgable in general, but he tailored the tour to not just English speakers, but to Canadian/American/English culture and sensibilities as well. This was the best museum guided tour I've ever been on. Well worth the money.

Our tour guy Adam was phenomenal!!!! (Photo below) I would give him 11 stars out of 10. Very informative and he also made it so much fun. Museums not my thing but, couldn’t help but enjoy myself. It was a lot of walking and no way to see everything but it was so great to see the Mona Lisa and everything else!!!!

We purchased the 3-hour CityWonders tour of the Louvre and feel extremely fortunate to have had Hugo as our guide. Hugo recently earned a Master’s degree in Art History, and his passion, energy, and wit suggests that Hugo will be a lifelong scholar. The Louvre would be wise to hire Hugo on permanent staff. I didn’t know what to expect if the tour, especially because my wife isn’t a huge fan of museums and we were kicking off our Paris adventure with a museum. But Hugo made all the difference. The Louvre of course is amazing in itself, but our experience was enriched by our knowledgeable and humorous guide. We appreciated our experience at the Louvre so much more than we would have on our own. I’d highly recommend this tour, and highly recommend CityWonders. We had a great time!
We were a group of 3 with our own guide: Josephine, she was great tour guide. We started early and went for @4 hours. We learned and saw all major works.
Julian was expert and enthusiasm with his tour. He guided us effortlessly through the crowds. The tour exceeded our expectations.

Everything was just as described in terms of where to meet. Guides were on time and ready to go. Our guide was Laura and I can't imagine a guide being better. Her knowledge seemed to be limitless. No matter what we asked her she knew the answer. I will admit I am not always the most patient at museums. However, I was completely engaged when Laura spoke of the many attractions. Having her as our guide made all the difference in terms of enjoyment, maximizing our time and learning so much more than we would have without a guide. It was so interesting that I opted to spend the rest of the day at the Louvre. Something I had not planned to do.

This 3 hour guided tour of the Louvre is a must see. A great way to catch the major attractions and cruise through the massive collection in a short time. Our tour guide, Claire, was very personable, knowledgeable, and a delight. She brought the museum to life with great stories. You could always spend more time in the Louvre, but we felt like we had covered it all in a short time.

We sincerely appreciated our guided tour and skip the line benefit. Our tour guide, Violet, was amazing. The Louvre is incredibly big, much larger than I anticipated. I can't imagine waiting in the line, and shuffling through with the crowds. In addition, she provided helpful recommendations of other tours, places to visit and Paris safety tips. Highly recommend!

The lines to get into the Louvre were unbelievable. Using Skip The Line really works and get you get to see things the regular ticket buyer may not. Once inside the crowds are unavoidable but the tour guide did an excellent job of keeping us together and making sure we saw the more important items.

We thoroughly enjoyed the louvre itself and were in complete awe of the artwork but our guide was rude and at the start of the tour said we would have to lift our son up flights of stairs because he didn’t want to have to change the course of the tour ‘just for the elevators.’ Luckily my husband and older sons were strong enough to lift my youngest son in his wheelchair. Although we were told at time of booking that the guide would accommodate our sons disability, the guide himself (a typically rude Frenchman) was rude, refused to wait for us to join the group so we could keep up with the commentary and we would recommend to other families with disabled members to go with a private tour instead.
I wish I had the guides name so I could put it here.

We enjoyed out Louvre tour very much. Our guide Julien was very informative, and the pace of the tour was excellent. We saw the highlights (including Venus de Milo and Mona Lisa) with great insight, and Julien was very patient with our novice questions. This is the way to do the Louvre for a first visit- get a quick, in depth viewing of the key pieces without waiting, then go back another time (or stay after) to see other aspects

We booked a 3 hour tour with CityWonders through Viator for this tour. We met at an easy to locate point and were hooked up with John E [Englishman] at Du Carousel.
John was very knowledgeable about everything concerning the Louvre.
The tour took in all the major works of art - the Venus de Milo, the Wings of Victory and Mona Lisa to name a few. John was able to clearly articulate the history behind all the major and some of the little nuggets that you wouldn’t normally know about.
We saw all the major art works that you’d want to see and then when the tour concluded - 3 and a bit hours later - we were left to stay in the museum and view what ever else interested us.
The tour guide John was very informative and made the tour. The information he provided was informative and he made it quite fun and interesting. The Skip the Line tour is the way to go if you want to check out all the main big ticket items in a reasonable amount of time.

For 3 hrs on a Saturday morning, our Leader Laura P. shepherded us throughout the massive wings and galleries to the top exhibits without the hassle of any lineup all the while providing highly informative narration and great context to the periods of all the great art on display. We’d do it again!

Sorry but I feel there was too much talk and not enough SEEING of the art. Spent too much time talking about history and stories of a few artists. This museum is far too big to send so much talk TALKING while standing still.

We did this tour with our 8 & 13 year old children. We had 24 in our group total. Anna did a great job of guiding us through the Louvre and giving us the history and details about the art we saw. She can be a little long winded, which I didn’t mind. I took the opportunity to browse the other works of art near the same area and was still able to hear her with the headset. She also did a great job of engaging my 8 year old throughout the tour which we really appreciated. Be advised the line for Mona Lisa goes quickly now so do not be discouraged when you enter the room. There are staff standing there allowing a certain number of people in for an allotted amount of time and then they scoot them out and the next group enters.

With the city of Paris snarled with traffic jams and protests, we managed to get to the meeting place on time. World tours had a meeting place not hard to find. Our tour guide was a young Ukrainian girl, very pleasant and passionate. She was well informed and professional. She has a world of knowledge on the many artworks and sculptures. She couldn't have been better. The Louvre is a tremendous museum and since we had a supposedly a not to crowded day, I cant imagine how much more crowded it could be. We got to see the very intriguing photo of the mona Lisa with only about a 15 minute wait. I have heard people wait 2 hours. With the constant warning of pick pockets in the area, it puts an uncomfortable feeling. Our tour guide was fearful of our group getting taken as other group leaders were radioing her with warnings. I can only rate the tour a top 5, but after being in Paris 3 days, it's one and done.

Glad I signed up for a tour. There is so much to see, I would've been overwhelmed. Plus, although I like art, I am not super knowledgeable about it, so having a guide was great. Alex was our guide. He had a great personality and lots of information to share.
It was a great tour! We see and learn so much in 4 hours. Lots of stuff I probably will miss if I have to take the tour by myself. Two thumbs up!
Excellent guide! Knowledgeable and courteous. Efficient. Affable. He added depth to our appreciation of the Louvre. We enjoyed ourselves immensely.

Best of the best! I missed my scheduled tour due to a belated flight. They rescheduled at last minute and I managed to take tour in another time slot. Guide Reuben was good too. Quick tour, three hours walk but that is the quickest possible tour if you want to see anything.

Alex shared so much information about the Louvre and at the same time took us through few in depth pieces where we spent most time glancing through the rest. From the old castle foundation to the newest architectural addition of the palace and though endless art and sculpture pieces it was truly and amazing experience.

This the best way to see the Louvre museum. In 3-4 hours you cover the most important items with a lot of information. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and addressed all important pieces. After the tour we stayed to see whatever was not covered in the tour. We didn't waste time in the ticket line other than the security which everyone has to go through. Money very well spend!!! Thanks guys for a great tour.
Amazing tour guide! To the point and fun, we had a great tour that kept us engaged the whole time. Highly recommended

The Louvre Museum in Central Paris is both "iconic" and very heavily visited. That means that there is almost always a "long line" awaiting to get in. One way to make the most of your time and reduce tedious waiting times- often of hours- is to take this very popular tour. In addition to by-passing the lines, one also has an expert, and very knowledgeable guide. The size of the group is limited to 25 so that one gets quite personal attention. Of course learning about famous works of art such as the Mona Lisa is expected.. but the long, 900 year history of the building is also fascinating. It is indeed a very worthwhile tour-- but the time is limited to 3 hours-- and for those with much more time and interest in the incredible collection, there are other options.

I hope that this Review has been helpful.

The instructions indicated to go to the Arch de Triomphe. I thought we should go to the Louvre instead, but my wife was stubborn, asked three different local French people where to find per instructions, followed the instructions which ended up being the wrong location. When we called the number listed, it was not in service so no help there. All this money and time for nothing.

Excellent tour guide very well informed
And gave great insight background stories of the art works statues paintings tapestry. Highly recommend. Very enjoyable.

Tour guide was fantastic. You skip long lines while entering which can save one hour plus wait. Guide takes you to all great places in museum, it's so large you would waste time on your own just trying to get around. Worth every penny.
The tour was great. We skipped the line and the tour leader was excellent. He focused on the major works and helped us to understand major works of Art

We really enjoyed his explanation and insight of the Louvre. And he gave us great tips for prioritizing and maneuvering the museum. Highly recommend the tour and would request Marq! He had a sense of humor when describing some of the history associated with the building and French rulers. Skip a line was a huge time saver.

This tour was great thanks to our guide Alex. Besides being very organized and making sure to show us some of the best art (in just 3 hours), he was extremely knowledgeable and had a great sense of humor. We were doing our tour with our baby which was a bit difficult with so many stairs. Alex was all the time making sure we were not left behind and at the end helped us find the easiest way out :)
Kind regards from Canada
We had a good tour around Louvre, the walk was long but that makes complete sense taking into consideration the length of the Louvre. Saw all the most important things and the tour was well planned.

Our guide was knowledgeable and engaged. we learned so much of French history as well as understanding the Louvre and seeing the amazing art. Our guide wisely encouraged us to skip the long line to see the Mona Lisa so that we could visit many other parts of the museum.

Even though we had to wait an hour to see Mona Lisa we still fully enjoyed our tour thanks to our fantastic guide, Laura P. During the wait she kept it interesting and fun while teaching us so much about the history of France, the Lourve, art and just about anything else you can think of! We learned so much and she even took things that previously I had no interest in and made them interesting! What an amazing museum, truly a must do when in Paris! Hopefully you will get a guide as amazing as Laura, She truly is an asset to your company and you can tell she loves what she does! Thank you Laura P!

We had a wonderful introduction to The Louvre - an this made us hungry for more time wandering around this iconic museum. We saw all the famous pieces, of note Mona Lisa, and the Venus de Milo sculpture. Our guide was very knowledgable and we received a good overview of the history of the Louvre, and the pieces of art work.

We took this tour with our guide Hugo who is studying Art History (I think) in Paris. Hugo was funny, informative and passionate about the art he showed us. He was simply outstanding.
As for the Louvre, what can I say. It is awesome, a beautiful building with enormous grandeur and the art is
Stunning. Thank you Hugo, thank you Louvre, thank you Paris

Our guide for CityWonders tour was Fabrizia or “Fab” as we liked to call her. What a wonderful, fun and well informed guide! My husband is a history buff so we were delighted when she shared such insightful information, she knows her stuff and enjoys sharing it. She has a passion for art and history and loves sharing her knowledge, we learned so much in such a fun atmosphere ! Thank you , Fabrizia !!!!

An amazing museum and tour guide. We saw all the classics as well as lesser-known masterpieces - both of which were beautiful and amazing. If you can get in Nev’s group, do so. She has an infectious passion and enthusiasm for art and art history that made our tour fantastic. Great
Museum and great tour.

Paying extra to skip the line and get a tour was completely worth it. I do not remember my tour guide's name but she was originally from London and had a delightful British accent. Our tour guide seamlessly navigated us through the Louvre making sure to stop at some of the most well known works of art. After the tour was over we were able to continue our visit at our own pace.

My family and I took the Louvre 3-Hour Walking Tour and it was incredible. We got to jump all the lines and saw the Mona Lisa in less than an hour entering the museum. We also learned so much from our guide, Ivana, who was so knowledgeable. We were exhausted after but it was a great experience.

The reason that we choose this option it was to make sure we will see Mona Lisa painter. However, our guide kind push the group to decided not go as first saying it will take an hour, etc. As i minority that wants to go for it we end up not see it.
