That was also the only time that the guide told us anything about what we were looking at other than what it was. He also continually referred to what the “ladies” in the group would like. I’m female and found it to be offensive. I asked one question about the artist who had created a statue and was told in a tone which implied I was stupid that “we don’t know, it’s an antiquity”— it was not what he said but how he said it. He also repeatedly said “ok” at the end of each statement which became irritating. In summary, there were too many people, we were rushed at a ridiculous pace, the guide’s tone and reference to the women in the group and treating us like children in his “family” was offensive and he gave us nothing of back story or content (not even about the Mona Lisa) until the very last of the tour. I’ve been on many tours and it was the absolute worse ever. So bad I found myself saying out loud as I rushed from room to room, that it was the worse tour ever. Do not waste your money on this tour!

Our Guide (Adam - PHD Nuclear Medicine) for this tour provided excellent suggestions on how we might optimize our time while on this AM tour. Sticking together as a Group while in line filling in the spaces rope to rope so as to prevent others from pushing there way forward - "TEAM ADAM". Adam was very knowledgeable, spoke very clearly and kept the tour at an even pace. Adams suggestions about seeing the Mona Lisa cannot be stressed enough. Once we were ready to step in front of the Mona Lisa, those just ahead - not in our group were very rood and inconsiderate - Pushing their way up front, taking videos, selfies and Friends pictures right in front of the Mona Lisa and then not moving when told by the Museum Staff. The result was we only got a short glimse of the Mona Lisa and a couple of pictures that were Blurred (< 60 seconds) in front of the Mona Lisa. Team Adam approach was helpful in that as a group we would not have been able to see much at all had we not stuck together. The remaining tour of the Louvre by Adam was excellent. Adam took his time to explain, rest a few seconds after steps and provided insights that kept our tour very interesting.
Morning tour when the museum opens is strongly recommended! Gary D

The Louvre was extraordinary. Our tour guide Laura was very knowledgeable in explaining the history behind the paintings and sculptures we saw. The building is huge and there are a lot of steps to clime. I highly recommend it.
Great guide,small group. A great addition to visiting the museum. Absolute fund of information presented in interesting manner with no overload.

Anna did a masterful job navigating our group through the crowds of visitors and the vast expanse of the museum while providing interesting and entertaining commentary to keep us all engaged. The three hours flew by. And skipping the lines was huge and worth every penny.

We loved the tour! Our guide Alex was fun and very informative. He made the 1 1/2 hour wait to see Mona Lisa go by pretty fast. Our only complaint is that due to the protests in Paris, we could not take the metro from our hotel, and the 2 mile walk turned into twice that because of street closures. We were less than 10 minutes late, and the tour left without us. Other tour companies were waiting a bit because of the restrictions. We rebooked, at 30 euros each for the next day. The next day the tour left 10 minutes late! I would recommend the tour, but not with City Wonders

My boyfriend and I went to the Louvre Museum last week and were hosted by Hugo. This was such an amazing experience from the start to the end! Hugo was super engaging, knew his stuff, and made this tour fun and interactive for the whole group. Do be aware that this is a long tour ( about 2-3 hours long) and you will be walking up and down stairs, so wear your comfiest shoes! I would recommend to friends and family!

We went early, but lines were starting to become long so skipping the line was great. Paid a bit more for the private guide, but they take you to the most interesting and famous pieces of art and provide a lot of detail and history that you just don't get with a group. Lasted about 4 hours. Excellent!

My tour at The Louvre given by Ana was wonderful! She was very knowledgeable and fun. Ana had great personality. The weather was perfect, we even got the chance to see Mona Lisa. I found the Louvre fascinating and Ana made it enjoyable.

This tour was a whirlwind of several of the most famous pieces in the museum as well as the royal apartments and the stories that went with them. Alexander was a fantastic guide and brought humor and knowledge to the art we saw. Thank you, Alex!

It was an excellent experience. Our guide Nev was very friendly, absolutely passionate about art and got us a hole different perspective of each piece we visited. The museum is huge and packed this time of year, having someone to show the most important pieces is essencial otherwise you’ll just waste a lot of time trying to find your way around.

Laura P. was absolutely fantastic as a tour guide in the Louve. Her knowledge of art, sculpture and history of France was amazing. She absolutely made the tour. Even though we had to stand in line for almost an hour to see the Mona Lisa, she kept us engaged with the history of the Mona Lisa and history of France through the ages. If there were any way to request Laura P. to be your guide, I would definitely try to do that.

Our guide Anna was great! Unforgettable experience spending time in Louvre museum The only disappointing moment when you realize that you have to spend 1 hour in line in order to see Mona Lisa for 20 seconds

The Skip the Line: Louvre Museum Walking Tour including Venus de Milo and Mona Lisa is invaluable. If you spent 30 seconds looking at each piece in the Louvre, you could be conceivably be there 100 days. Having a tour guide get you ahead of the common line (though you still need to go through security lines) and provide an overall review of the museum and pieces in it is incredibly helpful. You can then stay in the museum longer and go over any things you missed that you would like to spend more personal time on. The Mona Lisa is nice to see; but you don't really get that close - even with a protective glass covering it; and you only get a few seconds to take pictures of/with it. It's really no big deal; but at least I can say I've done it. That aside, it was an incredible experience and one everyone should have if they can do it.

As you may or may not know, the Louvre can be totally overwhelming. We had a fantastic guide named Hugo and he made the experience very fun, educational, and efficient. It was worth every penny to have someone guide us to the high points and provide us with "insider" details. Our total party had 5 people and I wouldn't do the Louvre any other way!
Superb performance by Manuel. Great dialogue, knowledge and enthusiasm. What a great ambassador for the majesty of Le Louvre.

Excellent tour, lots of steps. We’re sble to see all of the highlights. Very knowledgeable guide. The line for Mona Lisa was long. 20’ away was as close as we could get. If you have a 70-300 zoom lens for DSLR, use it for close up. No flash allowed.

We can’t recommend this tour enough, which was a Friday evening 3hr tour. Our guide Nev (an art major) was simply fantastic, she guided us through a miriad of rooms and halls imparting her impressive historical knowledge and passion for the art we saw. Nev gave so much, she was humourous, entertaining and enlightening, we both walked away with a new found deep respect for the Lourve and all the art and artifacts it held. Thank you Nev for giving us an experience that was definitely the highlight of our time in Paris.

highly recommend this tour. Me and my family booked this tour and was fortunate enough to have Felix as our tour guide. He was so informative, fun and very engaging. He took us to the best pieces at the museum including Mona Lisa and told us amazing stories about every single piece. We have been on many tours and so far Felix has been the best tour guide yet. He gave us just enough time to take pictures and did not rush anything which felt really nice considering the amount of walking that you have to do. No line ups and you can stay at the louvre after the tour is over if you wish to do so. definitely a great deal.

My wife and I did the 3 hour tour through the Louvre with Natalya. She was very knowledgeable and you could tell she was very passionate about her work. She was a joy to lead us through the museum, pouring out interesting information on some of the highlighted pieces. Obviously with a museum if that size, it’s impossible to see most of the art in o it 3 hours, however she did a great job of giving us an abbreviated version and we would highly recommend this tour to others. Also, afterward you can just stay in the museum and explore on your own after the tour if you wish.
If you want to get the most out of seeing the Louvre on a tight timeline this is the way to go. The place is huge and you will waste a ton of time without an experienced guide.

For our first trip to Paris, we were advised to pre-book the trips and sights before we arrived, and if possible book the 'skip the queue' tickets. We are so glad we did!
The Louvre was a lot bigger than expected and extremely busy, however we were in the expert hands of Felix, who was the perfect guide. He was knowledgable, very amusing, and passionate about art, which made the three hour tour fly by. Felix suggested where to stand to take the best pictures of the art work and statues, to get the best experience from our tour.

Highly recommended!
Felix did a great job. Went on the afternoon trip. 3 hours want enough time but would request Felix again.

Our guide, Catherine, gave us a very informative, insightful 3 hr tour. Her knowledge of art was impressive. And she got us into see the Mona Lisa,which we thought would be impossible. She was nice enough to give us clear directions to get back to the ship on the metro. This tour was well worth the money. Was on time & small group of 10.

This evening we did a wonderful three hour tour of The Louvre with a fantastic tour guide Nev. We are so glad we took this tour and to us it was worth every penny. Nev is an art historian and brought the highlights of this museum to life for us and opened our eyes to a wider appreciation of some of the art in the museum. Without her expertise we would have been totally overwhelmed by the enormity of the buildings and the sheer size of the art collection. We came away feeling enlightened by Nev’s interpretations and in awe of this amazing place. A highlight.

We used City Wonders for the Louvre tour and our guide spent virtually the entire tour trying to get the ear pieces and his microphone working. The last 20 minutes we just gave up and tried to walk as close to him as possible. The tour we took was called the Semi-Private express tour with Mona Lisa and other highlights. They really should not offer this tour. It is a 90 minute tour. We spent the first 45 minutes waiting in line to see the Mona Lisa. If you want an express tour, do one without Mona Lisa included. you can do that on your own. 90 minutes would have been fine for the rest of the museum with a guide (if the technology worked) and then enjoy the museum on your own after that. So after 45 minutes waiting in line and then another 25 minutes trying to fix communication system we pretty much wasted our money on this tour. 2 stars because at least we skipped the line to get in for the most part.

The tour of the Louve was wonderful! My tour guide was Ruben. He gave a lot of great history of Louve before entering the Louve and during. It was more than I expected which was a plus! He showed us some highlighted pieces of artwork (including the Mona Lisa!). He knew quite a bit about each of the pieces which is exactly what I wanted! He was very knowledgeable, passionate and excited about what he was sharing. I am so glad I booked this. I went on the 2pm tour. If you think you might want to check out some artwork after the tour is done (which I guarantee you will :) ) book an earlier tour.

Alexander was wonderful and provided the best adjustments for our group. He realized the line for Mona Lisa was short the moment we got inside, so we got to see her really fast. He explains everything very carefully and is really fun to hear.
Tottaly worth it!

Really just an introduction to the Louvre. Our guide crammed a lot into a three hour tour. While skipping the line was a plus the rush to as much as you can in three hours made it seem to fast pace for folks in our 70s.

I absolutely loved the tour of the Louvre and it's famous works of art. The tour guide Allister was very funny and you can tell that he loves his job. I really hope that I spelled his name right because he definitely deserves a great review. I wasn't concerned with the length of the tour because I don't mind doing something that I'll probably never get to do again in my lifetime. Overall, my experience was very good.

Our guide Julien was more than a guide. He was an art historian and teacher. When looking at the statues, he had us walk around them to look from all angles. He explained different art methods used from century to century. I would definitely book a guided walking tour again.

Glad taking this tour. Louvre is huge with many collections. Able to see major highlights in limited time. Tour guide did excellent job to share history and background, my two teen boys surprisingly showed interest and not got bored at all. Learned a lot.
Excellent overview of the Louvre and a terrific guide, really enjoyed the experience would do it again

Line moves fast and the Louvre is beautiful but the crowds once you are in really make it hard to have much in the way of a transcendental art experience, takes a PhD to figure out how to get out of the place , and scalpers try to take your tickets as you leave they are not part of the museum staff . We got tired of it fast and bailed chose to walk the streets away from touristy areas and had a better time

Get the more private small tour (most exepensive). You are able to ask any questions you want and see whatever it is you really want to see. Hugo was awesome... he is very animated and theatrical which helps describe all of the art and what was happening in different works of art in different time periods.
Tour was great. Alistair did an amazing job. He has a lot of knowledge about art history. Highly recommended.

Abdul was amazing! Took the time to explain everything in detail and made sure to keep elderly with him so that they didn’t get left behind. Loved skipping the lines and his knowledge was second to none.
He was extremely knowledgeable about the Louvre and art, and told you where specific artworks located!
Best money I spent in laris was getting this guided tour. I am an art history major and nerd and who’d have been completely lost in the louvre. I still learned so much as well! It was amazing.

Excellent tour highly recommend it
The guide was great and knew what she was talking about.
It was three hours able to see important things including Mona Lisa

Given that La Joconde was recently moved & with the threat that we might not see the Masterpiece, we we thrilled that Felix (best ever) got us down the The Carousel entrance and over to the north wing to see her first! From there we got tremendous insight and knowledge from our now favorite Croatian historian/teacher!!

A few hours is not enough in the Louvre so this is a great way to get an entertaining sample of what is there in a short time. If, like me, you are a casual art/art history fancier, and a first-time visitor without a strict itinerary of what you want to see, it is very handy to be led around and introduced to some of the 'greatest hits'. The museum was crowded and bustling so it was actually comparatively relaxing to have someone else lead the way along an efficiently planned route while chatting through some interesting facts and anecdotes. If I'd known it was 30+ minutes to get through the queue to see Mona Lisa behind glass for 20 seconds before museum staff usher you away I would have been happy to miss her and see other stuff but the charming guide kept us entertained with a potted history of the famous painting as we shuffled along. This was one of the most expensive walking tours we've done in any city but not outrageously so and we were glad we paid up not to have to struggle through the crowds, museum plan in hand, trying to find our way to the next thing we wanted to see and the works featured on the tour were presented in a clear and enthusiastic way with some interesting context and analysis. Enjoyed it. Recommended.

We booked a full day but found we really only needed. 4 hours
Therefore if you had a museum pass you could have skipped the line
The transfer to Versailles was good on time with pick up but the drop off point was way out that required a taxi to get back to your lodging
I think do on own and even book a taxi if more than 2 people it would be more economical
Our guide, Anna, was excellent! Service was great. The meeting place was easy to find. The audio system was also good.

I did think the price was a bit high to start with but with limited time in Paris I booked this so we could see as much as possible. However it was 100% worth it, the meeting point is easy to find and city wonders are super organized with colour coded stickers depending on the time you booked. Skipped the two hour queue for tickets and the long queue for security. Our guide was brilliant and gave us so much information as we went round. The best part is you are free to stay as long as you want after the tour and go back round by yourself. Would happily use this company again😊

Everyone who visits Paris should go to the Louvre on their first visit (like me).

Seeing the line at the entrance doors, we were very glad we took the tour and "skip the line." It was still a complicated series of steps to get inside. Our guide, Anna, was very helpful, and made sure all of us stayed together (best she could).

Her tour route worked well. We still had a 30 minute line to get to see Mona Lisa (first thing); Anna kept us engaged with several related stories. She also helped those with walking difficulties to use elevators and get a quicker view of the Mona Lisa.

The rest of her tour was very well organized. We saw many well known artworks, and heard new stories about them. Overall a very worthwhile tour.

NOTE - it was not Anna's fault when one of our group "got lost", went ahead - and left her 10 year old daughter with the rest of the group, then complained.
Tour started on time, guide was knowledgable and took us to Monalisa first thing in morning when lines are slightly shorter.
There wasn't enough time to see evrything, but we didn't have to wait in line long and even got to see the Mona Lisa!

Would do it again, tour guide was very knowledgeable and had a great attitude. Our first stop was the Mona Lisa and she got us there within 15 minutes! She then took us to all the other highlights and some of her personal favorites.
We had a skip the line ticket we still had to wait several minutes audio did not function well hard to hear at times.

The arrangements were good. However the audio system did not work well and we could not clearly hear the guide most of the time. He was informative and knowledgeable however the first part of the tour felt rushed and without much information. Comparatively the last part of the tour had lots of information in exhibits. The quality of the presentation can be improved to hold the audience's attention better.
Excellent guide Mannie did a great job. Very informative. Time literally flew by and we had a great tour of the Louvre. Be ready to walk and wear comfortable shoes.

Beautiful collection of arts from different times. It is amazing to see how thorough the artists were centuries back.

Bad audio guide- these new nintendo audio guides are complicated. Better take guides.

Tips - Book tickets online. Ahead of time else you have to take the longer route to enter.
Entrance for non ticket holders is - Carrousel du Louvre, 99 Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris, France and not the pyramid.

Keep an eye that you are in the right queue. There is a long queue for Mona Lisa.
Keep the Map handy.

Our guide Alistair was very informative and had a sense of humour which made the experience even more rewarding.
I would highly recommend to others.
Many thanks.

I would highly recommend taking this tour of the Louvre. We got skip most of the long lines saving a large chunk of time. Laura did a wonderful job informing us about the history while still very understandable. The Louvre is a very large museum so we were able to cover a lot of it with the help of Laura who knew how to navigate the museum.

we did the Louvre tour today . We were with “team Adam” he was AMAZING!!!!! Actually the best tour guide I ever had!!!! he was smart and funny and very very knowledgeable about the history. I learned so much! I wishI had him for the whole day!

Our group of seven people were toured through the Louvre with our guide Hugo. He’s extremely knowledgeable and highly educated in art, history and interesting facts about his country. Plus, I think he may know this museum perhaps even better than his own home. He’s very engaging and has the ability to keep everyone included while providing individual attention to answer specific questions at the same time. Hence, making everyone feel special as if you were the only one on his tour. He has a great sense of humor, quick wit and comedic timing which is truly a sign of intelligence. I highly recommend you choose Hugo as your guide....if you’re lucky enough to find him available.

Wow what an amazing museum. This City Wonders guided tour was excellent. We only had to wait 15mins to see the Mona Lisa. So much culture and history. Reuben our tour guide stopped at the highlights and provided an interesting & fun facts about the exhibits. Reuben is a great tour guide.

I couldn’t be more disappointed with a tour company. We booked our guided tour of the Louvre months before and after we arrived at the appointed meeting spot at the appointed time in 100F+ weather (!!!!) we were told that the tour was canceled at the last minute due to the guide not showing up. There was no effort to contact us via email or otherwise – so, the time to the meeting location and back was wasted, as well. Meanwhile, there were 2 employees of City Wonders standing there at the moment and they refused to lead a tour or to help us in any way. They were unapologetic, which only made the situation worse.
We take a lot of tours and this is a first. When people book an expensive tour, there needs to be assurances that this tour will happen. There were several others who were leaving Paris the next day and this was clearly something they left for the last evening to make their visit to Paris very special.
If you would like your hopes and dreams of your visit to Paris dashed to the ground, then you should book with City Wonders. If you value your time and money, find another company.
They did process the refund and they offered a free alternate tour – an outdoor walking tour for the next day when the temperature was (and I kid you not) 106F! We did not take them up on their offer.
Terrible!!

The Louvre Museum is huge with an incredible collections of art, sculptures and artefacts. We chose to do a guided tour because the place is so enormous, we wanted someone to show us where to go for the major exhibits, like Mona Lisa. Our guide, Fabrizia, was very friendly and informative. She knew the museum and the subject matter really well and guided us to all of the major attractions there. We loved it.
Our guide Alex was great! Funny, cheery and very, very knowledgeable. Such a great way to learn a lot of history and see all the highlights
Excellent tour guide. very smart and patient. always smiling, happy and energetic but very natural, spontaneous and friendly.
It was great time spent with our guide Fabricia.She was very knowledgeble and funny guide,Time just flew by.Good experience would definitely recommend Fab and the company!
Was wonderful to visit Louvre With a Tourist Guide Laura, she is an expert! She guided us with no stress, was really amazing, even with our big group of 25 people!
It was awesome . Tour guide was very detailed and was a very cool fella. The louvre is a awesome place .

My husband and I have differing views on how to visit a museum. I can linger for hours while he wants to get through as quickly as possible. This was the perfect way to compromise - our guide Alistair (5 stars) kept us entertained (and my husband quiet) while we got to soak in all the information!
It was wonderful, very informative and so good. I am glad we choose this! I wish the audio was a bit better because it kept cutting in and out. But other than that it was great!

My husband and I took the skip the line tour with the wonderful Fab. Even though it was a hot, crowded day, Fab managed the crowds and took us to see some of the museum’s headline exhibits. I learned a lot from her and she kept it interesting and lively. I highly recommend doing this tour in the morning and then spending the afternoon perusing the less crowded exhibits.

We booked this tour because navigating the Louvre on our own seemed intimidating. We checked in outside and met our tour guide, Ruben. He led us through ticketing and security and straight to the Mona Lisa. We didn’t have to wait very long to see her! We continued through all the highlights in the museum and ended with the Venus de Milo. Ruben was engaging and knowledgeable. He was helpful and we really enjoyed his commentary. Well worth it! Tour lasted about 3 hours and we wandered around on our own for a little while after that.

Our tour didn't include the Louvre and it really is a must see if you go to Paris. I saw that Trip Advisor offer a skip the line tour I purchased tickets weeks before my trip with their app. I rate this one of the best parts of our European experience. There were hundreds of people waiting to get tickets when we just skipped the lines. A great guide. We learned so much. We were all very pleased.
Our guide was terrific! Made sure we were always together. He was very informative and funny. Highly recommended tour.
our tour guide Laura was excellent. she’s very knowledgeable and kept the tour moving. honestly i like never go to museums, and i was shocked that i didn’t get bored at all. very good experience.

Highly recommend using this company to see The Louvre. Our tour guide, a 3rd generation Parisian, was extremely knowledgable and efficient. We were at The Louvre on probably the busiest day of the summer with extremely long lines to see The Mona Lisa. He was able to navigate us around the immense museum in order to see the highlights in a very efficient manner. His expert commentary about each art treasure was superb. I can’t imagine a better way to visit The Louvre.
Awesome tour - fabulous guide - pleasure to spend hours with her and see many of the main attractions!! Thank you - from Chicago - USA

Laura is an excellent tour guide! She was interesting and informative and guided us through a huge museum with purpose to select significant pieces of interest and importance. The Louvre is struggling with a transition of the Mona Lisa which added significant line waiting time in the middle of our tour. If possible, groups should try to see the Mona Lisa first to avoid this. Obviously it was worth the wait! Thank you Laura!

Tour was efficient and the guide was very informative. She was patient but firm on making sure we didn't hold others up. You hit the highlights and get in and out in 3 hours with so much walking and no breaks really.

The Louvre is just amazing and there is so much to see! It was our first time there and so glad we booked a tour with a guide through
City Wonders! Felix was our guide and he was just wonderful! Very knowledgeable, and caring. He knew so much about all the art, constantly answered all our questions and made the journey that much more special. He went out of his way to engage and enlighten us and you could tell he cared so much about the art. He also went out of his way to keep us together, safe, and enjoy us. I truly cannot say enough about him! I extremely recommend getting the private tour and skipping that line. City Wonders was right where they said to meet us-they were early. It was very organized, and definitely worth having someone take you around to navigate the massive museum and the huge crowds.

Laura was fantastic. Not a huge museum fan but my wife is. Have been to the Louvre before with an audio tour which does not compare with this. They do a great job of giving the history of the Louvre. Laura’s knowledge of art was impressive and walked us through the evolution of artistic techniques. Everyone enjoyed the tour.

Here is my hint. If you can book the Louvre with a guided tour directly with the Louvre, do it as it is half the price and you skip the line and you get a terrific tour. If you can't then book Christina who is engaging, smart and educated. The tour was efficient and well run. Her knowledge is top notch. Woke up my 15 year old who had no sleep the night before, complaining about being tired and by hour two he was taking tons of photos and listening to Christina. I turned and he was at the front of the line. To get a 15 year off their phone and to listen and take photos is a testament to Christina's knowledge and charm. She was also patient with people who strayed off and noticed those who were slower and did a head count to make sure everyone was there. It was unnecessary as I personally would leave everyone behind who didn't listen but she was very alert and kind. Sat down tonight for a cocktail with my 55 year old husband was talking about things she pointed out that I missed. He said it has been the best thing of our tour to London and Paris so far.

Met our guide Francois under the carousel monument at the designated time. Our family of 7 joined about 10 other participants. Francois kept us all together amidst the crowds. As a prior history teacher before becoming a full-time guide, he was exceptionally knowledgeable about the artwork that we saw. Answered everyone’s questions and more! Skipping the Line was a real time saver, and we felt we had an exceptional tour of the many treasures displayed in the Louvre. Highly recommend!

Top notch tour guide!! It was a great way to see the Louvre!! We didn't wait in line to get in and our guide was super knowledgable about all the pieces. We weren't rushed and she really took her time to allow our small group to enjoy each piece.

This is the only way to see this amazing museum. This is the second time I have been and the first time since i was going to school here as a kid. This place is even more amazing than I remember, truly one of the greats of the world. Skipping the line is the only way i would ever come here, a very crowded place but so many things to see that it is truly a must!

We left 10 mins late, their transmitters are absolutely terrible - 10 feet or less from the guide to hear anything, which is difficult with a group of 20 people.
The guide was confusing and not properly trained to handle a person with accessibility issues and this made the tour difficult and even more delayed. Interesting is that on the ticket it clearly says it is not wheelchair accessible! I would pay a bit more for a better organized tour.

It’s the biggest museum in the world, if you want to see the whole museum you need 3 months. Our tour guide was very educated and funny. He showed us some of the highlights of the louvre such as, Mona Lisa, and he gave us the history of Dovinche’s panting. I highly recommend this tour, because they are really good, and skip the line is very good.
Wish I could give 6/5 stars for Alex! It was great fun and very interesting. Clever guy with a lot of knowledge as well as charisma.
Enjoyed listening to the evolution of the building and the time period the artists lived in the building.

The museum is extremely busy, so booking the tour was really helpful. Our guide Felix was very knowledgeable, very personal and did a wonderful job of guiding us through the crowds and ensuring that we saw and learned about the highlights of the museum. Highly recommended

Felix, the english translater tour guide made the Louvre one of the top things we saw in Paris. We were so impressed by his depth of knowledge and complete understanding of the history that supported and made more interesting the artwork there. He was really amazing!!!!
Catherine our guide, was excellent, very knowledgeable and quite witty with her comments. Great tour - would highly recommend!!
Sylvie was amazing! We really enjoyed her as a guide through the Lourve, she was extremely knowledgeable, polite and was able to keep up with our group of 20 in the very busy museum.

We were 5 minutes late to the meeting point at Arc du triomphe du Carrousel. The tour had started, and the tour guide refused to let us join the group. Said we had to meet the "contact person" under the Arc to place us with another group. The contact person was not there even though we were only 5 minutes late. Approached the tour guide again, who said he only had 25 tickets, and his group was full. Tour guide very rude. Called customer service, who was also very rude. The company, City Wonders, refused to grant a refund, although they had clearly sold our spots to another group of tourists. When I asked to speak to a manager, they refused saying that they were on holiday. Bottom line, I am out of $150 because I was 5 minutes late to a meeting point. Was I late... yes. Should there be a 5- 10 minute grace period before they resell my tickets for a company that markets to tourists travelling in foreign countries ... I think that is reasonable. Do I deserve to be treated with respect and courtesy... absolutely. Customer Service was rude. Tour guide was rude. Please be warned, and use a different company

Felix was our guide and he was amazing. He took us to all the highlights. He gave us many tips on dealing with the crowds. He was very informative which really helped. It was really worth the extra money to skip the long, long line.
Awesome tour! We weren’t sure what to expect. Friendly and very knowledgeable tour guide. We got to see each of the major pieces in the museum.

It’s my second time visiting the museum but the first time to join a tour. Our guide was very qualified and extremely knowledgeable. She has made our experience at the huge museum easy and fun. Highly recommend.

The Louvre is spectacular but the crowds really diminish the experience. There are on average 50,000 visitors a day. This leads to extreme crowding as you walk through the galleries and there are so many people standing around and in front of the art that it is often impossible to see it and appreciate it. The tour does provide an advantage by allowing you to skip very long lines to enter the museum. Once inside, the guide provides helpful information about the history and the artwork that makes things interesting. But the guide decides where you are going once inside and this determines what you will get to see. We saw all of the "famous" works like the Venus de Milo, Winged Victory, and the Mona Lisa, but it felt like we were rushing by hundreds of really beautiful things as we fought the crowd and tried to stay in sight of our guide. Sometimes the guide seemed fixated on certain items and we spent a lengthy amount of time standing in front of one thing while he went on and on explaining and discussing the work. At others, we barely got the name of the work before we were rushing off. In retrospect, we would have appreciated less pushing and shoving and the ability to explore a little more on our own.

Great tour! I can’t remember our guides name but she wasn’t over qualified with a PhD...Totally worth the money...she was very pleasant and extremely informative...our tour lasted 2.5 hours with many interesting facts...would definitely book with them again!
Absolutely amazing tour. Highly recommend this. Though be prepared to walk ALOT and get very tired. But love the information given by the guide. Added to the experience immensely 👍🏽👍🏽

Was an efficient way to see the main attractions. The place is bigger than I thought. Need several days to appreciate it. Learned about the pieces and their history. Was more than I could remember later tho.

Hottest summer in Paris and our guide prepared us for hot rooms, cooler spaces, best vantage points and crowded spaces. The headsets worked great so we could learn great info while following our guide to other rooms.

Our trip was via City Wonders and although the instructions on where to meet were incorrect - calling the phone number for the booking sorted that. Our guide Natalya had just come from Saint Petersburg Russia (where we think she said she is also a museum guide) and she was beyond amazing! Articulate, engaging - a fabulous story teller and former teacher too we believe. We were quite lucky as tour group was small due a large group who were supposed to be there being held up. The tour was my husband, myself, our 18 year and 19 year old girls and a few others. This tour provides the guide with a headset and we all have earphones so Natalya could just walk and talk and we could follow and listen. It was all of our first time at the Louvre and we could not have been happier for the three hours we spent there. Yes it was crowded, sometimes quite warm - but not all the time. Natalya knew how to navigate and at times we found ourselves viewing masterpieces in quiet corners as well. We learned a TON! Yes of course about the art and artists - but also the history of the building itself, of Paris, of the monarchy and several stories I'm not sure we would have heard anywhere else. Thank you Natalya. It was a top highlight of our 3 days in Paris :)
Lots of walking, so very much to see, so wear comfy shoes. Its huge and I found it a bit warm. Have fun!

We booked this tour though Trip Advisor 3 weeks ahead of time. We arrived 2 hours early. We went to the meeting Point. We were told the tour had been cancelled. There were also no tickets available to purchase. This is not a reliable tour to book! Only book directly on line from the Louvre. I was Very Disappointed.

Excellent choice for people wishing to visit the highlight of this fabulous museum, skip the line was a great plus and our guide was brilliant, fun and informative. I would recommend it to anyone travelling to Paris and wishing to visit the Louvre without hassle.

Our experience was simply amazing! Check in was seamless, and our guide, “Z” was my favorite guide of my whole trip! He was knowledgeable, courteous and funny! I appreciated that he took great pains to make sure that everyone in our group was accounted for at all times, and looked to see that we were able to be up front and able to see all the amazing works of art. The fact that he just completed an art degree was an added bonus as he was able to give us specific details about what we were looking at. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who is planning to go to the Louvre. The skip the line feature is another plus that you don’t want to miss.

Tour was the right length for us, about 2.5 hours. Hits the headline pieces that most come to see. Guide was Felix and he added great commentary on the history and significance of them. This tour is more than just being lead around the museum, it is a short art history lesson in one of the most beautiful classrooms. Advice: take an early tour so you can linger the rest of the day inside the Louvre. There is so much to see.
Our tour guide was full of personality and very knowledgeable. Really enjoyed this tour!!! Would select this tour again.

We took this tour with my 13 year old and my mother. The meeting point was not very well described but once we figured it out all was well. Our guide Lucien was amazing. Native Parisian and extremely knowledgable about all things France and the museum. He was very accommodating to the group, especially my mother who was in a wheel chair. This tour is kind of the cliffhanger notes of the museum. He hits all of the significant highlights and it was well played out with no lines for our group. FYI, if you are with a wheelchair this may not be the best tour for you. My mother was bale to walk up the steps and I carried the wheelchair up. When we were about to leave our guide told us "there is and elevator over there". There are plenty of elevators, but they aren't on the tour path.

Our guide, Ivanna was fantastic! She is from Serbia but working on her PhD in Paris. She was very knowledgeable and friendly! She knew all of the history and details of the art and museum. She even took us on a surprise visit to Napoleon’s apartment because we had a little extra time.

Wonderful tour! Our guide (Alistair from Scotland) was wonderful. You better be fit because the walk and stairs are tiring. Only improvement would be to ensure the guide has an extended flag so you can find him - we spent 15 minutes walking around the meeting point before we found him. When you get to the Mona Lisa push your way around to the right to get close to the painting since the enormous flow of bodies goes out to the left.

The Louvre is such a gigantic museum, just to navigate it is a challenge. Unless you have unlimited amounts of time, take this tour and let a professional guide you to the sweet spots, then put them in context. For us that pro was Manny, and he was superb!
Great tour guide, Nev was awesome and had so much knowledge to share about the pieces at the Lourve.

we did not stay in the line for ticket but Had to waite more than 40 min till they find names and arrange other things. our guide was a 60 year old man, he had a bad breath and he was in hurry, we lost him 2 times and he did not even realize. after finishing the tour we managed to come back and take photos with highlights.

Small group only5 people. Our guide was most personable and knowledgable.

We would highly recommened her!
Great experience. Our guide was very knowledgeable and spoke perfect English. Everything went very smoothly. I would highly recommend this tour.

My daughter and I really enjoyed this tour. Our guide, Katrina, was wonderful! She was fun, very knowledgeable and kept us on track and able to see the main items throughout the museum. The tour was long, lots of walking, but well worth it.

Our guide Alex was fantastic. He was informative, witty and funny. He spoke for he whole tour with great information. His history qualifications were an asset, with relevant information to explain idiosyncrasies of the museum’s pieces. Very well done!!
Our tour was on Friday night, which is a good choice - less crowed. Unfortunaly, out guide wasn't that good

Our guide Daniel was great. His deep knowledge of history and art made this tour very enjoyable. We did not have to wait in line at all. This is a great introduction to Louvre and makes you want to come back and explore.

Fabi was wonderful. Informative, personable, she opened my eyes and heart to some new artists I had never heard of. A great mix of the best known and some hidden gems. Overall loved it and would recommend it to others.
The museum was beautiful! Besides the paintings, the sculptures throughout were terrific. Skip the Line saved us a lot of time waiting in line.

Fab made our tour of the Louvre unforgettable. Her knowledge of the exhibits was great but her passion for the history and art was wonderful. I would highly recommend this tour for the added insight that we got. Also important is to have someone who knows their way around this huge museum - getting lost is very easy but we did not have that problem!

Fabrizia was amazing! She was passionate about the subject, highly knowledgeable and warm and engaging with our group. I hope you can hire mi guides like her. The tour was wonderful and we learned - and enjoyed it - a lot!

Best 3 hours ever. Lucia was an amazing guide who guided our family of 4 (my children are 20, and 18). We were in Paris a couple of days after Notre Dame fire)The Louve is a special place and she was loaded with information...passionate about teaching us the history of the Luovre and the artwork. She was able to help us navigate the Museum through the crowds and tailored the tour to our interests.

Fab blew us away with her knowledge, excitement and joy for storytelling. She MADE our visit to the Louvre. She brought the art pieces to life, had an answer for every question the group asked, and expanded further when there was more intrigue to illuminate. I highly recommend seeking out Fab’s tours whether in France or Italy. Fab has well honed tour guide skills, kept the group together, explained logistics, and has a good sense of humor!

We had Felix as our English guide ... and he knew his stuff! We learned so much from him regarding the major pieces of work, as well as various artists. The 3 hours went by quickly, but beware ... it’s a lot of walking and standing. Bring comfortable shoes! Our line skipping helped right from the beginning, as there were literally thousands of people waiting to get into the Louvre and we just walked right past them, saving a TON of time! As a group, we were able to surround a piece of work that Felix took us to, so that we all had a great opportunity to photograph them, as well as learn about them ... except for La Joconda (Mona Lisa). That’s just a crazy situation. Do t do this in your own, go with a guide!

The guide "Z" was an art history graduate who was full of information. Every question asked he had a knowledgeable answer. He was very helpful to me since I walk with a cane; he would guide me to an elevator while the rest of the group used the stairs.
On this tour we saw the Mona Lisa and Venus DeMilo.

The Louvre is a huge museum without a guide you just won't get all the history and detail that was presented by our guide. It takes 3 months to see every work of hour but a 3 hour tour gave a good overview. "Z" was fantastic!!!
Great experience !!! Interesting... The guide with long curly hair gave us lots of amusing details on the castle's history !!! Well done!!
Laura P was phenomenal! She is an amazing guide - knows history and art very well - and made it a fantastic experience. Thank you!
Dan was very lively and knowledgeable. We highly enjoyed the experience and would do it again. Definitely worth the money!

This tour exceeded my expectations by far. Adam was incredibly knowledgeable and enjoyable throughout the tour. He taught us so many interesting facts about the pieces. I didn't think the 2.5 hour tour would be so fun! Time honestly just flew by. I *highly* recommend asking for Adam as your tour guide.

Let me start off by saying my review might be a tad bias because I'm not a lover of art but I do appreciate it. With that being said, this was a great tour and guide was very knowledgeable and showed us the highlights of our 3-hour excursion. While i wasn't blown away by it, I would still recommend that if you have time, you should visit it because there is a lot to see and do.

Had a great time on this tour. We didn’t know what to expect but very glad we booked this tour. Adam was a great guide through the museum. He kept the information fun and light, while informing us very well of the pieces we viewed. The entire group seemed to
Enjoy his comments and information and his awesome sense of humor. Thank you Adam!!!

We had the 9.45 walking tour on a Saturday morning. There were 24 of us in the group and I was originally thinking this isn’t going to be good.

However Felix is an old hand at this and with everyone equipped with a walkie talkie and in ear headphone, it went surprisingly smoothly.

He was articulate, had opinions, some facts you don’t know and funny. We covered Nike, Mona Lisa, Venus, the 4 turtles and Cupid and Psyche. Paced well with a lady who struggled with stairs, it was a great way to see just a portion of the Louvre.

I had reservations about group size but with the comms system in use it just wasn’t an issue. I’d highly recommend the tour.

Our tour was with Felix and he was excellent! It lasted for 3 hours and we were able to see the highlights of the south end. I would have been lost without this tour. It is highly recommended to acquaint yourself with the massive Louvre.
I enjoyed learning about the stories behind the styles of art that we saw. Felix was great at engaging with the group and made it interesting. I am usually not a “‘museum person” but thoroughly enjoyed this tour.

We booked many tours during our stay (a few through Viator and a couple of more expensive private tours). The tour we took with City Wonders Tours was by far the best! Our tour guide, Nev was so knowledgeable, professional & easy to understand. Her passion for the arts was contagious and she helped us navigate the massive & crowded louvre with ease. I wish I would have done my Palace of Versailles trip with them because I learned so much on this tour. Would highly recommend Nev from City Wonders LTD (booked Via Viator).

We had a excellent tour of the Louvre, with our wonderful tour guide, Anastasia. She was both knowledgeable and warm and friendly, taking into account the needs of the group. She did a great joy showing us the highlights of the museum and pointing out unique aspects of various pieces. The meet up point was easy to find and we were very pleased with the entire experience. Thank you!

Our guide through the Louvre Museum was wonderful. Florence was patient and incredibly informed and animated, making the 3 hour tour pass very quickly. I appreciated the tempo of the tour and her ability to make the Louvre not overwhelming. Thank you.

We had a great visit and tour and was amazed at the Louvre. It would have been overwhelming if not for our guide, Yulia, who did an awesome job with her bubbly personality and insight into the masterpieces you will see here. It was easy and effortless as we walked through the Louvre and saw the highlights. Take extra time after the tour to go back and see everything you are interested in. Make it an all day visit...You will love it!

Felix was our guide and he was passionate and knowledgeable and made the tour so much more than we had even hoped it would be. The museum was huge and overwhelming, but with his help we navigated it with ease and made sure we saw some of the main highlights. He provided a lot of historical context which really enhanced the experience and we went away with a greater understanding and appreciation for art. Thank you Felix for a memorable Louvre Tour!
Our guide Yulia was very knowledgeable and gave us a brilliant and most interesting tour of the Louvre.

Violet was so knowledgable and clearly very passionate about art history. The whole tour was fascinating and we were made to feel very comfortable in what is an overwhelming place. Can’t recommend this enough

The private tour is well worth the money to skip the line and to receive and in-depth tour of the Louvre. Ear pieces were provided to make sure the guide was heard clearly so that you did not miss any detail while walking around a busy museum. The guide spoke brilliant English and was very knowledgeable on not just the works of art but the small details in the history and the building of the Louvre which gave more insight to a standard entry to the museum. Highly recommend this visit.
Book a tour with Violet. You will have fun, and learn a lot along the way! We couldn’t have been more pleased. We have hired private guides around the world...She is right up there at the top!

Ruben was the tour guide for our tour. he was able to provide great insight into the art work we saw.
It was brilliant!!! Can't really say more!

My best friend and I just finished the Louvre tour with our tour guide Viollette (sp?) She was entertaining and knowledgeable. She loves history and told great stories. We skipped the line which was nice. It is a 3+ hour tour. We were given the opportunity to see the “must see” exhibits. This is a must do. Hopefully you will be lucky to spend the day with Viollette.

I may get her name wrong but I think our guide was called Lucia. She was clearly very knowledgeable and -- given the constraints she has to work with: huge crowds in the museum and in particular near prominent items such as the Mona Lisa -- she did an excellent job. She stopped at selected artworks and explained a bit of the history of them. All that with a slight accent but in impeccable English. She also occasionally showed pictures to illustrate points (e.g., the sketch of Marie-Antoinette just before she was guillotined). Overall she managed the rather diverse group of about 25 very well. There was a snafu at the beginning. Apparently the City Wonders org had too few headphones, so we started off late. (Not much, about ten minutes, I think. Still ... that seemed avoidable.) Overall, a good experience and no regrets having selected a guided tour. The museum of course is amazing and I will be back.

This tour was excellent. Adam was our tour guide, he was very knowledgeable about the history of the art and made the tour interesting and very enjoyable. We enjoyed every moment of our visit to the Louvre and were very lucky to have been in team Adam.
Josephine was outstanding! She was knowledgeable and passionate. We learned so much more from this tour than we expected and enjoyed in it every minute of it. Highly recommend!

Just finished a 3 hour private tour with Yvonna. What a great experience! Her knowledge was incredible and she was fantastic with the kids. We learned a lot and whizzed through the museum.
With a very limited time in Paris, I highly recommend the private tour (hopefully you get to spend time with her)!

My sister and I were only in Paris for a weekend, so we wanted to hit the sites but not spend all day at one place. This tour was excellent for a couple of hours. Our guide, Daniel, was knowledgeable, funny, and he kept us engaged and entertained. We learned so much in such a short period! Our tour was in the morning, so it wasn’t incredibly crowded and ended up being such a lovely way to spend the first half of the day. I highly recommend this tour!

Our tour guide was Josephine...and she was exceptional! Not only did she guide us through the museum, she provided stories and details that allowed you to ponder. The 2.5 hour tour flew by! I highly recommend!
Violette from City Wonders made the visit to the Louvre for my wife and I very engaging, interesting, and a great fun learning experience. Thoroughly and highly recommended!!

The idea of tackling the Louvre in one morning alone seemed like a daunting task. So happy that I found City Wonders! I did their 3 hour skip the line tour of the Louvre. Violette, our guide, was absolutely fantastic! Equal parts entertaining and knowledgeable. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants access to and info on some of the most famous pieces in the museum.

Our guide Felix in late November was outstanding. He knew his subject and showed us things you would have missed on your own. Very articulate and had great love for the artist and the history.
If art is not your passion, you will enjoy this tour and walk away wanting to learn more. The earpiece also was nice so it was easy to hear without having to be right beside the tour guide.

I like our tour guide; I am not sure how to spell his name (Zachary). He did a good job, consider that our group was too big (over 30 people) and Louvre itself is overpopulated. He was very responsible, very organized and how he was able to keep track of everybody, it is amazing. I did learn a lot about the art, history and about this place as well. I am not sure if I would like to come back into the Louvre. It is too crowded for me. The tour guide was knowledgeable, passion and extremely patient with us.

Our guide Violette was such a gem! She was a wealth of knowledge, extremely fun to tour with, articulate and professional (even after someone clipped past her in a bull-rushed frenzy, knocking the iPad out of her hand.) Heck yes, I’d recommend this tour to anyone and if possible with Violette!

We always visit the Louvre when we visit Paris. Due to the size and complexity of the museum, a guide is a must. Although we have been there and have seen these amazing, priceless works of art in the past, we had an incredible tour with Allestor from City Wonders. He was funny, extremely knowledgeable and great at explaining everything he showed us. He even took us into Napoleon‘s apartment, something we have never seen before at the Louvre, which was incredible. He was so passionate about the apartment that he went longer than the allotted time, without rushing any of us.

Great tour! I highly recommend City Wonders.

I can't remember the guide's name, but she was excellent. She put the major pieces of art in context with fascinating stories about each and kept everyone interested for the entire three hours. There was minimal waiting at security to enter. The three hours flew by. It is quite a bit of walking but well worth it rather than wandering through this enormous museum.

We were very pleased with our Louvre tour with Carolina. She was quite pleasant and extremely knowledgeable about the museum and it’s history as well as the art work and artists. Without a doubt our family, including our teenage children, had a much more rich and engaging experience visiting the Louvre thanks to having Carolina as our guide. I highly recommend this tour.

This was definitely worth the expense! Our tour guide Felipe from Croatia was great! I learned some interesting facts. I also appreciated that we each received a radio and earbud to hear the guide, who was speaking into a microphone. This was extremely helpful given how crowded and noisy the museum can be with so many visitors. Unfortunately I couldn't stay for the whole tour, but even half was well worth the convenience and guide!

This was an excellent tour our guide Anastasia was so personable and knowledgeable about everything on this tour! This was the English tour and her language skills were impeccable.
Thank you so much!!!

The benefits of having a very knowledgeable guide, both in regards to providing background as well as knowing how to navigate the maze called the Louvre, can not be overstated. We saw the highlights, or as the guide said, the “rock stars” of the Louvre while skirting our way through the crowds. Definitely money well spent.

We had only a minimal art knowledge when we started, but Felix’s knowledge and passion made this the best tour we have taken so far.
His stories about the different pieces and knowledge of the artists made this a fascinating tour. Not only did we see the more famous parts, but he also showed us pieces from other artists who were mentored by famous artists and we were able to see their influence.
The line was very long, but it went fast. We are glad not to pay extra so we can skip the line. We had plenty of time to get inside. It was nice that we were allowed to take pictures.

I am so glad that I booked this guided tour before visiting Louvre. Our tour guide Adam is able to introduce us all the key items from the vast collection of Louvre within 3 hours time. Not to mention how did he help us finding the best spot to admire the beauty of the artifacts. Though I have read books on Louvre before the visit, the guided tour is definitely so much better than reading the guidebook or having a audio guide. I lost my way several times in the museum when wondering around by myself after the tour. I might also overlook a few very interesting pieces without joining the tour with Adam.

Excellent value, and a great way to see the main highlights of the museum. Our guide was very good. We saw all of the pieces we wanted to see, and we were free to walk around without the guide on our own after the tour.

We loved this tour: Louvre Masterpieces and Royal Palace. Our guide was Josephine and she was friendly, knowledgeable and witty. Throughout the tour she would take moments in history and compare them to life today. She kept us entertained during this whole tour.
The louvre is enormous and no one could ever walk through all of it. This tour skipped all the lines and showed us all the top pieces of art.

Definitely book this tour if it’s your first time visiting the museum. Adam our guide was amazing, knowledgeable, funny and engaging. Think he made the experience, brought us to the pieces that we went to see, saving us valuable time but also to other pieces that were amazing.. was truly an interesting history lesson that we reflected on after we left. Worth every penny, book it, if you get Adam, your lucky.. you will love him and the experience.

Daniel from City Wonders was great. After going on about 5 tours with different companies and a few of City Wonders, this experience was by far the best. We skipped the entire line to get in which was valuable on it's own. The tour was thorough, engaging and entertaining. Not sure what more you can ask for.

As far as I am concerned this was the only way to visit this museum. The museum was packed with people and the lines to get in were long. Our excellent guide Anastasia spoke very good english and her knowledge of what she was showing us was superb. The Louvre is jammed full of relics, paintings, sculptures and lots of other interesting things. Of course the Mona Lisa was there as well. The tour lasted about 3 hours and since we all had head sets tuned into Anastasia’s head microphone the commentary was easy to hear and understand. Again, only way to do it!

Louvre Highlights Tour - Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo & Winged Victory, Spent a few weeks in Europe with our pre-teen daughters this summer, one of the tours we booked was the walking tour of the Louvre w/City Wonders. Claire, our tour guide, was fantastic! Absolutely a perfect tour. She was happy, engaging, precise, knowledgeable, and really did wonderful job at keeping the group, (kids included) engaged in all aspects of the tour. Yes, you completely skip the line, yes, there is a lot of walking, you meet out by the arch and enter thru the group entrance. Worth every cent & Highly recommend!!

Louvre Highlights Tour: Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo & Winged Victory

Date: 8/12/18
Time: 1030am

Tour Guide: Adam

Absolutely perfect Tour!! This was my second time at the Louvre and my family’s first. Skipped the line and walked right in. Saw the “have to” sights, but, also, sooo much more and were allowed to stay in museum at tour completion.

Adam was excellent!!
Being Canadian he spoke perfect English and provided a veritable art history class in 3 hours with such passion and humor that we were enthralled and bummed when it ended. I would recommend this tour to everyone. You will not be disappointed.
And...if you are blessed/lucky enough to get Adam as your guide then you are in for a first class experience.

Thank you Take a Walk tours and Merci Beaucoup, Adam!!!!

Can not say enough about our guided tour of the Lourve. Our guide, so sorry I did not get her name...was from France but spoke perfect English and was wonderfully knowledgeable and witty. She seemed to stay ahead of the crowds bringing in the the museum through side entrances ahead of all of the crowds. Going early was a plus, we noticed the crowds were very large as our tour was ending. Highly recommend this tour when you have a guide as good as ours!

Tour guide very informative and knowledgeable. Group tour departed timely and we were able to enter through a side door and head to front of line for entrance. Venue very crowded but we were ushered to the main attractions within two hours and then left to do a leisurely amble on our own!
Excellent three-hour tour of the magnificent Louvre. Our tour guide, Daniel, was sensational. His knowledge, insight and sense of humor was fantastic!

So.. we just came off a guided Eiffel Tower tour with a awesome guide. He made the experience perfect.... Then came this tour.. It was awful and we left half way into the tour.

Our guide which spoke with such a thick French accent that I honestly could not understand more than half of his words. I am usually great at understanding “broken English”, being born outside the US, but this guy took the cake! Not only did he speak with such a thick accent, he spoke super fast AND he wore his head microphone around his neck which means that every time he turned his head slightly, his mouth would be away from the mic. He went from barely being able to hear him to ear shattering loudness. I basically shut off my headset about 40 minutes into the tour after a few others asked him to adjust to no avail.

Now don’t get me wrong, he was a nice guy but the tour was horrible. As many know, the Louvre has more displays than one can possible see in one day.. this guide spent about 10-15 minutes at single displays telling facts we couldn’t understand, hear, or were on a tangent to the subject.

We felt awkward leaving in the middle of the tour but our family of 4 decided we had to. We enjoyed touring the Louvre ourselves so much more... though a good guide would have made it much better.

I guess these tours are hit and miss depending on the guide you get... I would have thought though that when a company assigns 24 guests to one guide (collectively we all spent about $1700... he would have been vetted and trained.. NOT the case.

Pass!

I am giving the tour organizer a 3 star rating. Our tour guide, Loren, gets a 5 star rating. The tour organizer, City Wonders, instructs you to be at the Arc du Carrousel 15 minutes before the start of the tour, 6:30 pm, and to look for someone holding a sign for City Wonders. On July 4th, my party of 5 arrived at the appointed meeting place at 6:05 pm along with numerous other people. There were probably more than 100 of us standing around in the hot sun with no place to sit waiting for a City Wonders representative to appear. That happened at 6:50 pm. Before he arrived, I called the contact number on my voucher and reached a recorder message that "no one was available to take my call". The representative didn't have a sign, and I only noticed him because a lot of people were standing around him asking questions, He said the tour was delayed because some of the guides had not shown up and we would have to wait a little longer while the company got substitute guides and the entrance tickets to the museum. We didn't get assigned a guide until 7:10 pm. However, our guide, Loren, was excellent, and our group was just the 5 of us. His knowledge of the art work was incredible and he added interesting tidbits of historical information about each exhibit. If City Wonders had not been so disorganized, I would have given the tour a higher number of stars.
Visited Louvre twice. I like Egyptian exhibits very much. It is huge. You need half of the day simply to rush through the most popular exhibits

Well worth the effort if you are short on time. Its managed in a semi biased way by the guide who knows how to avoid fellow groups but gives you just the right amount of info to take in the main pieces. Can ask lots of questions later as well. Definitely worth it for the quicker admission into the main areas...

Pre-booked this ’evening tour in english’ before going to Paris. The lines to get in to the Louvre can be about 2 hours sometimes so PRE-BOOK!!
Our guide met us on the courtyard outside. Very easy to find.
We were about 24 people on our tour.
Our guide was absolutely great! She knew EVERYTHING about history and made our tour come alive!
Walking through the Louvre when it started to get dark outside was very cozy:)
The tour was about 3,5 hours from meeting to end. Loved every minute of it!

This is a very interesting tour, which includes most interesting masterpieces in the Louvre. It is very difficult to make such a selection among tens of thousands of artworks, but they did it perfectly well. Our guide Florence was more than interesting, very pleasant, ready to answer any question. The tour took about 3 hours which is the exact measure for tourists who wish to see as much of Paris as possible. Of course, one could spend months in the Louvre museum, but if you do not have so much time, this tour is higly recommended.

Expect to spend 2-4 hours. Best time to go is right when it opens to get in the line. If you go to see the Mona Lisa, find that right away. There are a few little cafes inside to get something to eat or drink

This was a fantastic experience and thanks to our amazing tour guide, Adam, we learnt so much history whilst walking around. 3 hours felt like 30 minutes thanks to his fantastic knowledge. We covered all the main pieces of art that you go there to see and many more, highly recommended, thank you!

My fiance and I had such a fun time during this tour. Our tour guide, Adam, was very engaging and knowledgeable about art history and culture. Skipping the line was a bonus and we liked the fact that Adam took us to top masterpieces and paintings. We recommended this tour and Adam to all of our friends.

The guide is very good, knowledgeable and explained all the highlights of the museum. The museum is big but she is very organised. Very worth it to skip the long queue which otherwise we would have wasted hours of precious time queueing. I would definitely use them if I go there again! The group is kept to a comfortable size so that we would not get lost or need to wait for everybody.

Our guide was awesome! She was super knowledgeable about the Louvre's history and art. We got a private tour, and it was worth every penny, because we learned so much and we got to skip an extremely long line at the entrance. The previous weekend we waited 45 min to get into the Musee d’Orsay; so, we were so glad we could skip the line. In addition to all the must see sights, she took us to places we wouldn’t have seen on our own, and we loved those areas: the original moat and Napoleon’s drawing room. I highly recommend this tour.

We had Adam as a guide and he was very informative! From the initial meet up till we were down he had a wealth of information and his English was impeccable. He helped the tour navigate to the best spots for viewing and answered all questions in great detail.

I was by myself on business trip, so decided to join a tour instead of going around alone. Felix is a former world history teacher from Croatia. Excellent knowledge of pieces and history and he was also very passionate about them. Great sense of humor. I wish I had him for my teacher. I may have learned much more!
This was one of the best tours!!! I don’t know much about art but the tour guide made it very understandable and tangible. This tour is not for people who struggle with walking or mobility.

We had our walking tour at the Louvre on the afternoon of 5 April. I can't remember the guide's name, but he was very accommodating, interesting and had good knowledge of the Louvre and the displayed items. We enjoyed the interesting comments he made, and took us directly to the items of interest. We enjoyed the walking tour and will recommend it rather than to try and discover the Louvre on your own, especially if this is your 1st visit.

We did the Friday night three hour tour with Adam and it was the highlight of our visit. We saw all the "must sees" as well as many more beautiful pieces. Our guide was so knowledgeable and entertaining. I can't recommend him enough. I learned so much and the night flew by.

If Adam doesn’t make you love art and history, nothing will.
Adam is knowledgeable, entertaining and very professional.
Amazing!!
Get a tour with Adam if you can - his knowledge and humour made the tour so fun and interesting. We loved every second of it
Make sure you plan your visit and make reservations ahead of time. Get your camera ready, the place gorgeous. The tour is great, wear confortable shoes.

The tour itself is a great way to skip the very long lines to enter the Louvre. Adam made it a wonderful experience. He is very knowledgeable. Instead of bombarding us with dates and names, his sense of humor and approachable storytelling taught us so much and made each work of art so interesting. The 3 hours flew by! I only want to go back to the Louvre with Adam as my guide.
We had Adam as our guide. Brilliant to skip the really long que and go straight in. Adam made the 3h go by so fast with his witty, knowledge and amusing narration.

Having already braved the Louvre one with my husband we went back for a guided tour. We met our guide Adam under the aegis and he proceeded to guide us effortlessly into the museum with endless facts of everything in sight. His knowledge of all things history related was absolutely astounding and he made an unforgettable experience that much more amazing. My husband and I couldn’t stop saying how glad we were to have not only done the extended tour but to have been lead by someone so wonderful. Thank you to Adam! Can’t wait to wow our friends with all the information gained on this tour. #TeamAdam

It was a rainy morning so it was great to wait under the Arch and march past the waiting crowds (peasants) to experience the Louvre with Adam as our guide. Adam was very informative and entertaining. He was able to guide us to certain angles, posed questions, and inserted humor. We liked that he went chronologically through the pieces so we could imagine the progression of the art. Adam is very intelligent but not pretentious.
We had a wonderful time with our tour guide. She was knowledgeable, helpful, and pleasant. Great Tour!

We were apart of a tour that made good use of our available time. Elise was our guide and she gave us history and she was without a doubt the best guide of our 3 week European travel. She reminded us that the Louvre was a Fortress, Palace, and Museum. The tour made it all so clear and logical from the historical progression of the layout of the exhibits to the history of the major works of art that we saw. We never felt rushed or overwhelmed.
If you are lucky enough to encounter Elise, she is a gem!
